missions.name_zh: [DESTINATION] 跑腿

detail.description_en:
Got a box sitting at [LOCATION] that needs to make its way over to [DESTINATION]. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?
Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
在 [LOCATION] 有个箱子需要送到 [DESTINATION]。你能不能快点把这个搞定？

这可能是我分配的最简单的任务了。唯一的危险就是绊倒自己。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [LOCATION]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.
They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.
Stows out.

他们或许在口头上大谈安全，但他们手里有枪，而且很乐意使用。

missions.name_zh: [LOCATION] 需要一堆维修

detail.description_en:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to [LOCATION] and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.
I think if you've got six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes, you should be covered.
Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
需要个懂工具的人去 [LOCATION] 帮忙修点东西。上个维修工搞定了大部分问题，但还有些地方需要检查。

我觉得你带上 六个保险丝、打捞工具 和 足够修补五根管道的 RMC 罐 应该就够了。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，你 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》 或许值得翻翻。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [LOCATION] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TARGET], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.
While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.
Good luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们刚收到关于 [LOCATION] 遭到一大群武装人员攻击的报告，他们由 [TARGETNAME] 领导，这是一名臭名昭著的不法分子，已经威胁繁荣公民的工作人员好几个月了。具体细节尚未确认，但我们知道已经有多人伤亡。

繁荣公民正在寻找任何合格的安全人员前去夺回这些前哨站。我们了解到 [TARGETNAME] 往往藏在他们的士兵后面，但如果你消灭足够多的普通士兵，他们会出现。

虽然我们不喜欢诉诸暴力，但管理层认为没有其他办法来解决这个情况并继续我们在星系中的良好工作。

祝好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

missions.name_zh: [LOCATION] 需要大维特修

detail.description_en:
The storms over at [LOCATION] are getting to be a real pain in the ass. One of our outposts got absolutely reamed yesterday and needs some serious repairs so we're looking for help.
Figure you'd need to bring about six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to deal with at most eight busted pipes. We think that’ll cover, but you'll get exact numbers on site.
Hell with this place.
Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, that “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
[LOCATION] 那边的风暴真是要命，昨天我们一个前哨站被彻底摧毁了，需要大修，所以来找帮手。

估计你得带 六个保险丝、打捞工具，还有 足够处理最多八根破裂管道的 RMC 罐。我们觉得应该够用，但具体数量得到现场确认。

这破地方真见鬼。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，你 mobiGlas 日志里的 《维修指南》 或许值得翻翻。

detail.description_en:
The Civilian Defense Force needs YOU! Everyday, in the Stanton system innocent civilians are preyed upon by vicious outlaws and heartless criminals.
NO MORE.
Under the authority of the UEE and the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the CDF is deputizing all combat minded individuals in good legal standing* to engage and neutralize any individuals or vehicles that they verify to have an active CrimeStat.
In exchange for these selfless contributions to the general populaces safety, the CDF will financially compensate those who successfully bring these criminals to justice with a reward** of 500 UEC per outlaw dealt with.
Now is your chance to help bring about a positive change for yourself and all other Stanton travelers. Sign up today and do your part!
* Be aware, acquiring a CrimeStat will revoke CDF membership and cancel any outstanding contracts.
** Please note, criminals encountered as part of paid contract work do not qualify for the reward.

detail.description_en:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives.
People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.
I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills.
Seek out and discreetly kill [TARGET] over at [LOCATION].
Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
首先，请允许我介绍一下我自己。夸张点儿说，我做的是人命的活计。

有人要杀人，就会来找我，而我会雇佣一个完美的杀手。这种方式对所有人来说都安全，因为没有人知道对方是谁，就我们这活儿的性质来说再好不过了。

最近我听说你的手艺不错，能担得起这活儿，这说法到底对不对，我觉得值得一试。

你要是有兴趣给我做事儿，那就展示下你传说中的身手吧。

目标是 [TARGETNAME]，他们在 [LOCATION]，悄悄得杀掉他们。

办成了，你不仅有钱可拿，而且也是你实力的证明，以后还会有活儿给你。

此致，
沃恩

Vaughn

尽量把事情办得干净点。

此致，
沃恩

Vaughn

此致，

detail.description_en:
I am thrilled to inform you that we have a particularly ambitious assignment for you.
[TARGET] has been marked for termination. You may know them already: a particularly high-profile member of the People’s Alliance who is notorious for having thwarted numerous attempts against their life. We initially considered it too troublesome until our client offered an even more outrageous amount of credits to see this to completion.
The target’s last known location was at [LOCATION]. Expect a top-of-the-line ship and a skilled escort.
We look forward to hearing about their untimely demise.
Sincerely,
Vaughn

目标最后已知的位置在 [LOCATION]。预计他们会有一艘顶级飞船和一名技术娴熟的护卫陪同。

我们期待听到他们意外死亡的消息。

此致，
沃恩

detail.description_en:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TARGET] once and for all.
Start your search at [LOCATION]. These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.
However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
这目标真的难盯。他属于那帮神出鬼没的爪蜥帮，平时东躲西藏、行踪不定。不过最近听说他们正拼命想重启一座老掉牙的 QV 碎岩站。这倒是个千载难逢的机会，说不定这次真能一劳永逸地干掉 [TARGETNAME]。

先从 [LOCATION] 开始搜起吧。这种前哨站空荡荡的，像个大山洞似的。你一进去怕是得花点力气才能把人揪出来。

但是，我对你有十足的信心，
沃恩

detail.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.
> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.
This introductory contract will require you to head to [LOCATION] and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.
Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION
The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.
NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]
RISK ASSESSMENT: Very High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: With your proven track record, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn an Advanced Tracker License.
This license would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend Very High-Risk Targets (VHRT). These criminals can travel in larger multicrew ships with heavy escorts. With multiple hostiles to deal with, encounters with these targets can often be lethal.
To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a VHRT ranked criminal by the name of [TARGET] last seen at [LOCATION].
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice
The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 伏击 MRT

detail.description_en:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a [TARGET]. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?
Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by [LOCATION]. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike.
The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours.
And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 5 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
咱们猎头帮有个金主挂了悬赏要搞掉 [AMBUSHTARGET]。干完这票让他乐呵乐呵？

情报如下：目标船队会经过 [LOCATION]。附近有有片辐射云能藏住飞船信号，猫那儿等动手时机就行。

金主只要目标死透。残骸里捞到的好货都归你。

更重要的是，我还会额外奖励给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为甜头。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat Ready
Briefing:
An Idris-class People's Alliance security vessel named Tranquility is currently engaged with a <EM>Vanduul capital ship</EM4> near an old QV Extraction station and Intersec is looking for combat pilots to lend some support.
Scramble to the AO and engage Vanduul fighters so the Tranquility can focus on the capital ship.
Good luck,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：
一艘名为宁静号的伊德里斯级的人民联盟安保飞船正在一处旧的 QV 采矿站附近与一艘剜度主力舰交战，互安正招募战斗飞行员前去支援。

赶紧赶往行动区域，干掉那些剜度战斗机，好让宁静号专心对付那艘主力舰。

祝好运，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

detail.description_en:
One of our people is currently under attack at [LOCATION]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

利马·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION], we can really make it worth your while.
-Bit Zeros
detail.description_zh:
我们有个大活儿要找个真正的狠角色。我们正在想办法让某个人彻底消失，消得一干二净，其中一部分就是从那个人最近在 [LOCATION] 那边出的“事故”里把黑匣子捞出来。

问题是——这个人雇来策划这场事故的家伙们，现在觉得这事儿能赚更多，干脆赖在那艘死人飞船旁边不走了，不肯撒手。

这帮人可不讲武德，你最好带俩帮手，不然分分钟凉透。但只要你能把黑匣子搞出来，送到 [DESTINATION]，咱保证让你赚得盆满钵满。

- 零比特

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR74382
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
A known outlaw attacked and destroyed a ship near [LOCATION]. The agency has been contracted to retrieve the ship’s blackbox in order to build a case against them and lobby for Advocacy intervention.
Contract Investigator Actions:
An operative is needed to head to the crime scene at [LOCATION], secure the area from any hostiles present to procure the blackbox, and deliver to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Be advised that there are still hostile forces in the area that will attack. These will most likely have some experience fighting, so be prepared.
This contract has been flagged as a combat mission.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR74382
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
一伙已知的不法分子在 [LOCATION] 附近袭击并摧毁了一艘飞船。事务所已委托你回收该飞船的黑匣子，以便为他们建立案件并争取督导局的介入。

合约调查员的行动：
需要一名特工前往 [LOCATION] 的犯罪现场，确保该区域安全，排除任何敌对势力，然后取回黑匣子并将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
请注意，该地区仍有敌对势力存在，它们可能会有战斗经验，因此要做好准备。

此合约已被标记为战斗任务。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR23665
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Operative with extensive combat experience needed to retrieve a blackbox from a compromised ship at [LOCATION]. Client hasn’t specified why they need it but are paying good money to have it back.
Analysis of the wreck indicates that there are some serious hostiles in the area, so any attempt to retrieve will likely require a fight. Our records indicate that these hostiles are highly trained and aggressive, so prepare accordingly.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Route to [LOCATION] and secure the blacbox by any means necessary. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION] for payment.
Additional Notes:
Operations wanted to reiterate that this will be a heavy combat mission so make sure you bring allies or equipment to handle it.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR23665
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
需要一名具有丰富战斗经验的特工从 [LOCATION] 的一艘受损飞船中取出黑匣子。客户没有说明他们为何需要这个黑匣子，但他们愿意支付丰厚的报酬来取回它。

对残骸的分析表明，该地区有一些危险的敌对势力，因此任何取回黑匣子的尝试都可能引发战斗。我们的记录显示这些敌对势力训练有素且具有攻击性，所以请做好相应准备。

合约调查员的行动：
前往 [LOCATION]，想尽一切办法确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送到 [DESTINATION] 以获取报酬。

补充说明：
运营部门再次强调，这将是一次高强度战斗任务，请确保带上盟友或相应的装备来应对。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
This request comes down from Head Office.
We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near [LOCATION] might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a top-tier operative with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.
There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to [LOCATION] and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR547384
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
这个请求来自总部。

我们刚刚得知，最近在 [LOCATION] 附近发生的飞船袭击可能是由一个臭名昭著且难以捉摸的非法分子团伙所为。他们上次露面已经是多年前的事了，所以这是一个难得的机会。我们的客户不想错过这个机会。我们需要一名具有精英战斗经验的顶级特工来回收这艘被击落飞船的黑匣子，以证明该团伙的参与。

现场将有训练有素的敌对势力，它们会对你的到来进行强烈抵抗。消灭它们并完成任务。

合约调查员的行动：
立即前往 [LOCATION]，清理周围的空域以确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
总部强调，这将是一个极其艰巨的任务。一定要全力以赴。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR547384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
This request comes down from Head Office.
We’ve just learned that a recent ship attack near [LOCATION] might have been the work of a notorious and equally elusive outlaw ringleader. The last time they popped their head above water was years ago, so this is a rare opportunity to catch them. This is an opportunity that our client does not want to pass up. We need a top-tier operative with elite combat experience to retrieve the blackbox of this downed ship in order to prove the ringleader’s involvement.
There will be highly-trained hostiles present on the scene who will put up significant resistance to your presence. Eliminate them and complete the mission.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Immediately scramble to [LOCATION] and clear the surrounding airspace in order to secure the blackbox. Once obtained, deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Head Office stresses that this will be an incredibly difficult mission to pull off. Make sure you bring your A-game.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #BR547384
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
这个请求来自总部。

我们刚刚得知，最近在 [LOCATION] 附近发生的飞船袭击可能是由一个臭名昭著且难以捉摸的非法分子团伙所为。他们上次露面已经是多年前的事了，所以这是一个难得的机会。我们的客户不想错过这个机会。我们需要一名具有精英战斗经验的顶级特工来回收这艘被击落飞船的黑匣子，以证明该团伙的参与。

现场将有训练有素的敌对势力，它们会对你的到来进行强烈抵抗。消灭它们并完成任务。

合约调查员的行动：
立即前往 [LOCATION]，清理周围的空域以确保黑匣子的安全。一旦拿到黑匣子，将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
总部强调，这将是一个极其艰巨的任务。一定要全力以赴。

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
WORK BRIEF:
There's been another attack out at [LOCATION]. Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, retrieve the blackbox and deliver it [DESTINATION]. Make sure you bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox.
Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet they're still in the area.

Battaglia, Recco

detail.description_en:
IN-GAME ALSO SHOWN AS
Turning the Tables
Upgrade Grab
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.
Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.
Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.
-Bit Zeros
detail.description_zh:
好不容易才锁定一件稀有科技，结果却在最后一秒被人截胡。追踪它倒是不难，但我可不想一直追着这东西跑。

去 [LOCATION] 把它给我找回来。那边的人估计压根不知道那玩意儿有多贵重，不如我们帮他们一把，顺手把东西拿走。至于有没有人看守，我也不清楚，怎么应对潜在威胁你自己看着办。

拿到手后，把它送到 [DESTINATION]，到时候我们就给你打信用点。

- 零比特

detail.description_en:
IN-GAME ALSO SHOWN AS
Turning the Tables
Upgrade Grab
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.
Head to [LOCATION] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.
Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION] and then we'll send over the creds.
-Bit Zeros
detail.description_zh:
好不容易才锁定一件稀有科技，结果却在最后一秒被人截胡。追踪它倒是不难，但我可不想一直追着这东西跑。

去 [LOCATION] 把它给我找回来。那边的人估计压根不知道那玩意儿有多贵重，不如我们帮他们一把，顺手把东西拿走。至于有没有人看守，我也不清楚，怎么应对潜在威胁你自己看着办。

拿到手后，把它送到 [DESTINATION]，到时候我们就给你打信用点。

- 零比特

detail.description_en:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it.
I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely.
Think you can rise to the occasion?
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
异种威胁现在正处于战争状态，他们正同时对好几个猎头帮站点发动攻击，把我们的战士们逼得筋疲力尽。我得到消息，他们计划下一个突袭 [LOCATION]，而我们找不到人来保卫它。

我想雇个人来着急一群人，准备好补给，为我们建立一个强大的防御力量。实话跟你说，这会是一场激烈的战斗。异种们派了一些最有经验的部队过去。我只能说他们可能会错开他们的部队，把他们全部歼灭，你会得到丰厚的报酬。

你觉得你能应对的了吗？

- 斯托斯

I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong.
Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [LOCATION] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.
Sound like your kinda thing?
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:
我对繁荣公民插手不该管的事感到非常厌烦。

我开始觉得让他们的舰队暂时趴一阵子可能会不错。让我们在 [LOCATION] 炸掉他们的燃料罐，这些小家伙就不会轻易动了。

这听起来像是你喜欢的事吗？

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name [TARGET] is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at [LOCATION].
Our intel suggests that [TARGET]’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to [TARGET].
That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.
Best of luck,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

有一份需要比平时更多策略的合约。一个叫做 [TARGETNAME] 的高等级罪犯正与大量非法分子躲藏在 [LOCATION]。

我们的情报显示出 [TARGETNAME] 的手下很可能是为了保护他们的老板而集结的。我猜你必须先解决掉他们才能找到 [TARGETNAME]。

话虽如此，我并不希望你进行无差别攻击。有时这些法外之徒身边会有一些平民，应该把他们当作非战斗人员。

祝你好运

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

missions.name_zh: 大宗科瓦莱什货物需要追回
name_notes_zh: 科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 非常困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to [LOCATION] and complete the delivery.
This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and unless you're super strong a heavy-duty tractor beam to shift it all.
I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this all behind us.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

情况是这样的，我跟那个承包商打了一小时通讯，帮他排查飞船故障，最后实在搞不定，只能换人上。现在得赶紧派你去 [LOCATION] 那儿帮忙完成交付。

这单不小，你得开艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。除非你臂力爆表，否则必须配把重型牵引光束才搬得动。

我真心感激你，要是能搞定这个的话。货一拿到手就直送 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那里去，这样这事儿就算翻篇了。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

name_notes_zh: 科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 非常困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to [LOCATION] and complete the delivery.
This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and unless you're super strong a heavy-duty tractor beam to shift it all.
I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this all behind us.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

情况是这样的，我跟那个承包商打了一小时通讯，帮他排查飞船故障，最后实在搞不定，只能换人上。现在得赶紧派你去 [LOCATION] 那儿帮忙完成交付。

这单不小，你得开艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。除非你臂力爆表，否则必须配把重型牵引光束才搬得动。

我真心感激你，要是能搞定这个的话。货一拿到手就直送 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那里去，这样这事儿就算翻篇了。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

detail.description_en:
Although Citizens for Prosperity is committed to change through non-violent means, it's become apparent that exceptions might have to be made. CFP safe zones near [LOCATION] were recently and violently taken by XenoThreat forces under the command of [TARGET].
We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.
Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out [TARGET], who's loss will certainly make the system safer.
Good luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
虽然繁荣公民致力于通过非暴力手段实现变革，但显然可能需要做出例外。位于 [LOCATION] 附近的繁荣公民安全区最近被异种威胁部队在 [TARGETNAME] 的指挥下暴力夺取。

我们正在寻找任何有空的作战人员来帮助夺回这些前哨站。这无疑将是一项艰巨的任务，因为异种威胁部队训练有素且渴望战斗，所以你应该做好相应的准备。

除了清理每个集群的异种威胁部队之外，你还需要解决 [TARGETNAME]，他的失去无疑会让星系更加安全。

祝你好运。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

missions.name_zh: 逮捕阿灵顿帮领袖马尔特克斯·阿灵顿

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********
Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. Maltrox is the most likely suspect. While the regtag was temporarily deactivated, we have been able to trace the ship’s quantum signature and have provided you those coordinates.
A third generation criminal, the Arlington gang has been under Maltrox’s leadership for the past six years. Be aware, this is a smart, aggressive, and very dangerous target. The more resources you can bring to bear, the more likely it is that we can bring Maltrox in one and for all.
You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
detail.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 差事

合约类型：集体逮捕令
合约状态：独立
授权代码 = [CONTRACTOR]

需要立即处理

*********
__背景信息__
臭名昭著的阿灵顿帮居然试图从一个修船厂中盗窃一艘伊德里斯级护卫舰，作为回应，他们每个人都在这一份集体逮捕令中。这次盗窃被阻止了，那群渣滓落荒而逃，分开躲进了黑暗中。到底是无胆鼠辈，大难临头各自飞。埃克哈特安保收到了一份对阿灵顿帮高级成员的即时赏金逮捕令。成员包括：马尔特克斯·阿灵顿，卡斯·登特，尼克斯·坎特威尔，萨姆“爱哭鬼”阿灵顿，奥斯陆·阿灵顿和莱斯·阿灵顿。
*********

马尔特克斯·阿灵顿近来十分低调，但道高一丈，我们还是发现了他的蛛丝马迹并定位了一处可能是其藏身处的坐标。近日，一艘巡逻队舰船被盗窃，事发时该巡逻舰正随其所属巡逻队在一个燃料补给站补充燃料。马尔特克斯·阿灵顿是该案件最大的嫌疑人。该巡逻舰注册的可追踪标签被临时停用了，但通过分析并追踪舰船的量子特征，我们得出了该舰目前的坐标。

马尔特克斯·阿灵顿出生于一个犯罪之家。这个家族三代人都以犯罪为生。这六年来，马尔特克斯一直作为阿灵顿帮领袖活动着。当心。马尔特克斯是一个不好搞定的目标。他阴险，聪明，而且交战手段通常十分激进。此行动有很大可能会演变成一场持久战。带上你所能承担得起的一切补给，无论是弹药还是医用品，能带多少带多少。把马尔特克斯一劳永逸的干掉，给他的罪恶一生画上句号。

你被授权使用任何必要的火力，枪炮刀剑都无所谓，把他干掉。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

detail.description_en:
Hi,
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of [ITEM] that needs to go from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].
No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold 2 SCU cargo containers, and a handheld tractor beam to move them around.
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.
Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

现在，在我的管理下，玲家快递即将迈出新的重要一步——开展货运业务。这项新服务的需求增长速度超出了我的预期，这对我们双方来说都是好消息。

如果这次运输任务顺利完成，你将被提升为“值得信赖承包商”，之后会有更多的运输任务等着你。


此致，
佩特拉·玲
货运运营总经理
玲家快递

detail.description_en:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.
If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.
Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a 32 SCU load, and try not to get shot in the process. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
需要有人帮我们拿些货物。我们之前在一个老旧的哈索尔平台校准设施上进行秘密情报传递，但当地的帮派已经在那里扎根了，我们无法取回我们的东西。

如果你想动手的话，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯上拿走货物，然后送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯上。

我听说这个地方混杂着各种人。拿回我们的东西可不容易，但这就是我们花钱付雇你的原因。

确保你有一艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 货物的飞船，并尽量在过程中不要被打中。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.
Our pilot over at [LOCATION] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.
If you have a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.
This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.
Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll get it processed.
Good luck and take care,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
最近越来越多繁荣公民的飞船遭到袭击，尽管我们竭尽全力保持贸易航线低调，仍不断有运输员在不法分子的攻击中丧生。

位于 [LOCATION] 的飞行员就是最新一位牺牲者。想到我们已损失如此之多，实在令人心痛；但只要还有人需要我们的帮助，我们就必须继续战斗。

如果你有一艘能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，以及一把重型牵引光束，请立刻前往上述地点，把货物取回来。

这任务可不轻松。这位飞行员是我们最顶尖的成员之一，绝不会轻易被击倒。切勿低估这些不法分子，带上信得过的船员，彼此照应、互相掩护。

取回货物后，请将其送至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处，我会安排后续处理。

祝你好运，务必小心，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, [LOCATION], still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.
You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to [DESTINATION].
Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

联合科学与开发公司(ASD)联系了我们，好像是他们以前的一个实验室，[LOCATION]，那里还存放着一些他们想要取回的物资。

你应该驾驶一艘能够能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，降落在机库中，通过货运电梯装货，然后把所有东西运回 [DESTINATION]。

在设施那边的时候，一定要保持警惕，别让好奇心占了上风。像这样的废弃地点可能会藏着各种危险的东西。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

尽力做到最好 – 为你所做的工作感到自豪，这样你就会做出值得骄傲的成绩。

missions.name_zh: 从关闭的设施转移货物

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, [LOCATION], still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.
You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to [DESTINATION].
Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

联合科学与开发公司(ASD)联系了我们，好像是他们以前的一个实验室，[LOCATION]，那里还存放着一些他们想要取回的物资。

你应该驾驶一艘能够能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，降落在机库中，通过货运电梯装货，然后把所有东西运回 [DESTINATION]。

在设施那边的时候，一定要保持警惕，别让好奇心占了上风。像这样的废弃地点可能会藏着各种危险的东西。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

尽力做到最好 – 为你所做的工作感到自豪，这样你就会做出值得骄傲的成绩。

name_notes_zh: 沃恩 - 寻找尸体 LRT

detail.description_en:
A rather creative former contractor of ours with a knack for staging accidents was so swept up in their work that they forgot to confirm the death of [TARGET] for us.
The target’s body should be located at [LOCATION]. I need you to give the hopefully deceased an inspection to ensure the job was completed to our standard.
Do be careful when you arrive at the location. It wouldn’t surprise me if there was a few vultures lurking around.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
我们的一位相当有创意的前承包商，特别擅长制造事故，忙得忘了给我们确认 [TARGETNAME] 的死亡情况。

目标的尸体应该在 [LOCATION] 那里。我需要你去检查一下那位但愿已经去世的人，确保这事儿做得符合我们的标准。

你到达地点时可得小心点。要是有几个秃鹫在附近转悠，我一点都不会惊讶。

此致，
沃恩

missions.name_zh: 帮人收拾烂摊子
name_notes_zh: 死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 LRT

detail.description_en:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.
Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at [LOCATION]. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.
You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.
When you’re done, take the stuff to [DESTINATION] and I’ll sort you out with a reward.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
你有没有过那种感觉——问别人问题时，明明觉得他在撒谎，可你还是选择信他一回？对，我现在就处在这种状况。

我雇了两个自称“专家”的运输工，帮我运点货，结果他们半路出事，直接把我的货扔在了 [LOCATION]。不用说，我已经下了追杀令，但现在我需要你去把那批货给捞回来。追踪器显示货还在船上，你只需要带个重型牵引光束和你自己的船，直接去拖走就行。

可能会有几个捡破烂的在那边晃荡，不过我觉得你应付起来应该不费劲。

搞定之后，把货送到 [DESTINATION]，报酬少不了你的。

- 刺痛

missions.name_zh: 清除繁荣公民航线上的敌对目标
name_notes_zh: 繁荣公民 - 击杀飞船 LRT 多波次

detail.description_en:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.
You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.
Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
为保护我方飞行员，繁荣公民常建议采用星系内不那么传统的航线。然而，似乎一伙不法分子已获悉此事，并开始在其中一条航线上反复设伏。与其绕行避险、任其隐患蔓延至新路线，我们更倾向于正面迎击这些不法分子。

你及你召集来的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对势力。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

非常感谢您的帮助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
Long story, short - a Headhunter messed up real bad and now Citizens for Prosperity has gotten their hands on some data that could really do some damage to us.
The bastard is going to need some time to heal so that leaves it to you to clean up the mess. Can you go to [LOCATION] and destroy the servers they got stored there? I wanna make sure there's no chance of this info getting out there.
-Stows out

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but for our scientists to continue their efforts they need resources that the company's suppliers have been unable to deliver.
There is a sizeable population of kopions that have been exposed to radiation near [LOCATION]. Rayari is seeking an contractor to collect irradiated kopion horns and deliver them to [DESTINATION]. Due to the scarcity of this resource, we are prepared to pay a high service fee.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are working day and night to solve the current regen crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need rare resources that the company's suppliers cannot deliver.
We are therefore seeking a contractor to secure an irradiated valakkar egg. Our scans have confirmed several radioactive storms with known a valakkar presence on Pyro I, you can find a shuttle near [LOCATION] that will take you inside the storm. One more thing, analysis indicates that these eggs will decay over time, the state of the egg shouldn't affect our research but sooner would be better.
Due to the health risks associated with radiation exposure that will be needed to deliver a viable sample, Rayari is ready to pay well for anyone who can safely secure and deliver this item.
Once attained, please take this valuable resource to [DESTINATION].
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正在日夜不停地解决当前的再生危机，但我们的科学家需要一些公司供应商无法提供的稀有资源，以继续他们的研究工作。

因此，我们正在寻找一位承包商来获取一枚 受辐射的瓦拉卡蛋。我们的扫描确认了派罗 I 上存在几个带有瓦拉卡踪迹的放射性风暴，你可以在 [LOCATION] 附近找到一艘穿梭机，它将带你进入风暴。还有一点，分析表明这些蛋会随时间逐渐腐坏，蛋的状态应该不会影响到我们的研究，但越快越好。

由于获取可靠样本需要面对辐射暴露带来的健康风险，拉亚利准备为任何能够安全获取并运送该物品的人支付丰厚报酬。

一旦收集完成，请将这份珍贵资源送到 [DESTINATION]。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

missions.name_zh: 战斗挑战 - 场景 #1

detail.description_en:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.
Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing.
That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.
GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter
So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to [LOCATION] to begin.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 1 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:
想获得与各种目标和情况作战的关键实战经验吗？那我的战斗挑战可能正适合你。

请理解，这个课程是为那些已经掌握飞行基础、准备将技能提升到更高水平的飞行员设计的。如果你刚开始，想学习基础知识，我建议你在竞技指挥官模拟舱中多练习几小时。但对于那些准备迎接真正挑战的人，我坚信学生通过实践学习效果最好。

这就是为什么我设计了这八个场景，尽量做到尽可能真实。我向你保证，这将是你在不参军的情况下，最接近海军战斗飞行员训练的体验，所以不要指望会有人过多照顾。您自身或您飞船受伤的风险应当被极其严肃地对待。

挑战场景：
1. 单一目标
2. 复数目标
3. 目标优先级
4. 目标隐身
5. 导弹与对策
6. 多船员目标
7. 带护航的护卫舰
8. 主力舰遭遇战

所以，如果你准备好挑战自己并证明你有成为优秀飞行员的能力，第一场景将专注于处理单一目标。前往 [LOCATION] 开始。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 情境意识 - 不要太专注于攻击目标以至于忽视了你的飞行路径。如果你一头撞上小行星，那就没什么意义了。

祝你好运，
教练吉利


关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

detail.description_en:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.
Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.
Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to [LOCATION] to begin.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 3 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:

detail.description_en:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.
The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.
Whenever you’re ready, head to [LOCATION] to get started.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 5 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第二部分。

场景 3 将加入战术决策要素。本次来袭飞船分属不同舰种，战场职能各异。学会判断优先打击目标，是在混战中存活的关键。

准备就绪后，请前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 擒贼先擒王 - 优先评估最具威胁的目标并集中消灭。
- 护盾管理 - 若持续遭受重创，不妨加速脱离战场等待护盾充能。

祝你好运，

detail.description_en:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.
Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.
Make your way to [LOCATION] whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 10 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第三部分。

优秀飞行员都明白：真正的威胁往往藏于暗处。场景 4 将重点训练如何应对隐形目标。课程结束时，你会深刻体会到雷达在识别敌情时的重要性——本次你将同时遭遇常规飞船和隐身飞船的围剿。

准备就绪后前往 [LOCATION] ，切记时刻关注雷达动向。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 反隐侦查 - 主动扫描周围空域可能发现隐藏目标，随时做好遭遇突发敌情的准备。

祝你好运，
教练吉利

missions.name_zh: 战斗挑战 - 场景 #5

detail.description_en:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.
The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.
Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to [LOCATION] to start.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 12 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire.
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第四部分。

场景 5 重点训练防御战术。学会在何时采取规避动作、释放诱饵弹或干扰弹是生存的关键。本次训练的敌舰将配备导弹武器。

请确保携带足量反导装备，随后前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 快速反应 - 将诱饵弹和干扰弹设置为快捷键，这对应对导弹袭击至关重要
- 稳住阵脚 - 不要试图用加力燃烧逃跑，这反而会增大信号特征让导弹更容易锁定你（反正导弹肯定比你快）。
- 近身战术 - 看似违反直觉，但贴近敌舰反而有利。导弹有最小射程限制，贴身时无法锁定你。


祝你好运，
教练吉利

missions.name_zh: 战斗挑战 - 场景 #6

detail.description_en:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.
I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.
Find your way to [LOCATION] whenever you're ready.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 14 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第五部分。

场景 6 要动真格了——你将面对大型多船员飞船。这些巨兽带来全新挑战：不仅要应付凶猛火力，其多面护盾系统更要求你持续攻击同一面护盾才能造成有效伤害。在高速机动中保持精准攻击可不容易。

准备就绪后，请前往 [LOCATION] 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 尺寸优势 - 对抗大型飞船时，尽量避开正前方，那里通常是主武器集中区域

祝你好运，
教练吉利

missions.name_zh: 战斗挑战 - 场景 #7

detail.description_en:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.
You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.
The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.
Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to [LOCATION] to kick off the encounter.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 16 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第六部分。

经过前六个场景训练，现在是检验成果的时候了。第七课将让你直面一艘护卫舰级飞船及其护航编队。这场持久战会把你逼到极限，全面考验所学技能。

现在只剩最后一项要领悟：个人能力的极限。说白了，单打独斗总有尽头。发展和维护与其他飞行员的关系，能在关键时刻呼叫支援，才是终极解决方案。当然独狼也能完成任务——但就连海军也从不让王牌飞行员单独出勤。

决定好单干还是呼叫支援后，请前往 [LOCATION] 开始战斗。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 优势互补 - 慎重选择援军阵容，确保有人牵制护卫舰时，其他人能解决护航舰队。合理搭配各舰职能才能扬长避短。

祝你好运，
教练吉利


关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

missions.name_zh: 战斗挑战 - 场景 #8

detail.description_en:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.
Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.
You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to [LOCATION] to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 20 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
detail.description_zh:
欢迎来到战斗挑战的最终场景。

通过本课程，你已掌握在各种遭遇战中生存所需的进阶战斗与防御技巧。现在是将所学融会贯通的时刻——直面一艘主力舰及其护航编队的终极考验。

老规矩，当你和僚机准备就绪后，前往 [LOCATION] 看看当你被逼到极限时候的表现。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 耐心制胜 - 只要编队配置合理，胜利终将属于你。但要做好持久战准备，击沉巨舰从来不是速战速决的事。

祝你好运，
教练吉利


关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

name_notes_zh: 玲家快递 - 取回货物 困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hello,
Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.
We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at [LOCATION].
If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll take care of the rest.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
detail.description_zh:
你好，

坏消息。我们的运输员途中遇险，被迫遗弃了本应送达的货物。至今杳无音信，我们只能做最坏打算。

我们正在联系他们的家人，也明白现在是特别敏感的时刻，但实在没法放着任务半途而废。我们的追踪器显示，那批货物还在 [LOCATION] 那儿，完好无损。

要是你能把这批货送完，我们真的非常感激。目前没探测到附近有别的飞船，应该挺安全的，你去取就行。记得带把重型牵引光束，再开一艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行，剩下的交给我们来处理。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

detail.description_en:

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.
We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at [LOCATION].
If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll take care of the rest.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

detail.description_en:
We just received word that a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity affiliated ships have been targeted by outlaws and that our people are in dire need of assistance.
If you are available, we need combat ready pilots at [LOCATION] to defend our people. Note that at this dire time, we cannot afford even a single lost ship and expect with your assistance for all of our people make it out alive.
Good luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们刚收到消息，隶属于繁荣公民的船队遭到了不法分子的袭击，我们的人员急需支援。

如果你有空，我们需要战斗准备好的飞行员前往 [LOCATION] 保护我们的人员。请注意，在这个危急时刻，我们无法承受任何一艘飞船的损失，并希望在你的帮助下，所有人都能安全脱离。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

We’ve lost contact with a supply convoy and are concerned it might be under attack. Last comm we received from them reported Shattered Blade ships were incoming, but haven’t heard anything since. Are you free to hurry to [LOCATION] and support our forces?
We’ve come to learn that the Shattered Blade are very protective of their hunting grounds. Our last few encounters with them were quite intense, so I’d recommend bringing some heavy firepower.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们与一支物资运输队失去了联系，担心他们可能正遭到攻击。我们最后收到的消息说，碎刃帮的飞船正在逼近，但从那以后就再没消息了。你现在有空的话，能赶紧赶到 [LOCATION] 支援我们的部队吗？

我们了解到，碎刃帮对他们狩猎地的保护非常严，最近几次和他们交手都挺激烈的，所以建议你带上足够的重火力。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy on a resupply run dropped a distress beacon near [LOCATION]. They’re not answering any comms, so I assume the situation is serious. That convoy has some skilled pilots, so if they’re not responding then they definitely need the help.
We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
繁荣公民组织的一支补给运输舰队在 [LOCATION] 附近丢下了一个求救信标。他们没有任何回应，所以我估计情况很严重。这支运输队里有些技术不错的飞行员，要是他们不回话，那就说明真的需要支援了。

我们会给你报酬来支援这支运输舰队。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.
Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION] and likely rearming for another attack.
We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.
Stows out
detail.description_zh:
多年来，许多想当帮派的人都试图挑战猎头帮，认为他们可以强行进入这个星系。现在我们还在这里，他们都不在了。但似乎这些团体的幸存者决定重新联合起来，再次尝试。看来有些人永远都学不会教训。

最近一群人袭击了我们的物资运输队，法官想要迅速消灭他们，这也不奇怪。我们得知他们位于 [LOCATION] 附近，可能正在重新武装准备再次攻击。

我们希望你去那里，让他们后悔没有和他们的老帮派一起死去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In
WORK BRIEF:
Just got word that one of the mining teams is unaccounted for. They were supposed to be back hours ago, but no one’s heard from them. Family have tried to reach out but haven’t gotten a response from anyone on the crew.
I can send you their last known location, so we’re looking for someone to go check in and see if they’re okay. If the worst happened, please identify anyone you find. I’m sure the families would appreciate some closure on what happened.
Thanks
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：船员还没报平安

工作简报：
刚接到消息，有个采矿小队失联了。他们本该几个小时前就回来，可现在没有人有他们的消息。家属们试着联系过，但也没人回应。

我可以把他们的最后已知位置发给你，所以我们想找个人过去看看情况，确认他们是否安好。万一真出了事，也请尽量辨认出你找到的人。我相信家属们很希望能知道到底发生了什么，好有个交代。

谢谢。

报酬：
确认全体成员状态后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特

detail.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

detail.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特

detail.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

detail.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.
If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.
Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.
Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.
Just do the job and get home safe, okay?
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

又是新的一天，又有一个信标。在 [LOCATION] 那边有一艘 [SHIP] 希望能补充 [FUELTYPE]。客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

我也不骗你：那地方一旦被困住可不好受，要是被偷袭就更糟糕了。我们在那儿已经损失了不少人 - 哪怕是运气好活下来的，回家时也缺胳膊少腿的。

如果你决定接这活儿，帮我个忙，时刻提高警惕。如果你有个朋友正好有空，不妨叫上他搭把手做点支援。

也许是我多虑了，但这并不意味着他们不会找你麻烦，正如德洛特妈妈常说的那样。
其实她从来没说过这话 - 不过我敢打赌，如果她靠这个谋生，她肯定这么说。

把活儿干完，平安回家，好吗？

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at [DESTINATION] when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.
There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at [LOCATION]. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.
This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and let's make this right.
Fly safe,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们正赶着把一批紧急物资运送到 [DESTINATION] 那的人们手中，结果飞行员途中遭遇一伙不法分子。他们试图逃跑，但为时已晚。

不过好消息是，追踪器显示货物目前仍完好无损，位置在 [LOCATION]。极有可能那些不法分子正守着货物，等找来足够大的飞船再转移全部物资。虽然我不愿再冒失去一名飞行员的风险，但这批物资的紧迫性实在太高，足以让我们决定派人前去回收。

这任务可不轻松。这群不法分子对我们的飞行员毫不留情。你得先干掉他们，才能取回货物。请务必驾驶一艘能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，并配备一把 重型牵引光束 用于搬运。最后将货物送至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。让我们把这事办妥。

一路平安，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

missions.name_zh: 剔除入侵生物
name_notes_zh: 高境荒野 - 击杀动物 MRT 多物种

detail.description_en:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near [LOCATION]. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.
Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.
Best,
Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
detail.description_zh:
高境荒野专家致力于保持帝国脆弱生态系统的平衡。最近，一位客户雇佣我们评估 [LOCATION] 附近多种入侵生物对环境的影响。我们已确定，为了保护该地区的自然秩序，有必要对这些物种进行有意识的猎杀。

我们正在寻找能够并愿意参与这一努力的人。有关目标生物的更多信息，请在你的日志中参考《斯坦顿野生动物指南》。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

missions.name_zh: 捕杀受辐射的寇骈犬
name_notes_zh: 高境荒野 - 击杀动物 HRT

detail.description_en:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in [LOCATION].
We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around [LOCATION]. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment.
Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.
Best,
Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
detail.description_zh:
由于派罗 I 上频繁的辐射风暴，一些入侵的寇骈犬已经受到辐射污染。这对当地野生动物的健康以及生活和工作在 [LOCATION] 的人们构成了威胁。

我们正在寻找一位熟练的承包商，能够在 [LOCATION] 及其周边地区捕杀任何受辐射污染的寇骈犬。除非你拥有能在放射性环境中可靠运作的武器和装备，否则请勿接受此合约。
你的报酬将根据与本合约相关的风险进行调整。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

missions.name_zh: 危险：走私武器流入

detail.description_en:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.
While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.
Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [LOCATION]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.
Thank you and be safe out there,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
这是一个常规警告。我们得知猎头帮正在向星系运输大量的武器，意图对繁荣公民所拥有的定居点发起袭击。

虽然我们相信，变革只能通过非暴力的方式实现，然而，这些武器的存在毫无疑问会导致更多的流血和破坏，因此我们希望它们能从这个局面里移除。

任何拥有适当作战训练的支持者都被要求在 [LOCATION] 附近承担这个危险的任务。我们将为您所承担的巨大风险提供补偿。

谢谢，祝您在外面安全。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a [TARGET], who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.
Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an emission cloud near [LOCATION] which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

detail.description_en:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.
If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?
Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION] that we want.
All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.
-Bit Zeros

我们是谁、干啥的不重要，你只要知道：我们找人办事，给钱，就完事儿。要是顺顺利利，咱压根不用见面，这不挺好吗？

Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.
If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?
Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION] that we want.
All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

detail.description_en:

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling.
I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one.
Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for 2 SCU cargo containers, and you'll need a handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading. detail.description_zh:
叫我刺痛。死亡圣徒由我管着。

你八成听过我们名号，没听过也无所谓——我们啥都干，但最拿手的就是运些得偷偷摸摸处理的货。

我是从我的一个线人那儿打听到你的，他说你驾驶的运输船有东西挺符合咱们的胃口。

我的方案是这样的——我们出信用点，找人运一票特殊货。你船舱得能塞下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，还得配个手持式牵引光束，好装货卸货。你唯一要做的，就是从 [LOCATION] 把东西运到 [DESTINATION]，别惊动安保。

事儿办漂亮了，以后死亡圣徒的活儿，少不了你。
- 刺痛

detail.description_en:
Got an interesting one. Some folks who were suckered into life/labor contracts with Hurston Dynamics want to get as far from Lorville as they possibly can. They struck a deal with a people mover and got themselves put on ice. Now they just need someone to pick them up and give them a ride.
If you're up for some popsicle smuggling, you'll find [TOTAL] cryopods at [LOCATION] that need to go to [DESTINATION]. Make sure you have space in your cargo hold for size 2 SCU containers. If you use a handheld tractor beam, you should be able to get everyone loaded up before Hurston security catches on.
HD isn't too keen on anyone slipping out of their contracts, so watch your back. They shoot to kill.
If you can pull this off, there's a nice paycheck in it for you.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
有个挺有意思的事儿，一些被赫斯顿动力公司骗去签了劳工合约的人，想离罗威尔越远越好，他们跟个客运公司谈妥了，把自己给冷冻起来了，现在就等有人去接他们，捎他们一程。

如果你打算干点“冰棍”走私的活儿，那就在 [LOCATION] 找到 [TOTAL] 个冷冻舱，把它们运到 [DESTINATION]。记得你的货舱有空间能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱。要是你有手持式牵引光束，那大概能趁赫斯顿安保还没反应过来的时候就能把所有人都装上船。

赫斯顿那帮人可不乐意有人跑路，所以小心点，他们可是见人就开枪。

这事要是成了，报酬少不了你的。

- 刺痛

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. [TARGET] and their crew were identified executing a raid on [LOCATION]. If their MO holds true, [TARGET] has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.
Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of [TARGET] difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force [TARGET] to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
