detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. [TARGET] and their crew were identified executing a raid on [LOCATION]. If their MO holds true, [TARGET] has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.
Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of [TARGET] difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force [TARGET] to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
detail.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：赏金
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

需要立即处理

我们有一份重要的赏金合约等待执行。[TARGETNAME] 及其团队被发现正在对 [LOCATION] 进行突袭。如果他们的行事风格保持不变，那么 [TARGETNAME] 会现身进行一次大行动，然后消失无踪。这次我们不能再让他们得逞。

据称敌对势力已分散在该地点各处，这将使追踪 [TARGETNAME] 的确切位置变得困难。此外，预计目标在受到攻击时会采取防御措施。在之前的交战中，他一直保持隐藏并在远程指挥其部队。我们建议你首先集中精力削弱他们的盟友，迫使 [TARGETNAME] 亲自防御。同时建议你携带充足的弹药，或者一些支援，以免被压制。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

detail.description_en:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TARGET] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.
We're told you can find [TARGET] around [LOCATION]. Head over and take care of it.
They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.
Stows out.

detail.description_en:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact [LOCATION] has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.
With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.
This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 6 Council Scrip for a job well done.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
所以，我本以为咱们把事儿办得挺低调的，结果看来 [LOCATION] 跟猎头帮有关系这事儿还是走漏了风声。现在那帮狠角色在那边惹出大麻烦，盯着 [OBJECTS] 搞破坏，搞得我头都大了。

就凭这些不速之客手里的火力，你得带一帮自己的团队才能搞定。特别是还得护住那些需要帮忙的友方飞船。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我给主承包商开出 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的奖励，干漂亮了就归你。

detail.description_en:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact [LOCATION] has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.
With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.
This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 6 Council Scrip for a job well done.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
所以，我本以为咱们把事儿办得挺低调的，结果看来 [LOCATION] 跟猎头帮有关系这事儿还是走漏了风声。现在那帮狠角色在那边惹出大麻烦，盯着 [OBJECTS] 搞破坏，搞得我头都大了。

就凭这些不速之客手里的火力，你得带一帮自己的团队才能搞定。特别是还得护住那些需要帮忙的友方飞船。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我给主承包商开出 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的奖励，干漂亮了就归你。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact [LOCATION] has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.
With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.
This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 6 Council Scrip for a job well done.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
所以，我本以为咱们把事儿办得挺低调的，结果看来 [LOCATION] 跟猎头帮有关系这事儿还是走漏了风声。现在那帮狠角色在那边惹出大麻烦，盯着 [OBJECTS] 搞破坏，搞得我头都大了。

就凭这些不速之客手里的火力，你得带一帮自己的团队才能搞定。特别是还得护住那些需要帮忙的友方飞船。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我给主承包商开出 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的奖励，干漂亮了就归你。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en: A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at [LOCATION]. Seems someone has been tipped off that if the [OBJECTS] there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix. Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 7 Council Scrip for a job well done. Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
一群枪手被派来搅黄我们在 [LOCATION] 的生意。看来有人通风报信，说要是那里的 [OBJECTS] 被毁了，猎头帮在那片区域的行动就会大受阻碍。这正是个我得让你去解决的麻烦。

不跟你兜圈子了，这些佣兵可不是吃素的。单枪匹马去简直就是送死。所以你不仅要物资备齐，还得找几个信得过的朋友跟你并肩作战。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以只要干得漂亮，主承包商就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: Require urgent assistance for an InterSec operative who is currently under fire at [LOCATION].
A group of outlaws had previously taken our operative captive with the intention of extracting sensitive information from them, but miraculously they were able to escape. Unfortunately, the pursuing outlaws now have them pinned down.
Due to the number of the ships assaulting them, we're offering additional compensation to accommodate the added danger. Recruiting additional ships to support you in this mission is highly advised.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：需要紧急援助一名位于 [LOCATION] 遭受攻击的互安防务特工。

一群不法分子之前抓住了我们的特工，想从他们那儿套出机密信息，但他们奇迹般地逃了出来。不幸的是，那些穷追不舍的不法分子现在把人困住了。

由于攻击他们的飞船数量众多，我们会提供额外补偿来应对额外的风险。非常建议你招募更多飞船来支持你完成这次任务。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

detail.description_en:
We received an emergency comm from [LOCATION] reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.
If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们收到来自 [LOCATION] 的紧急通讯，报告称他们正受到一个猎头帮的攻击。我们知道我们在这个星系的存在激怒了猎头帮，但这并不能成为他们毫无理由发起攻击的借口。

如果可能的话，请整理好你的装备，赶往现场。请理解，猎头帮是经验丰富的战士，绝不会轻易退缩。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

missions.name_zh: 传达信息

detail.description_en:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to [LOCATION].
Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
惊喜，惊喜。看来并不是所有人都对猎头帮在斯坦顿的进展感到高兴。特别是有一伙人一直在袭击我们的人，然后逃回 [LOCATION]。

我希望你去那里，让他们也尝尝自己的苦头。清理轨道平台应该能传达一个明确的信息，那就是惹我们会有什么后果。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 运送玲家快递被抛弃的货物
name_notes_zh: 玲家快递 - 取回货物 非常困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.
Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.
Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

需要找个靠谱的承包商帮我们解个围。

我们一个运输员半道撂挑子了，客户那批货现在卡在半路上。估计是想跟我们重新谈判个更高价，但这可不是玲家快递的作风。反正人已经跑路了，我们急着把这单收尾。

佩特拉和我跟这客户合作好多年了，关系一直挺稳，真不想因为一个不靠谱的运输员全砸了。你能去 [LOCATION] 把货取走吗？记得带个重型牵引光束，再开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

货送到 [DESTINATION] 那边的货运电梯就行，我们马上结账。真挺感谢你搭把手的，客户肯定也一样！

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

missions.name_zh: 运送玲家快递被抛弃的货物
name_notes_zh: 玲家快递 - 取回货物 非常困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.
Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.
Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to [LOCATION] and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

需要找个靠谱的承包商帮我们解个围。

我们一个运输员半道撂挑子了，客户那批货现在卡在半路上。估计是想跟我们重新谈判个更高价，但这可不是玲家快递的作风。反正人已经跑路了，我们急着把这单收尾。

佩特拉和我跟这客户合作好多年了，关系一直挺稳，真不想因为一个不靠谱的运输员全砸了。你能去 [LOCATION] 把货取走吗？记得带个重型牵引光束，再开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

货送到 [DESTINATION] 那边的货运电梯就行，我们马上结账。真挺感谢你搭把手的，客户肯定也一样！

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

detail.description_en:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.
In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.
This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.
Thank you,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
繁荣公民一直在监视一个非常危险的不法分子团伙，他们位于 [LOCATION]，我们相信他们正计划一次可能会使整个星系陷入动荡的大规模攻击。

为了保护我们在这里所取得的所有进展，我们希望你能突袭他们的基地，摧毁所有存放他们计划的服务器。

这至少可以为我们争取到一些缓解的时间，让他们重新考虑他们的进攻。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

missions.name_zh: 瘫痪猎头帮的通讯塔
name_notes_zh: 繁荣公民 - 关闭通讯塔

detail.description_en:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.
We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.
We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to [LOCATION] and disable the communication towers. There should be a control panel located at the top of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.
If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.
It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.
Stay alert and stay safe.
Thank you,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
暴力从来不是我们的首选，但有时必须将其作为预防措施。

我们正计划对一个猎头帮控制的前哨站发动攻击，需要你的帮助。

我们必须确保一旦出了什么问题，就要让他们无法呼叫支援或让局势恶化。这就是你需要出手的地方。你要前往 [LOCATION] 并关闭那些通讯塔。每座塔的 顶部都有一个控制面板，你可以用它来让通讯塔瘫痪。

如果你能完成这件事，繁荣公民就能在派罗取得一些关键的进展。

另外也请记住，今后接取合约的时候，你可以选择直接摧毁通讯塔，避免和增援的运输船正面交火。

保持警惕，注意安全。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION].
Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.
Do you think you could handle it for us?
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
在针对繁荣公民相关定居点的一系列袭击之后，我们相信已经追踪到负责人位于 [LOCATION]。

直接攻击他们将带来很大的风险，并很可能引发激烈的报复。因此，我们认为如果能让他们的发电机停掉，可能会迫使他们迁到别处。

你觉得你能为我们处理这件事吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

直接攻击他们将带来很大的风险，并很可能引发激烈的报复。因此，我们认为如果能让他们的发电机停掉，可能会迫使他们迁到别处。

你觉得你能为我们处理这件事吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

name_notes_zh: 沃恩 - 寻找尸体 HRT

detail.description_en:
[TARGET] was a name that proved particularly troublesome for some time. Whether a master of evasion or just unerringly lucky all of our attempts have thus far failed.
With that being said, it seems that someone else may have beaten us to the punch so to speak. We’d like you to visit [LOCATION] and confirm if the target has indeed been neutralized. But be advised, I suspect they’re former crew may still be in the area, most likely out of a misplaced sense of loyalty. I’d suggest a crew of your own for this one, but will defer to your expertise.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
[TARGETNAME] 这个名字曾经让我们头疼了好一阵子。不管他是逃避大师还是运气好到没话说，我们所有尝试都到目前为止失败了。

话虽如此，看来似乎有人抢先我们一步了。我们希望你去 [LOCATION] 确认一下目标是否真的被干掉了。不过得提醒你一下，我怀疑他之前的船员可能还在这附近，大概是因为错把忠诚当回事儿。我建议你自己带个队伍去，不过具体怎么安排就看你专业了。

此致，
沃恩

detail.description_en:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole [TARGET] opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.
I need some hard workers to go hit [LOCATION] and take out [TARGET]. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们一直试图与这些繁荣公民好好相处，但他们已经非常清楚地表示，在他们的“安全星系”里我们没有立足之地。他们雇佣佣兵提供安保，结果导致了各种不合理的暴力事件。比如那个混蛋 [TARGETNAME] 对一群定居者开火，以将他们驱离一个他们盯上的前哨站，所以现在是时候不再客气了。

我需要一些干劲十足的人去攻击 [LOCATION]，干掉 [TARGETNAME]。直到你证明你是个威胁之前他们都可能会隐藏起来，所以务必要搞出来一点破坏。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

name_notes_zh: 死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 入门

detail.description_en:
Here’s the deal. Dead Saints need some new blood to help shift gear across the ’verse and if you can prove yourself useful, you could make some nice creds doing it.
Got an easy one to start you out. Couple of hours ago, something went down over at [LOCATION] and a pilot of mine got ghosted. My tracker’s telling me that they didn’t find the stash of gear in there.
If you can get out there, get the package back and take it to [DESTINATION] without dying, I might have some more work for you. Can’t see you running into too much trouble as any ships you spot will likely be scavs looking for a quick cred. I’m sure you can take care of that.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
情况是这样的。死亡圣徒需要一些新成员来帮助他们将物资运输到其他星系，如果你能证明自己有用，完成这个任务后可以获得不错的报酬。

给你一个简单的任务作为开始。几个小时前，[LOCATION] 那边出了点状况，我的一名飞行员失踪了。我的追踪器显示他们没有找到那里的物资。

如果你能赶到那里，把包裹取回来并安全送到 [DESTINATION]，我可能会给你更多的任务。你应该不会遇到太大麻烦，因为你看到的任何飞船很可能都是那些想赚快钱的不法分子。我相信你能应付得来。

-刺痛

missions.name_zh: 轻轻松松赚大钱
name_notes_zh: 零比特 - 飞船抢劫 LRT

detail.description_en:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves?
Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.
57 65 65 76 69 6c
detail.description_zh:
听着，我们在筛查一些通讯时，捕捉到了一些关于一笔丰厚交易的激动消息。找出他们藏匿着的一艘装满物资的飞船的地方很简单，我们想，嘿，为什么要把这种有利可图的消息藏起来呢？

给我们打点信用点作为信息费，我们就会把飞船所在的小行星基地的坐标发给你。飞船被锁在一个机库里，所以你需要通过站内的电梯到达那里。但一旦你进去之后，你就可以在控制台上覆盖锁定。做到这一点后，就可以轻松获取到他了。

57 65 65 76 69 6c

*********** People's Alliance ***********

RE: Efficient Miners Wanted
WORK BRIEF:
Need your help with something. If you could harvest [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]</EM4>, that would really help out our understanding of the current mineral levels in the system. [RARITY]
Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.
Thanks in advance.

Battaglia, Recco

提前谢啦。

雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.
We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.
If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.
Thanks,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们在 [LOCATION] 遇到的不法分子问题日益严重，我们不能再袖手旁观，任凭他们的侵略伤害我们的社区。

我们对发起全面攻击持谨慎态度，但我们相信如果能够摧毁他们的燃料储备，可以有效遏制进一步的敌对行动。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: InterSec requires the services of a skilled pilot who’s prepared to assist in taking down a dangerous Vanduul target that has been involved in numerous attacks.
Vanduul incursions have been on the rise recently, posing not only a threat to the system of Nyx, but the UEE as a whole. It is imperative that these sightings are responded to in a swift and efficient manner.
We require you to fly to the last known sighting of the Vanduul ship at [LOCATION] and eliminate them immediately.
Vanduul pilots are highly skilled and extremely dangerous. Engage the enemy immediately and do not hesitate – they will not show the same mercy.
Compensation proportionate to the risk of the contract will be awarded.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安需要一名技术娴熟的飞行员，该飞行员必须准备好协助击落一个危险的剜度目标，这个目标已经参与了许多次攻击。

最近剜度的入侵事件有所增加，这不仅对尼克斯星系构成了威胁，也对整个 UEE 构成了威胁。必须迅速而有效地应对这些情况。

我们需要你飞往 [LOCATION]，即剜度飞船最后一次出现的地点，并立即将其消灭。

Vanduul飞行员技术高超且极其危险。立即与敌人交战，不要犹豫——他们不会手下留情。

根据合约风险，将给予相应的报酬。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 伏击 ERT

detail.description_en:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.
Already got a spot picked out. If you get to [LOCATION] there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the [TARGET] and its escorts to pass by.
With a bonus of 16 Council Scrip for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
猎头帮在找能带队干票大的狠角色。有艘军用护卫舰带着小弟在星系里盯咱们金主，准没憋好屁。趁他们盯着肥肉时，咱找人组队抄他们后路。

埋伏点都选好了——去 [LOCATION] 那片辐射云后面猫着。带上兄弟关掉引擎，等 [AMBUSHTARGET] 和护航队经过就动手。

主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 ，光这点就够赚了，而且残骸里的破烂也归你。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 精英行动
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 伏击 ERT

detail.description_en:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.
Already got a spot picked out. If you get to [LOCATION] there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the [TARGET] and its escorts to pass by.
With a bonus of 16 Council Scrip for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
猎头帮在找能带队干票大的狠角色。有艘军用护卫舰带着小弟在星系里盯咱们金主，准没憋好屁。趁他们盯着肥肉时，咱找人组队抄他们后路。

埋伏点都选好了——去 [LOCATION] 那片辐射云后面猫着。带上兄弟关掉引擎，等 [AMBUSHTARGET] 和护航队经过就动手。

主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 ，光这点就够赚了，而且残骸里的破烂也归你。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Blinding Hope in trouble
WORK BRIEF:
We received a distress call from the Blinding Hope that said they were under attack from the Moraine again before they were cut off. I just want to know if they're okay. Head to their last known location and report what you find.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：炫目希望号有麻烦

工作简报：
我们收到了炫目希望号发出的求救信号，说他们在被切断联系前再次遭到了冰碛帮的攻击。我就想知道他们现在是否安全。赶紧前往他们最后的已知位置，并报告你发现的东西。

报酬：
确认全体成员状态后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
We're just putting the full picture together now, but so far we've learned that a Headhunter by the name of [TARGET] recently stole some sensitive data that if exposed will be detrimental to Citizens for Prosperity's cause.
We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at [LOCATION] as well as tracking down [TARGET] to stop them from further disseminating the information.
Your help is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们现在还在拼凑完整的情况，但到目前为止，我们了解到一名名为 [TARGETNAME] 的猎头帮成员最近窃取了一些敏感数据，如果曝光，将对繁荣公民的事业造成严重损害。

我们需要确保所有被盗数据的痕迹都被消除。这意味着要摧毁位于 [LOCATION] 的所有猎头帮服务器，并追踪 [TARGETNAME]，以阻止他们进一步传播这些信息。

非常感谢你的帮助，利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: [LOCATION]
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Capital Ship
Briefing: An outlaw fleet lead by [TARGET] has been planning a potentially devastating strike against sensitive UEE targets. InterSec has been tasked with dealing with this threat before their attack can be launched.
After putting together a fighting force of your own, head to the site and engage with the hostiles there. Their leader will not risk entering into the fray themselve unless they feel their operation is suitably at risk. Stay at the site and take out hostile targets, until you can engage with the groups leader directly and put a stop to this heinous attack once and for all.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：[LOCATION]
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：主力舰级飞船
任务简报：一支由 [TARGETNAME] 率领的不法分子舰队正密谋对重要 UEE 目标发动一场可能毁灭性的打击。互安防务已受命在袭击发起前彻底消除该威胁。

请自行组建作战力量，前往指定地点与敌方交战。其首领通常不会亲自参战，除非判断行动严重受挫。请坚守现场，持续清除敌方目标，直至直接对峙并击毙该首领，彻底终结此次暴行。

此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守相关星系的法律。

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.
If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.
The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.
Hope to hear from you soon,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

如果你有的话，首先需要你去完成一份临时嫌犯逮捕合约。与其说是评断，其实更像是次机会，来确保我们能有良好的共事关系。

你要找的嫌犯名叫 [TARGETNAME]。他们可是出了名的难以捉摸，所以对你来说会有些困难。

希望尽快收到你的消息，

布雷登·科查多

detail.description_en:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.
If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we are looking for anyone with combat experience to help secure [LOCATION] that has been taken over by a group of outlaws.
We've tried to work with them but have only been met with violence and threats.
Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

我们曾试图与他们合作，但只遭遇了暴力和威胁。

利玛·恩迪科特

Contractors are employed on a strictly freelance basis. Foxwell expects contractors to supply their own weapons and armor and does not accept any responsibility for any injuries, damages, or deaths accumulated during the contract.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

missions.name_zh: 大规模维修需求：[LOCATION]

detail.description_en:
We need some help. The CFP facility at [LOCATION] suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.
Surveying the site, you'll have to bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Do you think you can help?
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们需要协助。位于 [LOCATION] 的繁荣公民设施在近期雷暴中严重受损，现寻求能协助维修的人员。

现场勘查显示，需携带 六个保险丝、一个 打捞工具，以及 足够处理约八根管道的 RMC 罐。这些物资应足以修复损伤并使前哨站恢复运作。

如需维修工作详情，请查阅 mobiGlas 日志中 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

你能伸出援手吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

missions.name_zh: 大规模维修需求：Chawla's Beach

detail.description_en:
We need some help. The CFP facility at [LOCATION] suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.
Surveying the site, you'll have to bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Do you think you can help?
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们需要协助。位于 [LOCATION] 的繁荣公民设施在近期雷暴中严重受损，现寻求能协助维修的人员。

现场勘查显示，需携带 六个保险丝、一个 打捞工具，以及 足够处理约八根管道的 RMC 罐。这些物资应足以修复损伤并使前哨站恢复运作。

如需维修工作详情，请查阅 mobiGlas 日志中 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

你能伸出援手吗？

利玛·恩迪科特

detail.description_en:
Hi,
So I had a contractor who was supposed to deliver some stuff for us but has completely gone off the radar. I've pinged their ship and I've got no idea what's happened but they're floating around somewhere over at [LOCATION]. If you could head over there recover the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] you'd be doing me a huge favor.
Don't forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam to move all the cargo. Oh and a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

detail.description_en:
Hi,
So I had a contractor who was supposed to deliver some stuff for us but has completely gone off the radar. I've pinged their ship and I've got no idea what's happened but they're floating around somewhere over at [LOCATION]. If you could head over there recover the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] you'd be doing me a huge favor.
Don't forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam to move all the cargo. Oh and a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Extra Special Job
WORK BRIEF:
You've been doing some excellent work for us lately and wanted to offer a special job with a special reward. I'm looking for some more data, so I need someone to scan [RESOURCES] and send me what you find. [RARITY]
By this point you know what you're doing but just going to remind you that the United Resource Workers' mining journal on your mobi is great if you're stuck.
Let me know if you’re up for it.
PAYMENT:
Polished up a special Drake Golem from Teach's for this one.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：额外特别任务

工作简报：
你最近为我们做了很多出色的工作，所以想给你安排一个特别的任务，还有特别的奖励。我需要更多数据，所以需要有人去扫描 [RESOURCES]，并把找到的东西发给我。[RARITY]

另外，如果你不了解或者刚接触采矿，联合资源工人协会写了一本很有用的指南，你应该去看看。它就在你的手环里。

如果你愿意，请告诉我。

报酬：
这次我特意从蒂奇那里搞到了一台改良过的特别的德雷克魔像。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
This a simple seek and destroy contract. The client has requested that several servers located at an ASD research site be destroyed as soon as possible. Under no circumstances should these servers be accessed, or copies of the data made.
The client believes that the servers are somewhere in the Engineering wing, most likely in the Management area. In addition to this, there is a strong chance you won’t be the only presence on-site so be wary of potential hostiles.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
detail.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：摧毁服务器
授权代码 = VS-14

需要立即处理

这是一个简单的搜索与摧毁合约。客户要求尽快销毁位于联合科学与开发公司(ASD)研究站点的几台服务器。在任何情况下，这些服务器都不应被访问，也不应复制其中的数据。

客户认为这些服务器位于工程翼楼的某个地方，很可能在管理区。除此之外，现场很可能不止你一个人，因此请警惕潜在的敌对势力。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

missions.name_zh: 完成玲家快递被中断的运输
name_notes_zh: 玲家快递 - 取回货物 非常简单 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?
Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send you the creds.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

事情是这样的，我们一个运输员在 [LOCATION] 那儿出了状况，船直接被放弃了。你能过去帮我们把这单货送完吗？

活儿不算大，但你还是得带个重型牵引光束，再开艘能塞下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船。

货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿就行，我们立马把报酬打给你。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?
Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send you the creds.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.name_zh: 完成任务
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 取回货物 MRT

detail.description_en:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at [LOCATION]. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.
If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.
If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们的一名飞行员本应该把一批货带回，但看起来他在 [LOCATION] 那儿出了点麻烦。要么他的脑袋被炸得满驾驶舱都是，要么吓得把船扔掉了。为了他着想，希望只是第一种情况，这样我就不用去追杀那个混蛋了。现在最重要的是，我们的货还在那儿。

如果你有重型牵引光束和一艘不错的飞船，能过去把我们的货弄回来吗？袭击我飞行员的那些混蛋很可能还在那儿，而且他们肯定不好对付。

要是你能活着回来，把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我就给你报酬。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 完成任务
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 取回货物 MRT

detail.description_en:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at [LOCATION]. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.
If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.
If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll get you paid.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们的一名飞行员本应该把一批货带回，但看起来他在 [LOCATION] 那儿出了点麻烦。要么他的脑袋被炸得满驾驶舱都是，要么吓得把船扔掉了。为了他着想，希望只是第一种情况，这样我就不用去追杀那个混蛋了。现在最重要的是，我们的货还在那儿。

如果你有重型牵引光束和一艘不错的飞船，能过去把我们的货弄回来吗？袭击我飞行员的那些混蛋很可能还在那儿，而且他们肯定不好对付。

要是你能活着回来，把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我就给你报酬。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at [LOCATION] and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with a heavy-duty tractor beam to grab the cargo and finish the job.
They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.
If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?
Take it to the freight elevator over at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
我一个运输船在 [LOCATION] 出事了，船被迫弃了，得有人带重型牵引光束过去把货捞回来，这事得赶紧了结。

那船上带着我一批不错的装备，我可不想让哪个“圣母”捡了去，然后顺藤摸瓜找到咱头上。

要是碰上人，别跟他们套近乎，直接干掉那混蛋，拿上货走人，明白？

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，卖了钱我分你一份。

- 刺痛

detail.description_en:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.
Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at [LOCATION].
Grab a crew you can trust and your heavy-duty tractor beam and get your ass over there.
After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in [DESTINATION]. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
咱们有点情况，一帮名不见经传的小混混，想靠劫咱们的运输船出名，以为抢几艘货船就能当老大，真当自己是个人物了。一群菜鸡。

问题是，他们上次运气好，咱的飞行员差点没命逃出来，但他们的船还停在 [LOCATION]，装满着物资。

挑几个信得过的兄弟，带上你的重型牵引光束，然后赶紧给我滚过去。

搞到货之后，直接送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，这事办成了，我分你一大笔。

- 刺痛

missions.name_zh: 了结工作
name_notes_zh: 死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 VLRT

detail.description_en:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.
Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at [LOCATION].
Grab a crew you can trust and your heavy-duty tractor beam and get your ass over there.
After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in [DESTINATION]. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
咱们有点情况，一帮名不见经传的小混混，想靠劫咱们的运输船出名，以为抢几艘货船就能当老大，真当自己是个人物了。一群菜鸡。

问题是，他们上次运气好，咱的飞行员差点没命逃出来，但他们的船还停在 [LOCATION]，装满着物资。

挑几个信得过的兄弟，带上你的重型牵引光束，然后赶紧给我滚过去。

搞到货之后，直接送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，这事办成了，我分你一大笔。

- 刺痛

detail.description_en:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.
If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we need a package picked up from [LOCATION] and taken to [DESTINATION].
Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

如果你正在星系中寻找工作，并希望帮助实现我们的目标，那么我们需要你从 [LOCATION] 取走一个包裹，并送到 [DESTINATION]。

完成后，我们可以为你提供在这个星系及其他地方的多种新工作机会。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

missions.name_zh: 收集受辐射的瓦拉卡獠牙

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are dedicating all our energy to stopping the regeneration technology crisis in its tracks, but to continue their efforts our scientists need materials that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.
Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar fangs, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have uncovered the existence of a qualifying population inside the storm near [LOCATION].
Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is offering premium pay to anyone who can assist with collecting the fangs.
Once attained, please take these valuable resources to [DESTINATION].
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正全力以赴阻止重生技术危机的进一步恶化，但我们的科学家需要一些公司供应商无法获取的材料，以继续他们的研究工作。

拉亚利正在寻找有经验的承包商来收集 受辐射的瓦拉卡獠牙，这些獠牙可以从长期暴露在辐射下的成年瓦拉卡身上提取。我们的扫描发现，在靠近 [LOCATION] 的风暴中有一批符合条件的种群。

由于这些动物极其危险，拉亚利为任何能够协助收集獠牙的人提供高额报酬。

一旦收集完成，请将这些珍贵资源送到 [DESTINATION]。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

missions.name_zh: 把我的东西拿回来
name_notes_zh: 死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 MRT

detail.description_en:
A couple of hours ago I was supposed to receive a shipment of gear from a pilot of mine. I don’t like late, so I need you to head to their location and recover my stuff. I’ve got trackers on the packages so they should be easy enough to find.
My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to [DESTINATION] for me and I’ll wire you the creds.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
几个小时前，我本应该收到一名飞行员运送的物资。我不喜欢迟到，所以你需要前往他们的那里把我的东西取回来。我已经给包裹安装了追踪器，应该很容易找到。

我的直觉告诉我飞行员可能遭遇了不测。他们很擅长驾驶飞船，所以袭击他们的那些不法分子应该也挺厉害的。等你把我的三个包裹取回来，把它们送到 [DESTINATION]，我会把报酬转给你。

-刺痛

detail.description_en:
IN-GAME ALSO SHOWN AS
Stash Retrieval
Cleaning Up a Mess
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.
Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at [LOCATION] ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at [DESTINATION] for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
要想把事儿办漂亮，就得亲力亲为。这话他们常挂在嘴边，对吧？可惜我没那闲工夫，毕竟生意还得照做。

有些货被人弄丢了，我得找个承包商帮我收拾烂摊子。听说 [LOCATION] 那儿的人把我一个手下给干掉了，顺手牵走了咱们的装备。我要你去把那东西抢回来，搞定现场的所有人，然后把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的交货点给我。这事儿办妥了，钱我立马给你结清。

- 刺痛

missions.name_zh: 取回我们的货物

detail.description_en:
We’ve been using the old Hathor [LOCATION1] and [LOCATION2] as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.
Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] where we should be able to keep it on ice.
Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store 32 SCU at the very least.
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们一直在使用旧的哈索尔 [LOCATION1] 和 [LOCATION2] 作为藏货点，但结果发现一些过于热心的没脑子家伙找到了它们，还试图把我们的东西偷走。

幸运的是，货物现在还在那儿——暂时的。我们需要有人去那个平台校准设施和轨道激光平台，从货运电梯上拿走我们的东西，然后把它送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯上，我们应该能把它保管好。

这是需要拿的货物清单。顺序随你，无所谓。确保你带一艘至少能存放 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 集装箱的飞船。

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

确保你准备好应对任何碰到的混蛋。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.
Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION] and take it to [DESTINATION]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.
Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.
-Bit Zeros
detail.description_zh:
今天早些时候我们本该收到一个挺重要的包裹，结果飞行员直接跑路了，还把追踪芯片给撬了，挺机灵是吧？其实没那么聪明，因为他们忘了把飞行记录仪一块儿带走。

去 [LOCATION] 的残骸里把黑匣子捞出来，然后送到 [DESTINATION]，你干完活儿我们立马把酬金发你。

对了，小心点垃圾佬，现在这年头大家都快饿疯了，哪怕只是艘报废的快递船，也有人敢下手。

- 零比特

missions.name_zh: 让他们得到报应
name_notes_zh: 死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 VHRT

detail.description_en:
I got a situation I need dealing with pronto. A rival crew has intercepted a major shipment of gear I was expecting and all hell is breaking loose. The pilot’s ghosted, the ship’s busted, and it’s only a matter of time before they take my shit and leave. If you’re up for cracking these assholes, head to [LOCATION] and get my five packages.
Head’s up though, the pilot they ghosted was one of my best, so this crew’s got to be seriously kitted out. Bring your finest mates with you and show the bastards no mercy. Understood?
When you’re done, take the gear to [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you get a serious cut of the takings.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
我有个紧急情况需要处理。一个竞争对手的团队截获了我正在等待的一批重要物资，现在一片混乱。飞行员失踪了，飞船也毁了，他们很快就会拿走我的东西然后离开。如果你愿意对付这些混蛋，就前往 [LOCATION] 取回我的五个包裹。

不过要提醒你，那个失踪的飞行员是我最得力的成员之一，所以这个对手团队肯定装备精良。带上你最厉害的伙伴们，别给他们任何机会。明白了吗？

完成后，把装备送到 [DESTINATION]，我会确保你得到丰厚的报酬。

-刺痛

missions.name_zh: 幽灵行动 [TARGET]

detail.description_en:
Can’t believe how many criminals are crawling around this damn system. Guess we’ll have to make some room for ourselves.
Got a list of high-level leaders here. Nothing brings chaos and disorder to the existing gangs like a good decapitation attack. The next target is [TARGET], who we’ve tracked to [LOCATION]. Feel like ghosting ‘em?
These old Hathor platform facilities are big and spread out. Doubt there’s a way to do this and not attract the attention of their foot soldiers. Ain’t gonna be easy but sure sounds like fun.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
真不敢相信这个该死的星系里有这么多罪犯。看来我们得为自己腾出一些空间。

这里有一份高层领导的名单。没有什么比一次完美的斩首行动更能给现有帮派带来混乱和无序了。下一个目标是 [TARGETNAME]，我们已经追踪到他们在 [LOCATION]。想要悄无声息地解决他们吗？

这些老旧的哈索尔平台设施又大又分散。估计还是有办法做到这一点而不引起他们小弟的注意。虽然不容易，但听起来确实很有趣。

-斯托斯

name_notes_zh: 零比特 - 飞船抢劫 MRT

detail.description_en:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them?
But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you.
Guess their loss will be our gain too.
57 65 65 76 69 6c
detail.description_zh:
你可能会想，如果有人在策划一次大抢劫，他们不会把所有细节留在任何人都能黑进来的光谱上吧？

但嘿，他们的损失就是你的收获。目前，一艘重型货船被锁在一个小行星基地的机库里。进入的唯一方法是通过站内的电梯。进去之后，你就可以使用控制台覆盖锁定，把所有东西拿出来。我们很乐意把坐标卖给你，但剩下的就靠你了。

看来他们的损失能让我们也赚不少。

57 65 65 76 69 6c

detail.description_en:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named [TARGET] who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at [LOCATION] who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. [TARGET] is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.
Again, whenever we've tried to take out [TARGET], they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.
Good luck.
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
我的老板们传来消息，我们要清算旧账。我有一个关于这个老牌杀手 [TARGETNAME] 的线索，他的杀人名单可不小。我们得知他和一些对我们不太友好的人藏在 [LOCATION] 那里，所以他们可能不会对你太友好。[TARGETNAME] 是我们的目标，但你可能得和他们一群人打起来。

再说一次，每次我们试图处理 [TARGETNAME] 时，他们都会杀掉杀他们的杀手。我觉得你会表现得更好，但如果有后援的话，最好带上。

祝你好运。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 碾压愣头青
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 轰炸 VLRT

detail.description_en:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.
Head to [LOCATION] and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:
猎头帮可不是靠装好人混到今天的。我们盯上了一群不知天高地厚的愣头青，他们正试图入侵我们的地盘。得让他们长长记性。

去 [LOCATION] 把他们的燃料罐给炸个稀烂。等他们的飞船全趴窝的时候，再想插手咱们的生意就得好好掂量掂量了。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

detail.description_en:
The maintenance and reliable function of [LOCATION] is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting [OBJECTS] there.
Protecting the site, and any friendly ships, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some reliable backup along when you go and terminate these nullbrains.
To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 6 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.
- Stow
detail.description_zh:
[LOCATION] 的维护和可靠运行对猎头帮来说可是相当重要，但这伙死对头却铁了心要把它踢出局。他们现在就在现场，正冲着那里的 [OBJECTS] 下手。

保护这个据点以及周边的友方飞船至关重要，所以我让你去干掉这些脑残家伙时，务必带上一些可靠的支援。

为了证明我们对此事绝不姑息，只要主承包商能确保万无一失，就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

The maintenance and reliable function of [LOCATION] is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting [OBJECTS] there.
Protecting the site, and any friendly ships, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some reliable backup along when you go and terminate these nullbrains.
To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn 6 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.
- Stow

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: An operator working with InterSec is currently being attacked by Vanduul ships at [LOCATION]. The likelihood of them surviving on their own is low, so we’re looking for a contractor willing to provide combat support.
Contractors accepting this mission should be well supplied and ready to face the Vanduul threat head-on.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：一名与互安防务合作的特工目前正在 [LOCATION] 遭遇剜度飞船的攻击，他们靠自己战斗生还的可能性很低，因此我们正在寻找愿意提供战斗支援的承包商。

接受此任务的承包商必须装备充足，并准备好正面迎战剜度威胁。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

missions.name_zh: 运输请求

detail.description_en:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION] and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.
Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry 4 SCU cargo containers. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.
- Stows out
detail.description_zh:
你为我们做得很好，所以我还想请你帮个忙。钱我还是会付给你的，但这算是个帮忙。有些物资需要从 [LOCATION] 运送到 [DESTINATION]，而原本负责的人站错了气闸的另一边，但嘿，事情还是得做。

唯一的问题是你需要一艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 个货物集装箱的飞船。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

如果你能帮我解决这个，那就太好了。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
A distress call just came in from [LOCATION] claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.
Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
来自 [LOCATION] 的求救信号刚刚传来，声称一支庞大的猎头帮部队刚刚袭击了我们在那里设立的前哨站。已经有多人在逃离现场时遇难和受伤。我们正在寻找任何有空的安保人员前往那里夺回前哨站。

目击者的描述将袭击者识别为精英猎头帮执法者，所以在外面要小心，如果可以的话，带上支援。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
You busy? A promising prospect was doing a special run for me but ran into trouble with the People’s Alliance around [LOCATION]. This one’s on me. Knew they weren’t the best dogfighter but thought they could do this without running into any other ships.
Told ‘em to hold tight and do everything they can to stay alive until support gets there. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for someone with your skillset.
-Stows

我让他们坚持住，尽一切可能活下来，直到支援到来。以你的能力，应该不会太难。

-斯托斯

detail.description_en:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [LOCATION] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.
Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
刚收到消息，附近的 [LOCATION] 有个猎头帮成员卷入了战斗，现在他们无法应对。那个傻瓜想让我来救他。

我想我真是个软心肠，因为我实际上会付钱让你帮我做这件事。你觉得怎么样？想救个傻瓜的命吗？


- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 猎头帮飞行员需要帮一把

detail.description_en:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [LOCATION]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.
They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?
- Stows out
detail.description_zh:
看起来有些新手想通过袭击在 [LOCATION] 附近的猎头帮飞船来插手我们的业务。真不明白他们怎么想能逃得掉。

他们需要通过痛苦的教训来明白，在派罗可不是这么回事。你愿意过去给这些家伙上一课吗？

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

我的一名飞行员没考虑清楚，结果在 [LOCATION] 惹上了一堆麻烦。

name_notes_zh: 繁荣公民 - 击杀飞船 VLRT 多波次

detail.description_en:
Recently we've had incident reports of numerous Citizens for Prosperity contractors in the system having run-ins with an outlaw hunting party operating out of [LOCATION].
To help re-establish safer routes through that sector, you will be dispatched to head there and engage with these outlaws. The group is known to travel in smaller packs, so its important that you and whatever backup you bring wait in the area to deal with all of them or else there's a chance the threat will remain.
Thank you for helping us,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
近期我们接到多起报告，称星系内多名繁荣公民承包商在行动中遭遇一支以 [LOCATION] 为据点的不法分子狩猎队。

为协助恢复该星区的安全航线，现派遣你前往该地，与这些不法分子交战。该团伙惯以小股编队行动，因此，你及所携支援力量务必在该区域驻守，直至全部敌对目标全部清除，否则威胁仍有可能存在。

感谢您的协助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to [LOCATION] are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops.
There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.
The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.
Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus 7 Council Scrip.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
收到消息说，猎头帮的飞船在前往 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 的路上遭到了攻击。扫描显示，附近区域有敌对势力正打算对我们下手。

敌人数量不少，单靠一个人可搞不定这群垃圾。如果你能带上装备，再叫上几个朋友，那就真的帮大忙了。

具体的攻击地点和目标可能会随时变化，现在别管那些细节了。你先赶过去，我会告诉你需要去哪里支援。

只要处理得好，我会给主要承包人额外加个奖金：[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 保卫飞船 人民联盟 VLRT

detail.description_en:
Guess some folks just can’t dogfight. Sent a young prospect out on patrol, and am now being barraged with comms about how they’re barely hanging on. Had them update me with the details about who they’re up against and I damn near fell outta my chair laughing.
If this kid can’t handle a People’s Alliance ship, they sure ain’t ready for flight assignments. Appreciate it if you could save their hide anyway.
If you’re free, could you head over to [LOCATION] and show ‘em how it’s done?
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
看来有些人就是不擅长战斗机战斗。我派了一个新手去巡逻，现在收到的通讯信息全是他们怎么勉强撑着的。我让他们把对手的情况告诉我，我差点笑得从椅子上摔下来。

如果这孩子连人民联盟的飞船都对付不了，那他们肯定还没准备好执行飞行任务。如果你能帮他们摆脱麻烦，就太感谢了。

如果你有空，能去 [LOCATION] 给他们示范一下该怎么做吗？

-斯托斯

detail.description_en:
Got word that outlaws are attempting to overrun [LOCATION]. There’s local security forces there, but they’re struggling to stop that attack.
Need a contractor to hustle there and help take care of the aggressors. Bring plenty of gear, and be careful when engaging targets. Don’t want to hear about any security team members getting caught in your crossfire.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
收到消息，不法分子正试图攻占 [LOCATION]。那里有当地的安保部队，但他们在阻止这次攻击方面遇到了困难。

需要一名承包商赶到那里，帮助处理这些侵略者。带上充足的装备，并在与目标交战时要小心。可不想听到任何安保小组成员被卷入交火中。

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Got a transport in need of backup over at [LOCATION]. Signal was patchy, but their comms made it sound like a group of outlaws had gotten wind of what they were hauling and attempted to take it from them.

missions.name_zh: 高风险赏金：[TARGET]

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. [TARGET] was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at [LOCATION]. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.
Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that [TARGET] will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out [TARGET] to face you directly.
Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
detail.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：赏金
授权代码 = [APPROVAL_CODE]

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Recently, we sent a contractor after a [TARGET], who was leading a crew targeting the operations of an extremely important client. Unfortunately, it was a trap and we lost some good people. We can’t let the target get away again, so we’ve decided the best course of action is to give them a dose of their own medicine.
Ambushing this target seems like the safest course of action, and we’ve identified a good spot for such an attack. There’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that the target and their crew frequently fly by. You can power down your ship and hide there until you’re ready to strike. This crew is ruthless and extremely skilled. Don’t make the same mistake as the previous contractor and go this alone. It would be best for you to bring a few trusted friends to help handle this crew.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. Plus, we’ll throw in a bonus payment of 16 MG Scrip for the main contractor for taking care of this.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

detail.description_en:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.
A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.
Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.
This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
这些异种威胁的杂种就像是蟑螂。每当你以为彻底消灭他们时，他们又会顷刻复生。看样子，他们又回到了往日的疯狂，正试图策划一些大事。具体是什么我们不得而知，但肯定是一场混乱，因此我们已获得许可，在事情发生之前予以制止。

据说一群异种威胁的高层正在 [LOCATION] 秘密会面，计划或发泄情绪，或者做其他事情，但我们打算捣毁这个聚会。或者，由你来完成。

前往那里，消灭你遇到的所有人。没错，我敢肯定那些大人物会参与进战斗，这是他们一贯的做法。

这将会很艰难。尽管我讨厌异种威胁，但他们在战斗中确实很厉害，所以要小心，如果可以的话带上帮手。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.
A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.
Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.
This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
这些异种威胁的杂种就像是蟑螂。每当你以为彻底消灭他们时，他们又会顷刻复生。看样子，他们又回到了往日的疯狂，正试图策划一些大事。具体是什么我们不得而知，但肯定是一场混乱，因此我们已获得许可，在事情发生之前予以制止。

据说一群异种威胁的高层正在 [LOCATION] 秘密会面，计划或发泄情绪，或者做其他事情，但我们打算捣毁这个聚会。或者，由你来完成。

前往那里，消灭你遇到的所有人。没错，我敢肯定那些大人物会参与进战斗，这是他们一贯的做法。

这将会很艰难。尽管我讨厌异种威胁，但他们在战斗中确实很厉害，所以要小心，如果可以的话带上帮手。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near [LOCATION]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.
Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们的一名成员偶然发现了一群异种威胁藏身在靠近 [LOCATION] 的前哨站。不确定他们是扎根在此还是只是路过，但我们想在他们行动之前先发制人。

如果你有人的话，最好带上，因为异种威胁可不好对付。赶快去，让他们知道在这个星系里谁才是掌控者。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 猎一些头
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 ERT

detail.description_en:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?
See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.
I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.
Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
有群杂碎想把咱们挤出星系。想不想给他们点颜色瞧瞧？

听着，有些人真的不希望我们在这待着，他们已经开始派出五到七艘船的猎杀小队，通常还会有一艘火力更强的大型战舰，跑到我们正在建立势力的地方搞事情。是时候让他们知道，我们可不是好惹的。

我在 HUD 上标记了一个位置标记，串起了几个地点，这些地方是我们遭遇敌对行为最频繁的区域。需要你去每个地方扫描一下，看看能不能引诱他们出来干一架。

我知道这任务不容易，所以别太自信想着单干。如果我是你，我会至少带上三个朋友来帮忙。为了让你觉得值，所以答应给完成任务的主承包商额外 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 猎一些头
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 ERT

detail.description_en:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?
See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.
I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.
Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of 16 Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
有群杂碎想把咱们挤出星系。想不想给他们点颜色瞧瞧？

听着，有些人真的不希望我们在这待着，他们已经开始派出五到七艘船的猎杀小队，通常还会有一艘火力更强的大型战舰，跑到我们正在建立势力的地方搞事情。是时候让他们知道，我们可不是好惹的。

我在 HUD 上标记了一个位置标记，串起了几个地点，这些地方是我们遭遇敌对行为最频繁的区域。需要你去每个地方扫描一下，看看能不能引诱他们出来干一架。

我知道这任务不容易，所以别太自信想着单干。如果我是你，我会至少带上三个朋友来帮忙。为了让你觉得值，所以答应给完成任务的主承包商额外 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: ICC 特快专递
name_notes_zh: 玲家快递 - 投递 特别

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Not sure if you ever heard of them, but a rep from the ICC (they make starmaps and study space for the empire) just reached out to us about a special job they need picked up from Wikelo's Emporium.
Kind of surprised to be honest that they having any dealings there since that Banu's trading-post doesn't exactly scream "cutting-edge science" to me.
Anyway, they want the delivery brought from there to [DESTINATION]. They also emphasized that the cargo's very delicate so make sure that you use kid gloves when you're handling it, okay? (Not that you aren't careful normally, but you know how clients are.)
Be sure to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store 1 SCU cargo.
Thanks,
Conni Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

不知道你有没有听说过他们，但 ICC（他们为帝国绘制星图并研究太空）的一位代表刚刚联系我们，委托我们从维科洛百货接一件特殊的工作。

老实说，有点惊讶他们居然会和那里有业务往来，毕竟那个巴努人的贸易站对我来说完全不像是什么“尖端科学”的地方。

无论如何，他们要求将货物从那里运送到 [DESTINATION]。他们还强调货物非常精密，所以你在处理时一定要格外小心，好吗？（不是说你平时不小心，只是你知道的，客户那套嘛。）

务必携带一把 重型牵引光束 以及一艘拥有足够空间存放 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸货物的飞船。

感谢，
康妮·玲
货运协调员
玲家快递

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Our client has requested the immediate destruction of a group of servers located at a long-shuttered ASD research site. The servers in question contain information that our client considers extremely damaging and is eager to see the data completely eliminated.
Initial surveillance indicates the servers are within the facility’s Energy Lab, located in the Research wing. We’ve also picked up on a number of hostile forces, so be on alert.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
detail.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：摧毁服务器
授权代码 = VS-14

需要立即处理

我们的客户要求立即销毁一组位于早已关闭的联合科学与开发公司(ASD)研究站点的服务器。这些服务器包含客户认为极其有害的信息，他们迫切希望彻底清除这些数据。

初步侦察显示，这些服务器位于设施内研究翼楼的能源实验室中。我们还发现了一些敌对势力，因此请保持警惕。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

missions.name_zh: 囚犯维修工作机会

detail.description_en:
Hello Guests,
We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.
We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.
Thank you.
detail.description_zh:
各位“客人”，

我们最近接到警报，有一个补氧站出现技术故障。你知道的，这些补氧站是用来确保你们在参与我们的劳动减刑计划时能有充足的氧气而设置的。

我们需要一位“客人”去重置补氧站。那会把补氧站重连到网络并且解决这个问题。作为第一个吃螃蟹的人，你不仅会得到功绩点奖励，更会为其他人的工作奠定安全的基础。

谢谢。

missions.name_zh: 强力根除行动
name_notes_zh: 高境荒野 - 击杀动物 HRT 多物种

detail.description_en:
Native plants and animals near [LOCATION] are on the verge of environmental collapse due to the dramatic population spikes of several invasive species. We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.
You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.
Best,
Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
detail.description_zh:
由于几种入侵物种数量的剧增，[LOCATION] 附近的本土植物和动物正面临环境崩溃的边缘。我们已被委托大幅减少这些物种的当前数量，以帮助避免环境崩溃。我们需要一位专注且技术高超的“终结者”来执行这个合约。

你可以通过在你的日志中参考《斯坦顿野生动物指南》，更好地了解这些生物。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

detail.description_en:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.
One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.
Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.
Fly safe out there,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
边境生活艰难，每一次给我们定居者的补给都至关重要，今年我们真的不能再有更多损失了。

在 [LOCATION] 有位我们的关键供应商遭到一伙不法分子袭击，此后便彻底失联。我担心最坏的情况已经发生，但如果还能抢回他们当时运输的物资，那将意义重大。

袭击他们的不法分子很可能仍潜伏在附近，务必提高警惕。等你清理掉他们后，尽快取走货物，并运送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。请确保你驾驶的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，同时务必配备一把 重型牵引光束。

祝你在那飞行平安，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari Incorporated is looking for independent contractors to provide additional support in our efforts to push the boundaries of science, agriculture, and medicine in the Empire and beyond.
A research initiative at [DESTINATION] is in desperate need of resources, so we are looking for a reliable contractor to obtain and deliver these crucial components.
For more information on the materials in question, refer to "A Forager's Guide" in your Journal.
Rayari offers competitive wages along with the knowledge that you're building a better universe.
Let’s grow together,
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
拉亚利公司正在寻找独立承包商，为我们在帝国及其他地区推动科学、农业和医学发展的努力提供额外支持。

位于 [DESTINATION] 的一项研究项目急需一些资源，因此我们正在寻找可靠的承包商来获取并交付这些关键成分。

有关这些材料的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《觅食者指南》。

拉亚利提供具有竞争力的薪酬，并让您知道您正在为构建一个更美好的宇宙贡献力量。

让我们携手共进，

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 取回货物 HRT

detail.description_en:
Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.
The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at [LOCATION]. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.
Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your heavy-duty tractor beam of course.

missions.name_zh: 约里特卷宗：访问工程文档

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
From the personnel files recovered at the Onyx Facility, we have now learned that Dr. Jorrit has recently visited the site and accessed files while there. The next step will be to follow this lead and try to learn exactly what Dr. Jorrit was doing in his old lab.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files.
Additional Notes:
I've found a work around for the QT issue so you'll be able to travel directly to the site from now on.
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
从玛瑙设施找到的人事档案中，我们得知约里特博士最近曾到访过该地点，并在那儿访问了一些文档。接下来的任务是顺着这条线索，查清楚约里特博士在他的旧实验室里到底做了些什么。

合约调查员的行动：
探索工程翼楼并获取约里特博士近期的文件。

补充说明：
我已经找到了一个解决量子航行问题的办法，所以从现在开始你可以直接航行那个地点了。

小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

missions.name_zh: 约里特卷宗：玛瑙人事档案

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist Dr. Logan Jorrit. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered Onyx Facility where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist. Once there, locate and access the research lab’s personnel files so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.
Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.
While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.
I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there.
Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
一位客户请求霍克罗事务所为臭名昭著的科学家洛根·约里特博士编纂一份完整的卷宗。洛根博士被认为对发生在联合科学与开发公司拉撒路站点的事件负有责任，客户迫切希望更全面地了解洛根博士及其研究内容。

合约调查员的行动：
进入 ASD 已经关闭的玛瑙设施，洛根博士曾是该设施的首席科学家。到达后，找到并访问研究实验室的人事档案，以便我们能大致了解那里曾经发生的事情。

补充说明：
当设施断电时，通往该地点的量子航行信标也被停用了，所以你得手动驾驶飞船飞完最后一段路程。

虽然 ASD 已正式关闭该设施，但仍需保持警惕。不仅实验室本身可能存在危险，周围区域也显示出近期有人活动的迹象。可能会有拾荒者或擅闯人员在现场。

此外，我设法为你搞到了一个员工 ID 代码，只要你在执行任务，就能访问那里的电脑。

还有，玛瑙设施只有大型机库可用，因此请合理规划你的行程。

The seismic data you extracted had some interesting revelations. My expert says she thinks that Jorrit might have been excavating down there. detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his lab notes to your mobiGlas journal once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.
The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a Reagent code from the Engineering wing and a Catalyst code from the Research wing.
Once you have those, head down to the Lab in Site-B and run the experiment so you can upload the results.
Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
你在玛瑙设施的深入调查终于有了收获。我已确认乔里特一直在站点-B 秘密运营着一个未登记的实验室，进行他称之为“海伯利安项目”的实验。等你出发后，我会把他的实验笔记发送到你的 mobiGlas 日志中，简单来说，这个混蛋想让人类进化，或者诸如此类的荒唐事。

客户需要这些实验数据，所以你得重返玛瑙设施，完成一切必要步骤，启动“海伯利安项目”。

合约调查员的行动：
先去工程区获取反应物代码，再去研究区获取催化剂代码，为实验做好准备。

拿到代码后，前往站点-B 的实验室，运行实验，然后上传实验结果。

补充说明：
由于这是个仍在运作的实验室，现场可能有联合科学与开发公司的安保人员。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
Reviewing Dr. Jorrit’s recent files that you uploaded to me left us with more questions than answers. While we know for a fact that the doctor had been inside Onyx, we don’t yet know the specifics of what he was doing. The client is eager for us to learn more about what exactly Jorrit’s up to, so I’m afraid you’re going to have to go back in.
I have a few ideas on how we might be able to use the facility’s systems to pinpoint Dr. Jorrit’s activities, though you’ll have to physically bring me the data this time so we can properly analyze it. First up, are the energy sensors in Engineering. They’re still active and sensitive enough to pick up any anomalous readings.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and retrieve the Energy Anomaly data and deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
detail.description_zh:

我有几个想法，或许可以利用设施的系统来精确定位约里特博士的活动。不过这次你得亲自把数据带回来，我们才能好好分析。首先，工程区的能量传感器还在运作，而且足够灵敏，能捕捉到任何异常读数。

missions.name_zh: 约里特卷宗：检索地震波数据

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
Thanks to that last batch of data you delivered, we’re starting to fill in the gaps on what Dr. Jorrit’s doing down there. Got a rough timeline of his activities. Seems he’s had more stuff coming into Onyx than going out which is interesting. We’re going to need more intel though. There’s an old experiment running down there that monitors minute seismic changes. If you can deliver that data to me, it’ll help us pinpoint some of the movement around the facility.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Research wing and retrieve the Seismic data and deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
多亏了你上次送来的

一旦你交出这些数据，我会给你发送一个ASD 安全驱动器，你可以在你的家园位置领取它们。数据，我们开始填补乔里特博士在那边干了什么的空白了。现在已经大致梳理出了他的活动时间线。看起来他往玛瑙运进来的东西比运出去的多，这挺有意思。不过我们还需要更多情报。那边有个老旧实验在持续地监测微小的地震波变化。如果你能把那些数据带给我，会帮助我们更准确地掌握设施周围的活动。

合约调查员的行动：
探索研究翼楼，检索地震波数据，并将其送到 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。
