首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
在持续调查中，最大的问题之一就是情报会变得过时。为了缓解这个问题，我打算让你重新进入玛瑙，获取最新的地震波传感器数据。看看最新的读数能告诉我们些什么，这会很有帮助。

合约调查员的行动：
探索研究翼楼，检索地震波数据，并将其送到 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

一旦你交出这些数据，我会给你发送一个ASD 安全驱动器，你可以在你的家园位置领取它们。

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION
The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.
NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: As your standing in the community continues to grow, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn a Journeyman Tracker License.
This license would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend High-Risk Targets (HRT). These criminals can travel in larger multicrew ships with several escorts. The additional offensive and defensive capabilities make them difficult targets for all but the most skilled guild members.
To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend a HRT ranked criminal by the name of [TARGET] last seen at [LOCATION].
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice
The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 8 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 8 SCU in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.
On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

detail.description_en:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that [LOCATION] is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4>. It won't stand.
Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including any friendly ships in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.
Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
不跟你啰嗦那些细节，但信我，[LOCATION] 对猎头帮来说至关重要。所以你知道当我听说那帮不知天高地厚的愣头青正疯狂骚扰他们、一心想把他们的 [OBJECTS] 给毁了时，我有多火大吗？这事儿没门！

赶紧过去，在一切被毁之前提供保护，包括周边任何需要帮忙的任何友方飞船。像这种脑残家伙，对你这种冉冉升起的新星来说应该算不上什么挑战吧。

把他们全给我收拾干净，谁接了这活儿，我就扔给他 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that [LOCATION] is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4>. It won't stand.
Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including any friendly ships in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.
Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
不跟你啰嗦那些细节，但信我，[LOCATION] 对猎头帮来说至关重要。所以你知道当我听说那帮不知天高地厚的愣头青正疯狂骚扰他们、一心想把他们的 [OBJECTS] 给毁了时，我有多火大吗？这事儿没门！

赶紧过去，在一切被毁之前提供保护，包括周边任何需要帮忙的任何友方飞船。像这种脑残家伙，对你这种冉冉升起的新星来说应该算不上什么挑战吧。

把他们全给我收拾干净，谁接了这活儿，我就扔给他 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 大批量科瓦莱什货物需要追回
name_notes_zh: 科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hi, it's El.
Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.
Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at [LOCATION] and bringing it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Really appreciate your help.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，我是艾拉。

这活儿得赶紧找人干，我们有个承包商突然有“私人紧急情况”，直接扔下飞船跑了，看样子是不打算回来了，够糟心的。

好消息是货还在，至少追踪器上显示没丢。你能赶去 [LOCATION] 把货捞回来，再送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿吗，那对我来说真是帮大忙了！

这单子挺大的，你得开艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船，还得配把重型牵引光束才搬得动。真谢谢你啦！

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

name_notes_zh: 科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hi, it's El.
Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.
Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at [LOCATION] and bringing it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Really appreciate your help.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，我是艾拉。

这活儿得赶紧找人干，我们有个承包商突然有“私人紧急情况”，直接扔下飞船跑了，看样子是不打算回来了，够糟心的。

好消息是货还在，至少追踪器上显示没丢。你能赶去 [LOCATION] 把货捞回来，再送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿吗，那对我来说真是帮大忙了！

这单子挺大的，你得开艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的船，还得配把重型牵引光束才搬得动。真谢谢你啦！

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

detail.description_en:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at [LOCATION] surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.
Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION] for us.
But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.
-Bit Zeros
detail.description_zh:
你听说没？[LOCATION] 那儿一堆船围着艘烧得只剩架子的飞船，知道为啥不？我们可好奇死了。你能不能溜进那堆废铁里，找到黑匣子再溜出来？事成之后我们付钱。

这地方到处都是不靠谱的家伙，你最好带几个帮手盯着后背，除非你真打算一个人单干——但咱还是希望你能活下来，好把黑匣子送到 [DESTINATION] 这儿来。

不过嘛，咋干你说了算，只要事儿能办成。

- 零比特

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Guess the folks at [DESTINATION] are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.
Here are the pick ups:
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]
Please remember to bring a handheld tractor beam, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to 8 SCU.
Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

我猜 [DESTINATION] 那帮人是打算要开派对，所以急着凑齐所有东西，你这单得跑好几趟，其中一趟能去尼克斯提点“金克斯金酒”——你没喝过吧？那可是尼克斯的招牌，有人嫌它粉嘟嘟地发光，但我超爱，就爱喝那一口独特的劲道。

以下是取货地点：

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

忘了带个手持式牵引光束，货箱最大尺寸有 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE]，光靠胳膊可搬不动。


运货顺利，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP65817
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
A client has hired the agency to look for a missing friend who has not been returning their comms and have been acting increasingly erratic. The client has shared all the information they possess on [TARGET] and we’ve been able to pinpoint their ship’s location.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to [LOCATION] and verify the status of [TARGET]. If they are deceased, examine their body and we will pass the information on to the client.
Additional Notes:
Our scout reported heavy outlaw activity in the vicinity and was forced to retreat, meaning we have designated this as a highly dangerous case.

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP51643
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Looking for an operative to confirm the status of a client. They and their partner missed a scheduled meeting and all attempts to contact them have proven in vain. Last we heard they were undertaking some business in [SYSTEM] and fear that they may be the victim of some unfortunate tragedy.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate [MISSINGPERSONLIST] at [LOCATION] and confirm their status.
If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.
Additional Notes:
Be cautious while conducting your search. If the client did meet harm, it would be unfortunate for you to meet the same fate.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP51643
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
需一名行动人员确认某客户当前状态：该客户与其搭档未能如期赴约，且所有联络尝试均告失败。据最后消息，二人此前正在 [SYSTEM] 处理某项事务，我们担忧其或已遭遇不幸事件。

合约调查员的行动：
请前往 [LOCATION] 找到 [MISSINGPERSONLIST] 并确认其状态。

若他们已身亡，请仔细检查遗体，以便我们通过您的 mobiGlas 核实死亡情况。

补充说明：
搜索过程中请务必谨慎行事。若客户确已遇害，切勿重蹈覆辙，以免遭遇同样厄运。

Locate [MISSINGPERSONLIST] at [LOCATION] and confirm their status.

Additional Notes:
This investigation has high potential for there to be aggressive and dangerous hostiles on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bringing other skilled associates with you.

Case File #MP48597
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Looking for an operative to identify the status of a client’s missing partner. They lost contact with them abruptly during a comm call, so the client assumes the worst. We’re looking to provide them with some closure.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate [TARGET] at [LOCATION] and confirm their status.
If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.
Additional Notes:
The sector you're headed to is relatively quiet so I'm guessing that whatever did happen to [TARGET] it wasn't outlaws.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP48597
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
我们需要一名调查员来查明客户失踪合伙人的下落。据称在通话，他们突然失去了联系，因此客户担心最坏的情况。我们希望为他们提供一个明确的结论。

合约调查员的行动：
前往 [TARGETNAME]，位于 [LOCATION]，确认他们的状况。

如果他们已经死亡，请仔细检查尸体，以便我们通过你的mobiGlas设备核实他们的死亡。

补充说明：
你即将前往的区域相对平静，所以我猜对于 [TARGETNAME] 发生的任何事情都与不法分子无关。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP66432
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Need a skilled operator with combat experience to investigate the last known location of [TARGET]. Their employer hired us to look for they as they were carrying some highly valuable cargo, but the trackers have been disabled and the pilot is no longer responding.
We suspect that outlaws have attacked the ship and seized the cargo for themselves. The client has expressed that they consider the cargo lost but would like to know if the pilot is dead so they can inform their family.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Investigate [LOCATION] and locate the [TARGET]’s ship. If you are able to find the pilot’s body, confirm their status so we may inform the client.
Additional Notes:
Backup is highly recommended for this encounter.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP66432
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
我们需要一名具有战斗经验的熟练调查员来调查 [TARGETNAME] 的最后已知位置。他们的雇主雇佣我们去找他们，因为他们当时正在运送一些高价值的物资。但是追踪设备已被破坏，飞行员也失去了联系。

我们怀疑不法分子袭击了飞船并抢走了货物。客户表示他们认为货物已经丢失，但希望知道飞行员是否遇难，以便通知他们的家人。

合约调查员的行动：
调查 [LOCATION]，找到 [TARGETNAME] 的飞船。如果能够找到飞行员的尸体，请确认他们的状况，以便我们通知客户。

补充说明：
此次行动强烈建议带上增援。

name_notes_zh: 霍克罗 - 寻找尸体 MRT

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP74384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
We had sent in a two-person team to [SYSTEM] to investigate a case, but have received no reports from them for several days. At this juncture we are forced to assume that they had run into an unforeseen obstacle and may be in need of rescue, or worse, have been killed.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate [MISSINGPERSONLIST] at [LOCATION] and confirm their status.
If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.
Additional Notes:
Consider the dangerous nature of their investigation, there is a very strong chance there will be hostiles on site.
detail.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #MP74384
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件摘要：
我们此前曾派遣一支两人小组前往 [SYSTEM] 调查一宗案件，但已连续数日未收到其任何汇报。目前不得不推定，他们可能遭遇了突发障碍，亟需救援。抑或更糟已不幸遇难。

合约调查员的行动：
请前往 [LOCATION] 找到 [MISSINGPERSONLIST] 并确认其状态。

若他们已身亡，请仔细检查遗体，以便我们通过您的 mobiGlas 核实死亡情况。

补充说明：
鉴于他们执行的调查任务本身具有高度危险性，现场极有可能存在敌对目标。

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.
This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a handheld tractor beam.
And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

需要一名可靠的承包商为我们取货并把它们送达指定地点。

此航线较长，请确保燃料充足，并务必携带手持牵引光束。

然后我不确定你打算怎么飞，但你需要一艘能运输 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

detail.description_en:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near [LOCATION]. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.
Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
我们这下可麻烦大了。一艘执行重要任务的猎头帮飞船在 [LOCATION] 附近遭到了攻击。虽然不能透露太多细节，但他们的生存绝对至关重要。人民联盟也必须知道这件事，因为他们正在倾尽全力对付我们。

我们不会手下留情。这是个非常严重的情况，很多人在这种情况下都活不下来。如果你能成功解决这个问题，我会好好表扬你，而且保证你会得到丰厚的报酬。

-斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 急需一个英雄
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 保卫飞船 人民联盟 ERT

detail.description_en:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near [LOCATION]. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.
Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
我们这下可麻烦大了。一艘执行重要任务的猎头帮飞船在 [LOCATION] 附近遭到了攻击。虽然不能透露太多细节，但他们的生存绝对至关重要。人民联盟也必须知道这件事，因为他们正在倾尽全力对付我们。

我们不会手下留情。这是个非常严重的情况，很多人在这种情况下都活不下来。如果你能成功解决这个问题，我会好好表扬你，而且保证你会得到丰厚的报酬。

-斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 主动找茬
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 HRT

detail.description_en:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there?
The route starts at the location marker on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to bring a friend to watch your back.
You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus 14 Council Scrip as thanks.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
最近针对猎头帮飞船的袭击变多了，这让我感到不安。有批重要补给物资经不起闪失，得找人探路清场——我标了几个要是我就肯定会埋伏的点。

从你 HUD 上的位置标记开始扫荡，完事再发你下个坐标。听说这些地方最近总有杂碎晃悠，所以带上个朋友掩护你是个明智的选择。

只要你把这事办成，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为额外奖励。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 主动找茬
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 HRT

detail.description_en:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there?
The route starts at the location marker on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to bring a friend to watch your back.
You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus 14 Council Scrip as thanks.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
最近针对猎头帮飞船的袭击变多了，这让我感到不安。有批重要补给物资经不起闪失，得找人探路清场——我标了几个要是我就肯定会埋伏的点。

从你 HUD 上的位置标记开始扫荡，完事再发你下个坐标。听说这些地方最近总有杂碎晃悠，所以带上个朋友掩护你是个明智的选择。

只要你把这事办成，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为额外奖励。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 迷失但并未消失
name_notes_zh: 死亡圣徒 - 取回货物 ERT

detail.description_en:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at [LOCATION].
Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.
Head there with a crew of your own and a heavy-duty tractor beam to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.
Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
一帮对手摸清了我的送货路线，现在他们把我的一艘货船围在 [LOCATION] 了。

那帮混蛋全守着船，肯定在等谁派运输船去接货，所以你得赶在他们前面到。

带齐你的兄弟过去，再拎上重型牵引光束，直接把货抢回来，别像我把他们当软柿子。

干掉他们，把货送回 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，我保证让你赚翻。

- 刺痛

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION]

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION]
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION]

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION]
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION]

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

missions.name_zh: 充分利用糟糕处境
name_notes_zh: 死亡圣徒 - 物品取回 HRT

detail.description_en:
Just got a comm from the pilot who was transporting some gear for me and it sounded like they got jumped while on the call. I need someone to head to their location, grab the four packages that are still left inside their ship and bring them back to me.
Before they cut out, they told me that the ships that attacked them weren’t your standard transporters. These assholes are rocking some serious weaponry. Bring a crew, get my shit, and take it to [DESTINATION]. This whole thing is such a mess that I’d be willing to fork out some extra creds if you can get this done.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
我刚收到那个为我运输装备的飞行员的消息，听起来他们在执行任务时遭遇了袭击。我需要派人去他们的位置，把他们飞船里剩下的四个包裹拿回来带给我。

在他们通讯中断之前，他们告诉我袭击他们的飞船不是普通的运输船。那些混蛋配备了非常厉害的武器。带上一个团队，把我的东西拿回来，然后送到 [DESTINATION]。整个情况太混乱了，如果你们能完成这个任务，我愿意多付一些报酬。

-刺痛

Hey there,
So the People’s Alliance hired us to move a load of cargo from Levski to [DESTINATION]. Honestly, I’m surprised that they export some of this stuff, but I guess they must sell something to be able to afford everything they import.

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Have a run here that could become a lucrative regular thing if we can pull it off. This’ll take you into Pyro, so you’ll have to be ready to tangle with some of the locals.
You’ll need to grab the stuff from [LOCATION], make the jump to Pyro, and then get to [DESTINATION].
All you need to do is bring a ship with space for 24 SCU cargo containers, a handheld tractor beam, and be ready to do some damage if someone picks a fight with you.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

这儿有个活儿，要是能稳住就能变成个长期赚钱的买卖。这趟得进派罗，你得准备好跟当地那些人干一架。

你得先到 [LOCATION] 提货，跃迁到派罗，再赶到 [DESTINATION]。

你只需要一艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，带个手持式牵引光束，要是有人找茬，也别怂，该打就打。

detail.description_en:
--------------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------------
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION
The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.
NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]
RISK ASSESSMENT: Extreme
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: As acknowledgment of your expertise in the craft, the Bounty Hunters Guild would like to offer you the chance to earn a Master Tracker License.
This license would signify that you are qualified to track and apprehend Extreme-Risk Targets (ERT). These are criminals who travel in powerful ships with heavy escorts. This class of bounty only gets assigned to the most experienced of trackers.
To successfully complete this certification process, you must apprehend an ERT ranked criminal by the name of [TARGET] last seen at [LOCATION].
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice
The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

此执照表明您有资格追踪和逮捕极端危险目标（ERT），他们乘坐火力强劲的飞船，有重兵护卫。这些目标仅分配给最有经验的赏金猎人。

您必须成功缉拿这个名为 [TARGETNAME] 的极端危险目标，才能通过认证，他最后一次出现是在 [LOCATION]。

name_notes_zh: 科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 中等难度 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hey El here,
Got a weird one for you. I was checking the delivery stats for the past week and noticed some discrepancies. Seems we have a couple of deliveries marked as fulfilled but the cargo trackers are still showing as active.
One of these is located at [LOCATION] so I was hoping you could fly over and get to the bottom of this. The order says the hauler was using a ship that could carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers so make sure you have the same. A heavy-duty tractor beam is a must for this one too.
That cargo needs to be delivered yesterday, so as soon as you've got it take it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll get your payment sorted for you.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嘿，我是艾拉，

碰上个怪事，跟你讲一下。我刚核对了上周的送货记录，发现几单对不上。系统显示已签收，可集装箱的追踪器还亮着呢，说明货根本没到。

其中一单就在 [LOCATION]，你方便过去瞅瞅到底咋回事不？订单写明原承运飞船能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，你得开同规格的船去；另外这活儿必须带上重型牵引光束，别省这一步。

这批货早就该送到了，你一拿到手就赶紧送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我立马给你把报酬安排上。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

detail.description_en:
Hey El here,
Got a weird one for you. I was checking the delivery stats for the past week and noticed some discrepancies. Seems we have a couple of deliveries marked as fulfilled but the cargo trackers are still showing as active.
One of these is located at [LOCATION] so I was hoping you could fly over and get to the bottom of this. The order says the hauler was using a ship that could carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers so make sure you have the same. A heavy-duty tractor beam is a must for this one too.
That cargo needs to be delivered yesterday, so as soon as you've got it take it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll get your payment sorted for you.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嘿，我是艾拉，

碰上个怪事，跟你讲一下。我刚核对了上周的送货记录，发现几单对不上。系统显示已签收，可集装箱的追踪器还亮着呢，说明货根本没到。

其中一单就在 [LOCATION]，你方便过去瞅瞅到底咋回事不？订单写明原承运飞船能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，你得开同规格的船去；另外这活儿必须带上重型牵引光束，别省这一步。

这批货早就该送到了，你一拿到手就赶紧送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我立马给你把报酬安排上。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Looking for a contractor with a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers to run a delivery for us across Stanton.
This isn't a particularly long delivery route, but you will be moving between couple of different locations. To make sure things go smoothly, bring enough fuel and a handheld tractor beam to speed up moving the boxes.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

现招募一名承包商，需驾驶一艘可装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，跨越斯坦顿星系执行一次运输任务。

此航线虽不算特别长，但需在多个地点间往返。为确保任务顺利，请备足燃料，并携带手持牵引光束以加快装卸货箱效率。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺

LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的mobiGlas日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的mobiGlas日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

请注意，为了加快这些材料未来的使用效率，它们必须在交付前进行精炼。这可以在任何精炼厂完成，其位置可在你的星图中找到。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的mobiGlas日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

请注意，为了加快这些材料未来的使用效率，它们必须在交付前进行精炼。这可以在任何精炼厂完成，其位置可在你的星图中找到。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Mining and Data Collection
WORK BRIEF:
Have a big one for you today. Need you to get down there and mine [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]</EM4> and relay your stats back to us. I'm looking to pull together some findings from various miners around the system. [RARITY]
Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.
Let me know if you’re up for it.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：采矿与数据采集

工作简报：
今天有个大活儿交给你。你得下去挖 [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]，然后把你的数据传回来。我想汇总一下整个星系各种矿工的开采发现。[RARITY]

另外，如果你不了解或者刚接触采矿，联合资源工人协会写了一本很有用的指南，你应该去看看。它就在你的手环里。

如果你愿意，请告诉我。

报酬：
确认扫描并提取整个区域后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Mining and MOLE
WORK BRIEF:
Another special job for you with an extra special payout. Like the previous jobs, I need you to find and extract [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE] and relay your stats back to us. [RARITY]
I can't even tell you how helpful your work has been in the past so I've arranged an extra special payout for this one. [RARITY]
By this point you know what you're doing but just going to remind you that the United Resource Workers' mining journal on your mobi is great if you're stuck.
Let me know if you’re up for it.
PAYMENT:
You'll receive a custom ARGO MOLE as payment for all your help.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：采矿与鼹鼠

工作简报：
这次又给你安排了一个特别任务，报酬也格外丰厚。和之前的任务一样，我需要你去寻找并开采 [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]，然后把你的数据传回来。[RARITY]

我甚至无法形容你过去的工作对我有多有帮助，所以我特意为你安排了这笔额外的丰厚报酬。[RARITY]

到了这一步你应该已经轻车熟路了，不过还是提醒你一下，如果你找不到方向，手环里联合资源工人协会写的采矿指南会很有帮助。

如果你愿意，请告诉我。

报酬：
作为对你所有帮助的回报，你将获得一台定制的南船座鼹鼠。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Minor Mining Job
WORK BRIEF:
If you’ve got time, I’ve got a pretty basic mining job for you. I'm building a database of mineral types and their locations but I need some raw data, so I need someone to locate [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]. You can keep what you find, I'll pull the data I need. [RARITY]
Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.
Thanks.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

另外，如果你不知道去哪找矿或者刚接触采矿，联合资源工人协会写了一本很有用的指南，你应该去看看。它就在你的手环里。

谢谢。

报酬：
确认扫描并提取整个区域后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
Hi,
One of our outposts at [LOCATION] is in need of some light repairs. The folks onsite have estimated that you’ll need three fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to fix up to three or so pipes.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Thanks again for your help,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
你好，

我们在 [LOCATION] 的一座前哨站需要进行一些简单维修。现场人员估计你需要准备 三个保险丝、一个 打捞工具，以及 足够修复约三根管道的 RMC 罐子。

若需了解更多维修工作事项，请查阅 mobiGlas 日志中 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

再次感谢你的协助，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
A nearby outpost of ours at [LOCATION] is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.
We will need three fuses replaced and if you could bring a salvaging tool with enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes that should take care of the rest.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们在 [LOCATION] 附近的哨站出现了机械故障需要维修。由于常规技术员正在执行其他任务，现需外包承包商协助。

需要 更换三个保险丝，并请携带 打捞工具 以及 足够修复约三根管道的 RMC 罐 来处理剩余问题。

维修工作详情请参考 mobiGlas 日志中的 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

利玛·恩迪科特

We will need three fuses replaced and if you could bring a salvaging tool with enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes that should take care of the rest.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Missing Mining Team
WORK BRIEF:
One of our local crews set off for a dig and haven’t checked back in. With everything going on out there, people are starting to get a little worried, so we’d like someone to try and get eyes on them.
I hate to say this, but if something happened to them, could you please identify everyone you find so we can let next of kin know?
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：失联的采矿小组

工作简报：
我们本地的一个船员出发去采矿后就没再回过话。眼下外面局势这么乱，大家心里都开始犯嘀咕了，所以我们想请你帮忙去看看他们的情况。

说句难听的，万一真出了事，也请尽量辨认出你找到的所有人，好让我们通知他们的家属。

报酬：
确认全体成员状态后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Missing Persons
WORK BRIEF:
A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.
I'll send you their last known location. Just head out there and see what happened.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：失踪人员

工作简报：
一队人开着勘探者出发寻找采矿机会，之后便没了音讯。我们想找个人过去看看情况，确认他们是否安好。

我会给你发送他们最后已知的位置。请直接前往该处，查看究竟发生了什么事。

报酬：
确认全体成员状态后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

missions.name_zh: 需要常规维修: [LOCATION]

detail.description_en:
Hello,
We've received word that a devastating storm hit [LOCATION] which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Thanks,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
您好，

我们获知 [LOCATION] 遭遇了破坏性风暴，导致建筑结构受损。现场技术人员仍在评估可修复范围，但无法处理全部问题。若您能携带 六个保险丝、一个 打捞工具 以及 足够修复约五根管道的 RMC 罐，我们就能完成剩余维修工作。

如需了解更多维修细节，请查阅 mobiGlas 日志中的 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to [LOCATION] with the required supplies and perform some repairs.
As it stands, you’ll need six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so. That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Moraine Data Retrieval
WORK BRIEF:
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.
We need someone to infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.
While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：冰碛帮数据检索

工作简报：
这事有点超出我们平时的业务范围，但鉴于冰碛帮最近袭击得越来越频繁，我们希望能摸清他们的活动据点，好让船员们绕开那些危险区域。

我们需要有人潜入一个疑似冰碛帮的设施，然后复制他们服务器的数据。听说那空间站平时很少有人，但你万一在那儿撞上冰碛帮的人，也务必小心。

虽然我们不提倡暴力，但这情报的潜在价值足以拯救双方许多人的性命。

报酬：
交付后按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Moraine Movements
WORK BRIEF:
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.
We need someone to infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.
While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：冰碛帮动向

工作简报：
这事有点超出我们平时的业务范围，但鉴于冰碛帮最近袭击得越来越频繁，我们希望能摸清他们的活动据点，好让船员们绕开那些危险区域。

我们需要有人潜入一个疑似冰碛帮的设施，把一个小窃听器接到他们的服务器上。听说那个空间站平时几乎没人，但你也有可能在那儿撞上冰碛帮的人，所以务必小心。

虽然我们不提倡暴力，但这情报的潜在价值足以拯救双方许多人的性命。

报酬：
成功安装后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

name_notes_zh: 沃恩 - 寻找尸体 MRT

detail.description_en:
Whilst we pride ourselves on our efficiency and general cleanliness when it comes to our work, sometimes our contractors can get a little carried away themselves. Circumstances surrounding a former contractor’s death, and more importantly, the target, are somewhat unclear to us.
We’ll need you to travel to [LOCATION] and locate [TARGET]’s body so we can deliver clear confirmation to our client. As for the former contractor… you needn’t concern yourself with them. Arrangements for disposal have already been made.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
虽然我们在工作上以高效和干净著称，但有时候我们的承包商自己会有点失控。关于一位前承包商的死因，更重要的是目标的情况，我们目前还不太清楚。

我们需要你前往 [LOCATION] 找到 [TARGETNAME] 的尸体，这样我们就能向客户给出明确的确认了。至于那位前承包商...你不用操心他们。处理事宜已经安排好了。

此致，
沃恩

missions.name_zh: 需要一位运输工

detail.description_en:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.
If you head to [LOCATION], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle 4 SCU cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
嗨，我们需要在星系中运输一些物资，想知道你是否能帮忙。我知道这超出了你通常的职责范围，但我现在选择不多。这也是一个很好的机会，展示你对繁荣公民更大使命的承诺。

如果你前往 [LOCATION]，应该能通过一个货运电梯找到一些可用的物资，我们需要你把它们送到 [DESTINATION] 的另一个货运电梯。

唯一需要注意事情就是，你的飞船必须能够处理 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的货物集装箱。为了省点事，你最好随身带个手持式牵引光束。这应该是一次简单的运输。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
The outlaw presence here has become much bolder of late and a lot of people are getting hurt. We've recently lost several clusters around [LOCATION]. While we don't like to have to resort to violence, the board has acknowledged that these locations are crucial to establishing stability in the system and authorized the use of a security detail to retake them.
We're also aware that the embedded hostiles are being led by [TARGET] who's had a history of attacking CFP interests. The board would like [TARGET] dealt with to prevent future attacks.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
这里的不法分子最近变得更加猖獗，很多人都受到了伤害。我们最近在 [LOCATION] 附近失去了几个集群。虽然我们不想诉诸暴力，但董事会已经承认这些地点对在星系中建立稳定至关重要，并授权使用安全小组来夺回它们。

我们也意识到，现场的敌对人员是由 [TARGETNAME] 领导的，他有攻击繁荣公民权益的历史。堂会希望能解决 [TARGETNAME] 的问题，以防止未来的攻击。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.
We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.
The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们在 [DESTINATION] 的研究团队正在不懈努力解决当前的“再生危机”，处理不稳定印记的问题。他们的工作取得了可喜的成果，但缺少的一项关键资源阻碍了他们进行进一步实验的能力。

我们从供应商那里得知，由于需求的增加和采矿的产量下降，我们将无法在接下来的几个月内收到预定的货物。我们的研究团队等不及那么久，我们希望您能提供帮助。

这种资源难以获得，但我们有可靠消息称，旧哈索尔采矿设施建造在资源浓度较高的区域。由于哈索尔在建立其系统内的运营后不久就停业，因此激活其中一个采矿激光器很可能能为我们提供所需的资源。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Our research team at at [DESTINATION] is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.
We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.
The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们在 [DESTINATION] 的研究团队正在不懈努力解决当前的“再生危机”，处理不稳定印记的问题。他们的工作取得了可喜的成果，但缺少的一项关键资源阻碍了他们进行进一步实验的能力。

我们从供应商那里得知，由于需求的增加和采矿的产量下降，我们将无法在接下来的几个月内收到预定的货物。我们的研究团队等不及那么久，我们希望您能提供帮助。

这种资源难以获得，但我们有可靠消息称，旧哈索尔采矿设施建造在资源浓度较高的区域。由于哈索尔在建立其系统内的运营后不久就停业，因此激活其中一个采矿激光器很可能能为我们提供所需的资源。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

RE: Need Some Ore Mined

Got a moment? Need someone to fly over to locate [RESOURCES] and mine at least [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]. We're updating our database for future mining expeditions. You can keep what you find, we just need the data. [RARITY]

detail.description_en:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.
You and your most trusted support ships will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.
Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

一支罪犯舰队已在繁荣公民正着力开发的星区扎根，其暴力行径已致使所有前进步伐都停滞了。为保障长期战略目标，我们必须在事态进一步恶化前设法彻底瓦解这支舰队。

你及你最信赖的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对目标。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

非常感谢您的帮助，

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: Seemingly unsatisfied with their takings in Nyx, an outlaw group lead by [TARGET] has been planning a major strike against the UEE. This cannot be allowed to come to pass.
Thanks to the work of our Intelligence team, we've been able to track them down to [LOCATION].
Head there as soon as you can and engage before they have a chance to leave the system. Based on our strategic analysis, we recommend a well-armed and skilled fleet will be necessary for the successful completion of this mission.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：看样子他们在尼克斯的收获还不够满意，由 [TARGETNAME] 领导的一伙不法分子正策划对 UEE 发动大规模袭击，这一计划绝不能得逞。

多亏了我们情报部门的努力，我们已找到他们锁定在 [LOCATION]。

请尽快赶到那里，并在他们逃离星系前发动攻击。根据我们的战略分析，成功完成此次任务需要一支装备精良技术娴熟的舰队。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec is in need of a highly skilled combat pilot who can locate and neutralize a dangerous Vanduul target.
An operator of ours has identified a Vanduul ship flying within the vicinity of [LOCATION]. We've been given strict instructions to eliminate any Vanduul spotted on the fringes of UEE space, for fear of encroachment into the Empire's territory.
Bring a small fleet of competent pilots with you to engage and neutralize the target.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

我们的一名特工发现，一艘剜度飞船正在 [LOCATION] 附近活动。我们接到明确指令，必须消灭任何出现在 UEE 边境的剜度飞船，以防其侵入帝国领土。

请带一支由优秀飞行员组成的小型舰队前去对付并消灭目标。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP38100
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Hockrow Agency is looking for new contractors with a strong stomach and familiarity with dangerous situations to handle the legwork of an active missing persons investigation.
Reports indicate that it is highly unlikely that you will encounter any hostiles.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Travel to [LOCATION], search for [TARGET], and confirm their status. If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.
Additional Notes:
Successful completion of this task will open up other employment opportunities within Hockrow Agency.
detail.description_zh:

报告显示，你遇到敌对势力的可能性非常低。

前往 [LOCATION]，寻找 [TARGETNAME]，并确认他们的状况。如果他们已经死亡，请仔细检查尸体，以便我们通过你的mobiGlas设备验证他们的死亡。

补充说明：
成功完成这项任务将为你在霍克罗事务所开辟其他就业机会。

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
We’re looking for contractors with combat experience who are willing to get their hands dirty so to speak. A client of ours was double-crossed by a [TARGET] and we’ve been waiting for an opportunity to deal with the issue. After tracking them for several weeks, we’ve identified [LOCATION] as the ideal spot to intercept them. It features an emission cloud where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting for the [TARGET].
Intel suggests that they may travel with an escort. If they do, you’ll have to deal with them too. Since this is your first contract, we will have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip in this for the main contractor too.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 轰炸 LRT

detail.description_en:
Some competition has taken root at [LOCATION] and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.
Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.
Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:
在 [LOCATION] 出现了一些竞争者，他们真的让我们在这个区域的操作变得很麻烦。

我心里有一部分看到了这些新人的潜力，希望能够把他们拉入我们的圈子，但同时，我也不能让他们四处飞来飞去惹麻烦。

所以我想让你去炸掉他们的燃料罐。这应该能让他们被迫停下来，给我时间去劝说他们的脑袋冷静下来。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 身为刺客毫无荣誉我最深切的哀悼
name_notes_zh: 沃恩 - 寻找尸体 ERT

detail.description_en:
I have a very specific task that requires my best people.
Something unusual seems to have occurred over at [LOCATION]. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Now, I have other methods for dealing with renegade assets but our client still requires confirmation of the original target’s death which we are unable to provide due to this pilot’s presence.
I need you to head to the location and identify that [TARGET] is well and truly dead, preferably without being obliterated by this former, disgruntled contractor. As a fair warning, they were one of our most thorough, and ruthless employees, so extreme caution is advised. You will want to bring your most competent of allies to support you with this.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
我有一个非常具体的任务，需要我最得力的人来完成。

好像在 [LOCATION] 那边发生了一些不寻常的事情。我们的一位承包商完成任务后似乎变得叛变了，拒绝跟我们沟通，还无差别地攻击遇到的任何人。现在，我有其他办法对付这些叛变的人，但我们的客户仍然需要确认原来目标已经死了，而由于这个飞行员的存在，我们无法提供这种确认。

我需要你去那个地点，确认 [TARGETNAME] 确实已经死了，最好是在这位前不满的承包商摧毁他之前。作为善意提醒，他们是我们在职员工中最彻底、最无情的一个，所以必须格外小心。你最好带上最能干的盟友来支持你。

此致，
沃恩

Something unusual seems to have occurred over at [LOCATION]. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Now, I have other methods for dealing with renegade assets but our client still requires confirmation of the original target’s death which we are unable to provide due to this pilot’s presence.
I need you to head to the location and identify that [TARGET] is well and truly dead, preferably without being obliterated by this former, disgruntled contractor. As a fair warning, they were one of our most thorough, and ruthless employees, so extreme caution is advised. You will want to bring your most competent of allies to support you with this.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
我有一个非常具体的任务，需要我最得力的人来完成。

好像在 [LOCATION] 那边发生了一些不寻常的事情。我们的一位承包商完成任务后似乎变得叛变了，拒绝跟我们沟通，还无差别地攻击遇到的任何人。现在，我有其他办法对付这些叛变的人，但我们的客户仍然需要确认原来目标已经死了，而由于这个飞行员的存在，我们无法提供这种确认。

我需要你去那个地点，确认 [TARGETNAME] 确实已经死了，最好是在这位前不满的承包商摧毁他之前。作为善意提醒，他们是我们在职员工中最彻底、最无情的一个，所以必须格外小心。你最好带上最能干的盟友来支持你。

此致，
沃恩

missions.name_zh: 获取受辐射的瓦拉卡珍珠

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.
Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar pearls, which can be extracted from apex valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near [LOCATION]. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls.
Once attained, please take these valuable resources to [DESTINATION].
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正在不遗余力地阻止当前的再生危机，但我们的科学家需要一种罕见的资源，而公司供应商无法获取这种资源。

拉亚利正在寻找有经验的承包商来收集 受辐射的瓦拉卡珍珠，这些珍珠可以从长期暴露在辐射下的巅峰期瓦拉卡体内提取。我们的扫描发现，在靠近 [LOCATION] 的风暴中有一批符合条件的种群。因为这些动物极其危险，拉亚利准备慷慨地补偿任何能够协助收集珍珠的人。

一旦收集完成，请将这些珍贵的资源送到 [DESTINATION]。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: An undercover agent of ours was compromised and is now being pursued by the outlaw pack they had infiltrated. As such, they are in need of immediate extraction at [LOCATION].
Once on site, engage with all hostiles in order to provide cover so our operative can QT away.
Bring additional backup and don't underestimate these outlaws. They are violent and motivated so they are unlikely to give up anytime soon.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系

一抵达现场，就与现场所有的敌对目标交战，为我们的人争取量子航行离开的时间。

带上额外的支援，别小看这些不法分子。他们非常暴力且目标明确，所以不太可能轻易放弃。

此致，

迪肯·托宾

detail.description_en:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.
Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.
Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of [ITEM] from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

detail.description_en:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.
Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.
Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of [ITEM] from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

detail.description_en:
An opportunity has presented itself for a client to take action against a group of criminals who have been harassing their business.
According to reports, this group of outlaws are currently laying low at [LOCATION]. The client thinks this is a good time to catch them off guard and bring them to justice. The job is to take out their fuel tanks and putting an end to their smuggling operations once and for all.
These folks are not to be underestimated. You better bring some backup and fly low to avoid the turrets. Priority as always is the fuel tanks.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
客户迎来一次良机，可对长期骚扰其生意的一伙罪犯采取行动。

据情报显示，这群不法分子目前正蛰伏于 [LOCATION]。客户认为眼下正是出其不意、将其绳之以法的绝佳时机。任务目标是摧毁其燃料罐，彻底终结他们的走私活动。

切勿轻敌，务必携带支援力量，并低空飞行以规避炮塔火力。一如往常，燃料罐始终是最高优先级目标。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。
