detail.description_en:
A splinter group of outlaws have broken off from one of the main gangs in the system and have been trying to strike out on their own. With the amount of trouble they've been causing its clear they're looking to establish a name for themselves as quickly as they can. It's going to be up to you and your support crew to put a stop to them.
Once your crew is ready, head over to [LOCATION] and engage with the gang. Not all of them will just be waiting there on site. Expect reinforcements to arrive once you begin your assault. Just be sure to stay until every last one of them has been take care of.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives."

等你们团队准备好了，直接去 [LOCATION] 找上那帮人开干。并不是所有的人都会在那里等着，等你一动手，援军就会到达。一定要待在这里，直到他们都被解决掉。

detail.description_en:
After a contractor successfully recovered data stolen from one of our clients, a security analyst verified that it was captured by unauthorized surveillance monitors illegally installed around [LOCATION]. We’re looking for someone to follow up and take out those monitors.
You will need to find the [MONITOR_COUNT] and destroy them before any more data can be gathered. Passive 'Skimmers' like these typically are hard to find so be thorough in your search.
Once attacked, their security protocols will cause them to begin transmitting the contents of their drives, so it’s imperative that you stop the upload before it can complete. There’s also a good chance that whoever’s responsible might be in the area, so be careful.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

detail.description_en:
Several unknown ships have been spotted in areas frequented by haulers delivering goods for our client. They’re worried these ships are monitoring their haulers in preparation for an ambush, so they’ve hired us to patrol the area.
Start by going to the location marker on your HUD and scan it to ensure it’s clear. After that, we’ll send you to some other areas to scan for potential threats. We recommend that you bring a wingman and plenty of supplies to be ready to handle whatever might come your way.
Also know that successfully completing this contract will earn the main contractor a bonus payment of 14 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

detail.description_en:
The folks at [LOCATION] are under attack and need our support. Their ships in the wider area are being targeted and there’s a growing concern that this is only a precursor to something bigger.
The situation is evolving, but I’m being fed constant updates on what’s going on and will keep you informed as the contract progresses.
Are you available to come to their aid? Would be smart to recruit some friends to help. These are important clients and we can’t afford to fail them. The main contractor will earn a bonus payment of 7 MG Scrip if you get the job done.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

detail.description_en:
Recently, a [TARGET] baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.
Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at [LOCATION] that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us?
It’ll be you against the [TARGET], other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.
Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

detail.description_en:
A client is concerned about activity near some of their interests. We’ve been contracted to patrol the area and run scans at several locations. Interested? If so, head to the location marker on your HUD to start the patrol.
The client wasn’t specific about the threats, but they don’t think everything’s on the level out there. Hopefully we’ll be able to bring them some peace of mind.
Additionally, the client arranged for us to offer a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

Foxwell has been tracking a [TARGET] used by outlaws and discovered a pattern to its movements. The ship should be passing by [LOCATION] soon.
Looking for a contractor willing to hustle there, hide in the emission cloud, and then spring the trap when the time is right. There’s usually escort ships with the [TARGET]. Careful not to jump the gun and blow your cover. The element of surprise is crucial from what I’ve read.
Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 5 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
福克斯韦尔一直在追踪一个被不法分子使用的 [AMBUSHTARGET]，并发现了它的行动规律。这艘船应该很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。

我们在寻找一位愿意快速赶到那里的承包商，藏身于辐射云中，然后在合适的时候设下圈套。[AMBUSHTARGET] 通常会有护航船。小心不要操之过急，暴露了行踪。根据我所了解到的，出其不意至关重要。

搞定这事儿，我们就会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

It seems that a couple of different small-time gangs have decided to pool their resources and start doing coordinated attacks. Alone, they weren't much, but all together they're proving to be a serious threat that has to be dealt with.
Recruit some backup you can rely on and the fly over to [LOCATION]. Once you attack the initial gang members you find there, the other groups will arrive to support them. Make sure you wait around to take out all of them.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
看来几伙小打小闹的帮派最近凑一块儿，搞起了“共同出资”，开始联手搞协同袭击。单个看他们没啥威胁，可一抱团，立马成了大麻烦，非得赶紧处理不可。

你先拉点信得过的帮手，然后直接飞去 [LOCATION]。等你一开打，干掉最先碰上的那拨人，其他几伙援军马上就会赶到支援。所以别急着走，多蹲会儿，把他们全清干净。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
We're in need of a sharp contractor for a hit and run operation. Client says some local thugs have been congregating in concerning numbers and we have been tasked with disrupting their base of operations.
Get on over to [LOCATION] and take out their fuel tanks. If you're successful we can set these folks plans back a while, and most importantly, without having to deal with them directly.
Reports are showing there's a couple of ships buzzing around the area and some defense turrets. Just focus on the fuel tanks and you should be alright.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们急需一名干练的承包商执行一次突袭撤离行动。客户反映，一批本地暴徒近期频繁聚集，人数令人担忧，现委托我们对其据点实施干扰打击。

请立即前往 [LOCATION]，摧毁其燃料罐。若行动成功，可暂时打乱他们的计划。最关键的是，无需与他们正面交锋。

情报显示，该区域有数艘飞船盘旋巡逻，并配有防御炮塔。只需专注摧毁燃料罐，任务即可完成。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS]. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.
For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我希望您能前往 [LOCATION] 提供保护服务。我们的一位高优先级客户正遭受一伙不法分子的攻击，对方盯上了他们的 [OBJECTS]。我们必须尽可能确保资产的安全与完整。客户对付费服务抱有期待，所以千万别搞砸了，否则我们可能会失去一位忠实的客户。

目前，关于这些不法分子的情报还比较模糊，但如果您能按照福克斯韦尔的达标标准完成此次任务，我们将向主承包商提供 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为报酬。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS]. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.
For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

detail.description_en:
One of our high priority clients is under attack from a criminal gang targeting their [OBJECTS] in [LOCATION]. The client’s assets are valuable, so we need to keep those safe at all costs, but I won’t kid – it’ll be a challenge and a half with these thugs determined to do some real damage.
If it were me, I wouldn’t hesitate to <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. They’re no joke, so we’re offering a well-earned 6 MG Scrip to the main contractor who deals with these guys successfully.
Best of luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们的一位高优先级客户正遭受犯罪团伙的攻击，对方盯上了位于 [LOCATION] 的 [OBJECTS]。客户的资产非常珍贵，我们必须不惜一切代价确保其安全。但我也不瞒你，面对这些一心要造成实质性破坏的恶棍，这将是一场艰巨的挑战。

换作是我的话我绝不犹豫，会立刻 呼叫增援 来对付他们。这些人可不是好惹的，因此，若主承包商能成功解决这些麻烦，我们将向其提供一份实至名归的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为报酬。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at [LOCATION] have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the [OBJECTS] and ships in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage.
If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully.
Best of luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

雷科·巴塔利亚

missions.name_zh: 奥里森平台遭到袭击
name_notes_zh: 奥里森之围

detail.description_en:
Greetings,
Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.
The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.
For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge.
Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.
Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
你好，

十字军安保部队联系了我们，希望我们协助处理一起紧急情况。奥里森附近的几个平台已被九尾帮派成员占领，而北境之岩正迫切需要人手消灭他们，将平台夺回并交还给十字军方面。

九尾已采取措施封锁了该区域的所有空中交通，所以我们获准提供一艘安保穿梭机，将你和你的突击队的其他成员运送至第一个平台。

为了充分披露，我必须提醒：这不是一份适合胆小鬼的任务。但我相信你的战斗技巧，凭借你和你所选团队，你们完全能够应对这一挑战。

等你登上穿梭机，我会直接与你联系并提供更多信息。

稍后详谈，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

detail.description_en:
Alright,
The damage reports are still rolling in from the Nine Tails' attack on Orison and the folks at Crusader are saying they might have to repair a significant proportion of the propulsors on those platforms. That's why this one's a massive order.
Larger quantity, but same as before otherwise. Either manufacturer them yourself using an Item Fabricator or source them some other way.
When you're done, drop the propulsors off at [DESTINATION]. Be a big payout with this one.
Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager
CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
detail.description_zh:
好的，

来自九尾袭击奥里森的损害报告仍在不断传来，十字军方面表示他们可能不得不修复那些平台上相当大比例的推进器。这就是为什么这次订单如此巨大。

数量更大，但其他方面与之前相同。你可以使用物品制造机自行制造，或者通过其他渠道获取。

完成后，请将推进器运送到 [DESTINATION] 交付。这次的报酬非常丰厚。

非常感谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石开发公司
“立足过往之基石，建设我们的未来。”

name_notes_zh: 货物运输

detail.description_en:
Hey, it’s El.
Off the bat – this particular job’s a big deal, so if you’re looking to take this one on for us, make sure you’re confident in your ability to do a job well.
We’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver medical supplies to [DESTINATION]. Pick up’s at [LOCATION]. Bear in mind, this is gonna be a big one, so make sure bring a handheld tractor beam and a ship that can hold 16 SCU cargo containers otherwise it might be a little rough.
I can’t stress the importance of this contract enough – lots of good people got hurt in those attacks, and it’s our responsibility to do what we can to help them in the aftermath. We owe the victims that much, at the very least.
Let’s do right by them,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
detail.description_zh:
嘿，我是艾拉。

首先说明 - 这份任务非同小可，如果你打算接下它，务必确保自己有足够的能力将其圆满完成。

我们受十字军委托，需将医疗物资运送至 [DESTINATION]，取货地点在 [LOCATION]。请注意，这次是个大单，务必携带 手持牵引光束，并确保你的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的货物，否则运输过程可能会有点艰难。

我再怎么强调这份合约的重要性也不为过 - 那些袭击中许多好人受了重伤，我们有责任尽己所能在灾后提供帮助。至少，我们对受害者负有这份义务。

让我们尽力而为，

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

detail.description_en:
Hello,
Crusader has asked us here at Ling Family Hauling to aid their relief efforts, and it’s extremely important to us as a business and a family to do this right. The thought of what happened to the victims of Orison happening to anyone in my family… We owe it to the survivors to do everything in our power to help them.
The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from [LOCATION] and needs to be dropped at [DESTINATION]. And be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to speed things along.
Thank you,
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
detail.description_zh:
哈喽，

十字军已要求我们玲家快递协助他们的救援工作，作为一家公司和一个家庭，做好这件事对我们来说极其重要。一想到奥里森受害者遭遇的惨剧若发生在我的家人身上...我们有责任竭尽全力帮助幸存者。

十字军所需的医疗物资已准备好从 [LOCATION] 取货，并需要投递至 [DESTINATION]。请务必携带一个 手持牵引光束 以加快进度。

谢谢，
康妮·玲
运输协调员
玲家快递

detail.description_en:
Hullo,
Crusader have been in touch to say that the scale of the damage to their platforms is greater than they initially thought and they'll need more propulsors than they originally estimated for.
We're contracting out their request to anyone with an available Item Fabricator standing by. Though I guess you could source the propulsors some other way, but that's on you.
Once ready, deliver them to [DESTINATION]. Payment sent on completion.
Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager
CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
detail.description_zh:
哈喽，

十字军方面已联系表示，他们平台受损程度比最初预估的更为严重，因此需要比原计划更多的推进器。

我们正委托任何有闲置物品制造机的承包商承接此需求。不过我猜你也可以通过其他渠道获取推进器，但这取决于你自己。

准备好后，请将它们运送到 [DESTINATION] 进行交付。任务完成后即支付报酬。

非常感谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石开发公司
“立足过往之基石，建设我们的未来。”

detail.description_en:
Hey, it’s El.
Crusader is still trying to make things right in Orison following the attack, so I’m hoping you’re free to keep assisting with the effort.
We been contracted to deliver relief supplies to [DESTINATION]. Pick up’s at [LOCATION].
Not too shabby a haul either, so make sure you’re in a ship that can hold 8 SCU cargo containers and bring a handheld tractor beam, or you’ll make us all look unprofessional.
I’m not kidding around with this job being important to get done right. Lotta people got hurt during the Nine Tails raid, and they’re relying on people like us to get them the help they need. So let’s do right by them, okay?
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
detail.description_zh:
嘿，我是艾拉。

十字军仍在努力修复奥里森遇袭后的局面，所以我希望你有空继续协助我们的工作。

我们受委托将救援物资运送至 [DESTINATION]，取货地点在 [LOCATION]。

这趟货运的报酬也相当不错，所以务必确保你的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱，并带上一把手持牵引光束，否则你会让我们看起来很不专业。

我可不是在开玩笑，这项任务非常重要，必须圆满完成。许多人在九尾袭击期间受了伤，他们正依赖像我们这样的人提供急需的帮助。所以，让我们不负所托好吗？

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

missions.name_en: Orison Relief: Neutralize Nine Tails Reprisal
missions.name_zh: 奥里森救援：消灭九尾的报复行动
name_notes_zh: 地堡突袭

detail.description_en:
Some of the Nine Tails responsible for the attack on Orison have reportedly been sighted around [LOCATION] marshalling their forces. Crusader is concerned they’re planning another attack, so this is a job that needs doing well.
You’ll be tasked with infiltrating the site and neutralizing the Nine Tails however necessary before they can enact a retaliation attempt on Orison. As I’m sure you’re aware, these guys are bad news, so be careful they don’t get the better of you.
Good luck,
Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
据报道，一些负责袭击奥里森的九尾在 [LOCATION] 附近集结兵力。十字军担心他们正在策划另一次袭击，所以这项任务必须圆满完成。

你的任务是渗透进入该地点，并在九尾有机会对奥里森实施报复之前，不惜一切代价将其消灭。正如你所知，这帮家伙非常危险，务必小心，别让他们占了上风。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

missions.name_zh: 奥里森救援：小型制造订单
name_notes_zh: 物品制造

detail.description_en:
Now then,
After the Nine Tails attack, the folks at Crusader could do with more than just a helping hand. What they need are proper propulsors to help replace the ones damaged in the attacks.
We've attached a blueprint for the TH-01 Propulsor that you can access at an Item Fabricator. Just search for it on the fabricator's terminal and you'll be able to see what materials are needed. Up to you whether you go out and find those materials yourself or buy them from a trader. (And if you don't have a fabricator yet, you'll have to purchase one at a shop, unload it at a freight elevator, and then set it up in a hangar or ship's cargo bay.)
Once you're done bring them to [DESTINATION] and one of the team will sort out the rest.
Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager
CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
detail.description_zh:
那么，

九尾袭击之后，十字军方面需要的不仅仅是一点帮助。他们真正需要的是合适的推进器，以替换在袭击中受损的那些。

我们已经附上了 TH-01 推进器的蓝图，你可以在物品制造机中访问它。只要在制造机的终端上搜索，就能看到所需的材料。至于你是亲自出去寻找这些材料，还是从商人那里购买，就由你决定了。无论哪种方式，你都需要使用物品制造机来自行制造推进器。（如果你还没有制造机，就得先在商店购买一台，把它卸到货运电梯上，然后将其设置在机库或飞船货舱中。）

完成后，请将它们运送到 [DESTINATION] 交付，届时有一个团队会负责后续事宜。

非常感谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比
合约经理

基石开发公司
“立足过往之基石，建设我们的未来。”

detail.description_en:
Now then,
You might have heard about the recent attacks on the Orison platforms. Terrible stuff. The folks at Crusader are scrambling around trying to put it all back together and have contracted us to help.
To get them back on their feet what we need is construction materials. Can give you a decent pay packet for them too.
If you don't know already how to get construction materials, your best bet is to read United Resource Workers' A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection. That'll set you on the right path.
Once you've got the order ready, you'll need to drop it all off at [DESTINATION].
Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager
CORNERSTONE MAINTENANCE
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."
detail.description_zh:
那么，

你可能已经听说了最近奥里森平台遭受袭击的事情。真是惨不忍睹。十字军的人正忙着试图修复一切，并委托我们进行协助。

为了让他们重新站稳脚跟，我们需要的是[结构材料Construction Materials]。我们也可以为你提供丰厚的报酬。

如果你还不知道如何获取结构材料，最好的办法是阅读资源工人联合会发布的《打捞者物资收集指南》。它会指引你走上正轨。

等你把订单准备完毕，你需要把它们全部运送到 [DESTINATION] 进行交付。

非常感谢，
哈尔·格里姆斯比

name_notes_zh: 货物运输

detail.description_en:
Hey, it’s El.
Need a reliable contractor for a pretty important delivery today. I’m sure you’re aware of what went down in Orison, big commotion. Made my job about ten times harder.
Anyway, we’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver some medical stuff to [DESTINATION]. Pick up’s at [LOCATION]. Shouldn’t be too heavy an order for this one, just make sure you’ve got a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam, or you’ll really embarrass yourself when you get there.
Look, I’ll level with you. This job isn’t just hauling for hauling’s sake. Orison got pretty messed up by those Nine Tails, so anything we can do to help them out is probably the right thing to do.
Let’s get it done,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
detail.description_zh:
嘿，我是艾拉。

今天，需要一位可靠的承包商来完成一项相当重要的运送任务。想必你已经知道奥里森发生了什么，大骚乱。让我的工作难度增加了十倍。

总之，我们受十字军委托，需将一些医疗物资运送至 [DESTINATION]，取货地点在 [LOCATION]。这次订单重量应该不算太重，但务必确保你的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的货物，并带上一把手持牵引光束，否则到了那儿你会很尴尬的。

我跟你说句心里话，这项任务绝非为了运货而运货。奥里森被那些九尾搞得一团糟，所以任何能帮上忙的事都是正确的选择。

让我们尽力而为，

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

missions.name_zh: 奥里森救援：阻止九尾重新集结

detail.description_en:
Just got word that some of the Nine Tails involved in the recent assault on Orison are convening near [LOCATION] before launching their next attack. We need a capable fighter pilot to head them off and take care of them before they start wreaking havoc again.
To complicate matters, from what we know there’s a very high chance that they might have additional reinforcements inbound, so be sure the extra ships don’t take you by surprise.
All the best,
Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
刚接到消息，一些参与近期奥里森袭击的九尾正集结在 [LOCATION] 附近，准备发动下一轮攻击。我们需要一位能干的战斗机飞行员前去阻止他们，并在他们再次制造混乱之前干掉他们。

更棘手的是，据我们所知，他们极有可能正在调集增援部队。所以务必小心那些突然出现的飞船，别被打了个措手不及。

祝一切顺利，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

missions.name_en: Orison Relief: Strike Nine Tails Squad
missions.name_zh: 奥里森救援：突袭九尾小队
name_notes_zh: 伏击

detail.description_en:
Looking for a tough and competent pilot in the area willing to take on some of the outlaws responsible for the attack on Crusader. We’ve received word that a group of Nine Tails stragglers are hunkering down near [LOCATION] after they got pushed out of Orison, and Crusader Security wants our help dealing with them while they’re down.
We’ve mapped out a good spot in the area to get the drop on them, so you’ll go there, wait quietly until they show up, and hit them before they know what’s happening. Hopefully this’ll send a message to the rest of them out there that their actions have consequences.
Good luck,
Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
正在寻找一位身手矫健且能力出众的飞行员，愿意接手打击那些袭击十字军的不法分子。我们收到消息，一群九尾的散兵被赶出奥里森后，正躲藏在 [LOCATION] 附近，十字军安保希望我们能趁其立足未稳时帮忙解决他们。

我们已规划好该区域的一个绝佳伏击点，你将前往那里，保持静默直到他们现身，然后在他们反应过来之前发起打击。希望此举能让他们的其余团伙明白，他们的所作所为必将付出代价。

祝你好运，

凯文·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.
We’re not gonna let that happen though.
Snatch that blackbox at [LOCATION] and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

-Bit Zeros

我就不跟你说这王八蛋对咱们干过啥了，反正关键是这个混蛋想通过飞船坠毁去骗保，保险公司想看黑匣子录像来确认一切是不是“光明正大”的。

话说这片区域有点危险，估计也是他们选这儿策划事故的原因。你最好带上几个帮手，别还没把黑匣子运到 [DESTINATION] 给咱们就被人整没了。

- 零比特

Several CFP clusters near [LOCATION] just got hit by a group of outlaws led by [TARGET]. We're looking for any available combat specialists to help retake the outposts.
I can provide the locations upon acceptance but we need to clear out the main outpost and satellite installations from all hostile forces and take out [TARGET] as it's unlikely that they will not cease their hostilities if they escape.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 轰炸 ERT

detail.description_en:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at [LOCATION]. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.
But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.
Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:
我们听说一伙新帮派正计划进攻 [LOCATION] 那块地方。他们盘算着只要端掉那里的燃料补给，那地儿就归他们了。

但他们不知道的是，我们要先派你去把那些油罐炸了，好在他们动手前把地盘占下来。要是按计划行事，咱们既能清空那块地，又能顺便给那帮混蛋点颜色看看，一举两得。

唯一的麻烦是那儿武装到了牙齿。带上一个团队去把那些燃料罐搞定，剩下的交给我们。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

detail.description_en:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [LOCATION]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TARGET] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.
While all the security have been greenlit, [TARGET] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.
Watch yourself though, [TARGET] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
猎头帮正在 [LOCATION] 附近发起攻击。如果那里的人不投降交出武器的话，一个名叫 [TARGETNAME] 的前海军陆战队混蛋一直在派遣他的雇佣兵去清除那边的营地。

虽然所有的安保措施都已获批，但 [TARGETNAME] 被特别点名。在他们的最后一次突袭中，他们把一个无家可归者打死了，因为那人顶嘴。结果发现那个无家可归者是我们一个小组成员的表亲，所以他们愿意额外支付，以确保正义得以伸张。

不过要小心，[TARGETNAME] 可能是个该得报应的混蛋，但他们毕竟是前军人，所以不容易对付。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been increasingly riddled with outlaw attacks and we think that if we begin to actively patrol the area we can turn things around. We’d recommend gathering at least two wingmen to head out there in combat-ready ships and confront any hostile forces you might encounter.
Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 18 MG Scrip.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点扫一遍，确认安全。主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has received intelligence that outlaws are planning to launch an attack on a target within the UEE. In an effort to prevent this from happening, we need a contractor to patrol a sector we believe these outlaws are using to prepare for their attack.
Outlaw activity in this sector is higher than normal, so InterSec recommends that you bring backup. When ready, dispatch to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. Once you've confirmed that the entire sector is clear, the main contractor will receive a bonus of 14 MG Scrip.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安收到情报，不法分子正计划对 UEE 内的一个目标发动攻击。为了防止这种情况发生，我们需要一名承包商在该区域进行巡逻，我们认为这些不法分子正在该区域为攻击做准备。

该区域的不法分子活动比平时更为频繁，因此互安建议你带上支援。准备好后，前往 HUD 上的位置标记，并扫描路线上的各个点。一旦确认整个区域安全，主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的奖金。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

name_notes_zh: 繁荣公民 - 巡逻 MRT

detail.description_en:
Outlaws have been increasing their activity along one of the more popular routes in the system and we’re hoping to provide a deterrent before the problem gets out of hand. As such, we’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and deal with any hostiles you might encounter.
Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 8 MG Scrip.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
最近这条热门航线上不法分子越来越猖獗，咱们得赶紧去震慑一下，别等到事儿闹大了。你开艘能打的船过去，碰上敌对势力就直接干掉。

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点都扫一遍。等全搞定，主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

missions.name_zh: 巡逻极端危险区域
name_notes_zh: 繁荣公民 - 巡逻 ERT

detail.description_en:
After weeks of seeing crime rates increase, we’ve been able to identify a sector that we believe to be the source of the outlaw activity that has been leeching into the surrounding areas. While it would be too much to expect to eradicate all threats, we believe that by sending combat patrols into the area we might be able to start reversing this worrisome trend. Our in-house combat analysts recommend bringing around three wingmen in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.
Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of 24 MG Scrip.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
折腾了几个星期，总算摸清了那帮不法分子的老巢，就藏在最近闹得最凶的那片星域。想彻底清干净是没戏，但咱派巡逻队杀过去，也许能压一压这股邪风。我们内部的战斗分析员建议你带上三架僚机，开艘能硬刚的船以对抗你可能遇到的任何敌对势力。

接了这活儿，飞到 HUD 上标出的位置标记，把沿途所有航路点都扫一遍。等全搞定，主承包商额外奖励[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been tracking increased outlaw activity in certain sectors of the system. This activity in conjunction with other intelligence leads us to believe that outlaws are planning an attack on elements traveling from the UEE. We're aiming to patrol these sectors and disrupt any plans before they can be put into action.
Currently, we need someone who can help patrol a highly dangerous sector. Once you've accepted the mission, you can proceed to the location marker on your HUD. From there, we'll send you along a specific route with additional waypoints to scan. Complete the patrol and we'll send the main contractor a bonus of 18 MG Scrip.
Due to the high probability of attack and general threat level of local outlaws, we recommend recruiting trusted wingmen to provide combat support.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安一直在追踪星系某些区域的不法分子活动有所增加。结合其他情报，我们认为这些不法分子正在策划对来自 UEE 的船只发动攻击。我们的目标是巡逻这些区域，在他们的计划实施之前予以破坏。

目前，我们需要有人协助巡逻一个危险性极高的区域。一旦你接受任务，就可以前往 HUD 上的位置标记。从那里，我们会为你提供一条包含多个检查点的具体路线。完成巡逻后，我们将向主承包商发放 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的奖励。

由于攻击的可能性很高且当地不法分子的威胁等级较高，我们建议招募可靠的僚机以提供战斗支援。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: There's a growing concern that Vanduul hunting parties are pushing further into Nyx. The first line of defense against this encroachment is increased patrols. InterSec has identified a sector that has seen an uptick in Vanduul activity and are looking for someone to patrol the region and provide an update on it.
You'll begin your patrol at a location marker sent to your HUD and then scan a series of waypoints along a designated route. The Vanduul ships in this sector are highly skilled and aggressive, so InterSec highly recommends that you bring several combat-ready ships along as backup.
InterSec understands the immense danger you'll be under on this patrol, so we'll send a special bonus of 24 MG Scrip to the main contractor once the sector is clear.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：人们越来越担心剜度狩猎队伍正在进一步侵入尼克斯。防止这种入侵的第一道防线是加强巡逻。互安已经确定了一个剜度活动增加的区域，正在寻找人员前往该地区进行巡逻并提供最新情况。

你将从发送到 HUD 的位置标记开始巡逻，然后沿着指定的路线扫描各个点。该区域的剜度飞船技术高超且极具攻击性，因此互安强烈建议你带上几艘准备好战斗的飞船作为支援。

互安了解你在这次巡逻中将面临的巨大危险，因此一旦该区域安全，我们将向主承包商发放 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证的特别奖励。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

detail.description_en:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at [LOCATION] and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at [DESTINATION].
This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.
-Bit Zeros
detail.description_zh:
有个我们关注的人最近在 [LOCATION] 那儿挂了（不是咱们干的），我们得搞清楚怎么回事。你去把飞船上的黑匣子拿出来，送到 [DESTINATION] 就行。

顺便说一下，那是个沉船现场，估计会有垃圾佬在那儿转悠。不过别担心，咱们已经把这笔麻烦钱加到你的工资里了。

- 零比特

Received an emergency comm from a ship saying that the Shattered Blade are harassing them. Believe the pilot got their attention by getting a little too close to their territory. The pilot admitted that they don’t have a lot of combat experience, so I’m not sure how much longer they can hold out.
Could you head to [LOCATION] now to help them survive the attack?
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

detail.description_en:
Need a pilot who can hold their own in a dogfight. A Citizens for Prosperity scout ship ran into a problem with the Shattered Blade near [LOCATION]. Must be an area of special interest for them. They launched an attack when our ship got close and don’t seem content simply driving them off. Looks like they’re out for blood.
Any chance you could lend a hand before we lose that ship?
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
需要一名能在空战中表现出色的飞行员。一艘繁荣公民组织的侦察船在 [LOCATION] 附近与碎刃帮组织发生了冲突。这个地区对他们来说似乎特别重要。当我们的飞船靠近时，他们发动了攻击，而且看起来他们并不满足于仅仅将他们赶走，似乎还想要大开杀戒。

在我们失去那艘飞船之前，你能帮一下忙吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: We've just lost contact with a pilot who engaged with Vanduul forces at [LOCATION].
Travel to their last known location and if they're still alive, defend them long enough to ensure they can escape. Ensuring the safety of the operative is crucial, as is eliminating any Vanduul threats to the UEE.
You'll most likely need a strong group of ships to successfully neutralize these Vanduul.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：剜度

前往他们最后已知的位置，如果那人还活着，就保护他直到他能逃离。确保人员安全至关重要，清除任何对 UEE 构成威胁的剜度也是同样。

你很可能需要一支强大的飞船队伍来成功消灭这些剜度敌人。


此致，
迪肯·托宾

detail.description_en:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with [TARGET] in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.
All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to [LOCATION], find [TARGET], and kill them.
Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.
Damn shame.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
这真让我感到悲伤。不知道你在与我们打交道时是否遇到过 [TARGETNAME]。我一直以为他们是个好人。和猎头帮在一起多年，但肯定发生了什么事，他们跑去找繁荣公民求保护了，在这个过程中还背叛了我们的一些兄弟姐妹。

所有法官都怒火中烧，想要血债血偿，这就是你的任务。前往 [LOCATION]，找到 [TARGETNAME]，然后杀了他。

不需要什么花哨的，只要结果。

真他妈可惜。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP50122
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Need an operative to help us potentially prevent a death. An informant has reported an active hit issued for [TARGET] and fears the worst, but the client has hired us like us to look into it.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Last known location was [LOCATION]. Head over there and see if the person mentioned by our client is still with us. If they’re not, examine the body closely so we can report back to them with details of their death.
Additional Notes:
This contract has been flagged as combat-likely so prepare accordingly.

Got a line on a bounty named [TARGET]. Someone spotted them along with known criminal accomplices at [LOCATION]. Need you to get there before they get going.
[TARGET] has a reputation for only showing their face in places with civs. Really need you to take down this bounty without there being any civilian collateral damage. Foxwell can’t afford to be caught in the shitstorm that would erupt over the loss of innocent life.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec requires a skilled contractor to eliminate a highly dangerous group of criminals based in Nyx who are planning a coordinated strike on a prominent member of the UEE Navy.
We have intercepted a crucial piece of intelligence suggesting a known terrorist by the name of [TARGET] intends to carry out this assassination along with the help of local criminal elements.
They are currently located at [LOCATION], making this an ideal time for us to strike. Be warned, these outlaws are experienced killers - bringing a group of trustworthy allies is advised.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安需要一位技术娴熟的承包商消灭盘踞在尼克斯、计划对 UEE 海军一名重要成员发动协同袭击的危险犯罪团伙。

我们截获了一条关键情报，显示一名名为 [TARGETNAME] 的已知恐怖分子正打算联合当地犯罪分子实施这次暗杀。

他们目前位于 [LOCATION]，这正是我们动手的绝佳时机。警告一下，这些不法分子是经验丰富的杀手，建议携带一支 值得信赖的盟友队伍。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

detail.description_en:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGET] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGET] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.
They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION], so you should still be able to find them there.
They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.
Stows out.

missions.name_zh: 临时赏金任务：[TARGET]

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Northrock recently received intel that a bounty who disappeared from Stanton is back. [TARGET] has been spotted at [LOCATION]. Surveillance of the orbital platform indicates that [TARGET] is directing the operation there. Getting to ‘em won’t be easy, but absolutely essential.
We’re determined to not let them get away again. That’s why we’re giving anyone interested the opportunity to apprehend this target. Just be prepared to face fierce resistance.
Best of luck,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

北境之岩最近收到情报，一个从斯坦顿消失的悬赏目标又出现了。[TARGETNAME] 被目击出现在 [LOCATION]。对轨道平台的监视表明，[TARGETNAME] 正在那里指挥行动。抓到他们不会很容易，但是这至关重要。

我们决心不让他们再次逃脱。这就是为什么我们向任何感兴趣的人提供抓捕这个目标的机会。只是要做好面对激烈抵抗的准备。


祝你好运，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

missions.name_zh: 临时逃犯赏金任务
name_notes_zh: 玩家赏金

detail.description_en:
Hey There,
My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract.
You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system.
Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one [TARGET]. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid.
A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.
Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.
Hope to hear from you soon,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
你好，

我叫布雷登·科查多，北境之岩服务团队的后勤官，斯坦顿星系内最大的独立安保公司。我可能已经找过你了，但我们希望能联系上每个达到高标准的人，并去完成我们的临时合约。

成为北境之岩的承包商绝对是你的不二之选。我们良好的声誉能为你提供一些既有趣又不乏挑战性的工作，且报酬高于星系内的其它竞争者。

如果，你想获得认证的话，你需要去抓捕 [TARGETNAME]。他们最近刚从拘留中心里逃出来，而你的工作就是在他们消声灭迹前，把他们抓回去。

有些线索能帮得上忙，可以假设他们此时应该赶着要去清除记录，我建议你在拘留中心的位置，和他们有机会能骇入记录系统的地方进行下三角定位。

搞定这事我再看看能不能安排给你更多的活。

希望尽快收到你的答复，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.
If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.
The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.
Hope to hear from you soon,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

希望你不介意，但我知道你在赏金猎人工会的情况，并想看下你有没有兴趣和我们北境之岩服务团队签订合约，我们是星系内评价最高的私人安保公司之一。

如果你有的话，首先需要你去完成一份临时嫌犯逮捕合约。与其说是评断，其实更像是次机会，来确保我们能有良好的共事关系。

你要找的嫌犯名叫 [TARGETNAME]。他们可是出了名的难以捉摸，所以对你来说会有些困难。

希望尽快收到你的消息，

布雷登·科查多

detail.description_en:
Urgent!
XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe [LOCATION] off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.
I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.
If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.
We believe in you.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
紧急情况！

异种威胁正在准备大规模入侵，企图将 [LOCATION] 从地图上抹去。你是他们唯一的希望，挡下这次攻击，保护他们免受异种威胁的残害。

我知道我是在要求你把自己置身险境，但只有像你这样面对危险能挺身而出的人，才能改变这个星系。再多的钱也抵不上你的壮举带来的益处。

如果你愿意并有能力执行这项任务，一定要带上一些盟友。如果异种威胁发现自己损失惨重，他们肯定会派出更强大的援军。

我们相信你。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
We’ve gotten word that outlaws have their sights set on attacking [LOCATION]. Our client is concerned the attack is imminent and requested that security be deployed to the site immediately. If you’re interested and available, gather all the supplies and support you may need and head to the location pronto.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: One of our pilots is under attack at [LOCATION] and is in need of assistance.
This operative is carrying key information regarding a coordinated attack on key UEE infrastructure and it is vital that they are able to deliver it to us. You and any dependable pilots you can recruit are charged with protecting them from the outlaws in pursuit long enough for them to QT away.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：我们的一名飞行员在 [LOCATION] 受到了攻击，急需援助。

这名特工携带了关于针对 UEE 关键基础设施协同攻击的重要信息，他们必须把信息送到我们手上。你和任何你能招募到的可靠飞行员负责保护他，让他摆脱追击的不法分子，直到他量子航行离开。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

detail.description_en:
Reports indicate that [LOCATION] has come under attack from a group of armed individuals led by a notorious outlaw named [TARGET]. There have been multiple reported deaths and injuries, so Citizens for Prosperity has been looking for qualified combat operatives to provide some support.
Though we don't advocate conflict resolution through violence, we believe that the group will disperse if [TARGET] is not there to lead them.
Head over as soon as you can. Lives are on the line.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
报告显示，[LOCATION] 附近的一个前哨站遭到了由臭名昭著的不法分子 [TARGETNAME] 领导的一群武装人员的攻击。已有多起报告死亡和受伤的事件，因此繁荣公民正在寻找合格的作战人员提供支持。

尽管我们不支持通过暴力解决冲突，但我们相信，如果没有 [TARGETNAME] ，这个团体就会解散。

尽快前往，人命关天。

利玛·恩迪科特

I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at [LOCATION] comm'd to let me know that their <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.
You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any friendly ships unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you.
Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor 3 Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我过得很糟，今天更是雪上加霜。我们位于 [LOCATION] 的利益相关方发来消息，称他们的 [OBJECTS] 正遭到一群无名小卒的攻击，对方企图抢占地盘。

此外，为了表达我的谢意，我将向主承包商额外支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

detail.description_en:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at [LOCATION] comm'd to let me know that their <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.
You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any friendly ships unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you.
Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor 3 Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我过得很糟，今天更是雪上加霜。我们位于 [LOCATION] 的利益相关方发来消息，称他们的 [OBJECTS] 正遭到一群无名小卒的攻击，对方企图抢占地盘。

你得去那里替我保护好该区域，包括任何不幸卷入交火的友方飞船。对于像你这样的人来说，教训这些半吊子应该不算什么难事。

此外，为了表达我的谢意，我将向主承包商额外支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 清除 ASD 服务器
name_notes_zh: 研究翼楼 - 异种科技实验室

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
A client has asked us to infiltrate an old ASD research site and wipe the contents of a few specific servers there.
We believe the servers are located somewhere within the Xenotech Lab, in the Research wing. The client has also informed us that despite the facilities being publicly declared as closed, you're still likely to find hostile forces there.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
detail.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 派遣

合约类型：摧毁服务器
授权代码 = VS-14

需要立即处理

一位客户要求我们潜入一个旧的联合科学与开发公司(ASD)的研究站点，并清除其中几台特定服务器的内容。

我们相信这些服务器位于研究翼楼的异种科技实验室内的某个地方。客户还告知我们，尽管这些设施已被公开宣布关闭，但你仍可能在那里遇到敌对势力。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

missions.name_zh: 清除异种威胁的服务器

detail.description_en:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people.
To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at [LOCATION].
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:
我现在气得眼睛都看不清楚了。一个我本以为可以信任的猎头帮成员居然叛变了，投向了异种威胁。没错，外星人杀了你的家人，这真让人糟心，但你总不能背叛自己的同胞。

更让人恼火的是，这家伙居然把我们的一些情报交给了异种威胁。我让其他人去追踪这个叛徒，但我需要你帮我清除被盗的数据。那些数据存储在 [LOCATION] 的服务器上。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 让人安心
name_notes_zh: 沃恩 - 寻找尸体 VLRT

detail.description_en:
Despite having given the client my word that their target has been dealt with, they are disposed to bouts of paranoia, so they require additional digital evidence of their demise.
I’ll need you to head to [LOCATION] and give the corpse a thorough once over. Whilst I’m confident [TARGET] is taken care of, verification via your mobiGlas will hopefully bring some peace of mind to my client.
I can’t imagine you coming across any significant trouble, but in this line of work, some trouble is always to be expected.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:

detail.description_en:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx
DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.
While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.
Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.
TERMS*:
We are making available the shared mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.
Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a first come, first serve basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
合约：采矿权转让
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
舒宾星际的勘探者们最近发现了一处已被废弃的 QV 行星服务公司碎岩站的位置，该站位于基格小行星带附近。这些站点最初由这家已倒闭的公司用来从小行星内部开采珍贵资源，但其确切位置早已丢失多年。

虽然该站点目前处于离线状态，但我们的侦察队认为，只要进行必要的维修，它就能重新投入使用。此外，一旦将其恢复运行，现场已经有一块富含资源的小行星，随时可以由站点的采矿激光进行开采。

不幸的是，由于在尼克斯运营面临的各种挑战，舒宾手头目前没有足够的宽裕自行处理上述维修工作。但这却为像您这样对独立采矿作业感兴趣的人创造了一个机会。

条款*:
我们提供该 QV 碎岩站站的共享采矿权。购买后，我们将向您及您的船员提供该站点的坐标。（请注意，任何其他有兴趣购买采矿权的人也将获得该站点的访问权限。）随后，您的船员可驾驶采矿飞船前往该地点，将该空间站的采矿激光恢复至运行状态，开采小行星，并在内部获取资源。

请注意，由于这是一份共享合约，所以我们能够以较低的价格提供这些采矿权，但小行星中的资源将与现场的其他采矿人员按先到先得的原则共享。此外，其他感兴趣的各方（如不法分子）也有可能自行发现该空间站的位置。请务必谨慎行事。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen.
Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to [LOCATION] immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.
Stows out.

如果这个小队都这么慌了，那情况肯定很严重。真的需要你立刻去 [LOCATION]，确保他们能安全脱身。

detail.description_en:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted [LOCATION] and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.
We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
尽管我们努力倡导非暴力，但当地的非法团伙依然持续攻击我们的组织。异种威胁最近袭击了 [LOCATION] ，把我们在那里工作的志愿者驱赶了出去。

我们希望招募战斗人员来夺回这个前哨站。理想情况下，我们希望能找个办法促使他们撤退，但异种威胁很快就会通过暴力来解决他们的所有问题，因此毫无疑问会发生一场战斗。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near [LOCATION] that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.
You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out [TARGET], who's in charge of the hostiles on site.
These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
繁荣公民的理事会刚刚批准资金，雇佣安全人员夺回几个位于 [LOCATION] 附近的前哨站集群，这些地方已经落入猎头帮之手。虽然我们曾试图接受这个损失，但显然这些地点对我们在星系中的持续运营至关重要。

你需要清理我们提供的每一个地点，但更重要的是，你还需要解决 [TARGETNAME]，他是现场敌对人员的领导者

。这些猎头帮成员资历很深，且有暴力历史，所以你应该做好相应的准备。

玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
Looking for any available security personnel to reclaim several clusters previously lost to XenoThreat aggressors. Located near [LOCATION], they had been seized in brutal attacks led by [TARGET], a notorious XenoThreat lieutenant.
We're looking to take these clusters back so we can reestablish operations and continue our good work. You'll need to clear all the hostiles still on-site as well as [TARGET].
Just a reminder, that XenoThreat are highly trained and quick to fight, so prepare accordingly.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我们正在寻找任何有空的安全人员，以夺回几个之前陷落于异种威胁侵略者之手的前哨站群。它们位于 [LOCATION]，曾在 [TARGETNAME] 这个臭名昭著的异种威胁中尉的领导下遭到残酷攻击而被夺走。

我们希望重新夺回这些集群，以便重新建立运营，继续我们的工作。你需要清除现场仍在活动的所有敌对人员并击杀 [TARGETNAME]。

请记住，异种威胁训练有素且反应迅速，所以请做好准备。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.
NAME: [TARGET]

LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: Unknown
NOTES: This particular target has proven very difficult to capture. They tend to remain hidden unless there is a big enough threat to demand their attention. That's why you and your most trusted support fleet will need to take out enough of their underlings to force them to confront you. Just stay put, take out any hostiles that show up, and the target will eventually arrive in their capital ship.
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice
The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Cargo Capable Ship, Personal Arms, Heavy-Duty Tractor Beam
Briefing:
Our latest intel shows that the Shattered Blade have replenished their stock of Vanduul corpses and will shortly be transferring them from the old QV Logistics stationthey're operating from to an interested buyer. The UEE can't have another incident like what happened with ASD so they're eager for us to recover the cryopods and deliver them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
While the Shattered Blade members present at the site might offer resistance, they are not the focus of you mission. Deal with them as needed and get the cryopods.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

name_notes_zh: 科瓦莱什 - 取回货物 超级困难 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Only looking for contractors who are the best of the best for this one. One of our most valued clients is expecting an incredibly important shipment which is now seriously overdue.
Here at Covalex, we pride ourselves on treating all of our clients equally, offering outstanding levels of service regardless of what we're delivering. That being said, if we lose this contract someone's gonna be in hot water and I really can't afford for that person to be me.
The tracker is reporting that the last contractor's ship is over at [LOCATION]. Don't take any chances with this one, you'll need a ship that can hold [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to collect it all.
Deliver the shipment to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this whole mess behind us. And you'll make a sizeable heap of credits in the process. Not bad, right?
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

这活儿只找最优秀的承包商来做。我们一位极其重要的客户正等着一批超级关键的货，结果现在严重超期了。

在科瓦莱什，我们向来等对待所有客户，不管送啥都拼尽全力服务到位。但这次要是搞砸了合约，肯定有人要倒大霉，而我真的不希望那个人是我...

追踪器显示，上一任承包商的飞船还在 [LOCATION] 那儿。这单别掉以轻心，你得开一艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞，还得配上一把重型牵引光束，不然根本搬不动。

货一拿到手，立刻送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿。然后咱们就翻篇，而且你还能赚一大笔信用点，挺不错吧？

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

detail.description_en:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.
We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the supplies onto your ship.
Take them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.
Be safe out there,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
一艘繁荣公民的飞船在 [LOCATION] 遭到一伙不法分子伏击，急需一名技术娴熟的飞行员前去支援。

我们中途与他们失联了，但最后听到的通讯里，他们似乎正承受猛烈火力。他们或许已凶多吉少，但他们所运送的关键物资仍有可能派上用场。请立即飞赴现场，清除所有敌对目标，并回收这批货物。你需要驾驶一艘能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，并配备一把 重型牵引光束，以便将物资转运上船。

随后将货物送至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。我保证，这批物资定会物尽其用。

在外务必保重，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens.
We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a [TARGET], was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by [LOCATION]. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.
Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support.
You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of 12 MG Scrip for the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
福克斯韦尔收到一位重要客户的消息，称不法分子组建了一支小队，正在用次主力舰和护航战斗机在星系中游荡。我们的客户担心，如果不加以制止，不法分子会组建更多这样的攻击小队，从而破坏星系安全。我们被雇来在这种情况发生之前消灭这伙人。

我们需要一位自信且技术熟练的承包商来执行这个任务。好消息是我们已经有了计划。这个小队使用的一艘船，一艘 [AMBUSHTARGET]，是从我们的客户那里偷来的，客户仍然能够追踪它的动向。他们与我们分享了位置信息，我们发现这个小队经常在 [LOCATION] 一带活动。我们已经侦察过这个地点，发现一片巨大的辐射云非常适合设下伏击。

老实说，这可不是件容易的事。我们没有额外的力量可供调动，所以最好带上你自己的支援。

要是你能办成这事儿，我已经安排好了给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.
We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at [LOCATION1] and [LOCATION2], but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle 32 SCU cargo containers. It also wouldn't hurt to bring a handheld tractor beam with you.
- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]
- [LOCATION 3]
Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
在旧的哈索尔采矿设施中发生了一些奇怪的事情。平台校准设施和轨道激光平台已经被废弃积灰了几十年，但不法分子开始将它们用作行动基地。

我们受雇于一个相关的客户，他最近被这样一个团伙抢走了大量重要货物。目前，他们的货物被藏在 [LOCATION1] 和 [LOCATION2]，但有人担心这个团伙可能很快就会转移货物。这就是为什么我们被雇佣同时袭击这两座哈索尔设施，从货运电梯取回货物，并将其送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。

以下是每个位置需要取回的具体信息。无论你按什么顺序执行，只要确保所有货物都被收集并送达即可。记得确保你有一艘能处理 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 集装箱的飞船。

而且带上一个手持式牵引光束也没啥坏处。

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

福克斯韦尔还未能侦察这些地点，如果我是你的话，我会预计到会遇到一些严重的武装抵抗。最好带上大量装备和一些朋友。


尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

We are looking for a highly competent mercenary team to assist with a challenging demolition for a VIP client.
The outlaws operating at [LOCATION] has been identified as a threat of growing concern in the area and to help deal with this situation your team is being tasked with taking out the fuel tanks at the location.
However, it won't be as easy as just slipping in and out - expect to deal with multiple hostiles and turrets that will be expecting you. The stronger your crew the better your chances at completing this operation successfully.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

我们正在寻找一支能力出众的佣兵团队，协助一位 VIP 客户执行一项高难度破坏任务。

但切勿掉以轻心，此行动绝非简单潜入撤离。你将面对复数敌对目标及防御炮塔。你的团队实力越强，成功完成任务的把握就越大。

Foxwell have been hired by a client to take part in a multi-stage operation on a known outlaw base at [LOCATION] and need a strong pilot to play their part in this.
You, and whatever additional support ships you arrange, will be tasked with taking out the fuel tanks located there to set the stage for the rest of the operation to follow.
Unfortunately, this place is swarming with ships and anti-air turrets. So make sure you and your people are ready, and remember, the fuel tanks are your priority. No need to be a hero.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

遗憾的是，此地舰船密集、防空炮塔林立，务必确保你和团队做好充分准备。切记燃料罐是首要目标，无需逞英雄。

detail.description_en:
A client needs our help. Outlaws are roaming certain sectors where they do business and attacking anyone they come across. Our client has already lost several ships and can’t afford to lose anymore.
We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the location marker on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan.
From the sound of it, these packs of ships feature skilled and aggressive pilots. Best be ready to rumble if you run into any of them. Would be good to have at least two trusted pilots by your side for this one.
At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 18 MG Scrip.
Stay chilly,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
有位客户急需支援。不法分子正在他们经营区域游荡，见船就打。客户已经损失了好几艘飞船了，再也经不起折腾了。

我们需要人手巡逻这些区域，引出敌对势力。任务从 HUD 上的位置标记开始扫描，之后会给你其他几个巡逻点进行扫描。

据情报，这些飞船团伙的飞行员技术老道且极具攻击性。要是撞见他们，最好做好干架准备。这次行动最好有至少两名值得信赖的飞行员在你身边。

顺利完成巡逻后，主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

保持冷静，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
A crew recently raided a distribution center and made off with [CARGOGRADETOKEN] load of cargo. Foxwell has been hired to get all those goods back. We’re getting reports of these outlaws using old Hathor facilities as stash houses and we believe the stolen items are currently at [LOCATION].
If interested, you’ll need a ship that can handle 32 SCU cargo containers. Doubt you’ll be able to slip in and out of that PAF without being noticed either, so best be prepared to clear the location. Once safe, grab the goods from the freight elevator and deliver them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
It also wouldn't hurt to bring a handheld tractor beam with you.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
一伙不法分子最近袭击了一个配送中心，并抢走了 [CARGOGRADETOKEN] 货物。福克斯韦尔受雇追回所有这些货物。我们收到报告称，这些不法分子正在使用旧的哈索尔设施作为藏匿点，我们相信被盗物品目前位于 [LOCATION]。

如果有兴趣，你需要一艘能处理 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 集装箱的飞船。别指望你能悄无声息地进出那个平台校准设施，所以最好准备好清理该区域。一旦确保安全，从货运电梯取回货物，并将其送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。

而且带上一个手持式牵引光束也没啥坏处。


尤金·沃尔顿

detail.description_en:
Looking for a contractor with the right skills and ship for an important mission. Outlaws ambushed a Hull C carrying a [CARGOGRADETOKEN] load of cargo and took it to [LOCATION]. We’ve been hired to get it all back.
The cargo is being stored somewhere at a defunct Hathor facility. The place is big and crawling with outlaws. Need someone to retrieve the goods from the freight elevator there and deliver it all back to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Don’t think this will be a walk in the park. Bring lots of ammo and a ship that can handle 32 SCU cargo containers.
It also wouldn't hurt to bring a handheld tractor beam with you.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
寻找一位具备合适技能和飞船的承包商来完成一项重要任务。不法分子伏击了一艘载有 [CARGOGRADETOKEN] 货物的货轮 C 飞船，并将其带到了 [LOCATION]。我们受雇将其全部追回。

货物被存放在一座废弃的哈索尔设施中。这个地方很大，且到处都是不法分子。需要有人从那里的货运电梯取回货物，并将其全部送回 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。别以为这会很轻松。带上充足的弹药和一艘能处理 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 集装箱的飞船。

而且带上一个手持式牵引光束也没啥坏处。

detail.description_en:
Ship support is needed at [LOCATION] immediately. Our client’s interests in the area are under fierce attack by outlaw forces. Looking for someone who can grab their gear, a few support ships they can trust, and deploy before it’s too late. Once you arrive, I’ll send any sitrep updates your way.
Don’t mess this up. These clients are paying for and expecting top tier protection. If anything goes wrong, we could lose this contract. That’s why we’ll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip if all goes down without a hitch.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
[DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 急需飞船支援。我们客户在该地区的利益正遭到不法分子的猛烈攻击。我们需要一个能迅速行动的人，带上装备、几艘值得信赖的支援飞船，赶在情况恶化之前部署到位。你到达之后，我会把最新的局势报告发给你。

别搞砸了。这些客户可是花了钱买顶级保护的，他们也期待得到相应的服务。如果出任何差错，我们可能就会丢掉这个合约。所以，如果一切顺利，我们会给主承包商发放 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

Ship support is needed at [LOCATION] immediately. Our client’s interests in the area are under fierce attack by outlaw forces. Looking for someone who can grab their gear, a few support ships they can trust, and deploy before it’s too late. Once you arrive, I’ll send any sitrep updates your way.

Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

detail.description_en:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the location marker on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.
Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least three friends to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.
Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 24 MG Scrip at the end of the patrol.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
需要个身经百战的飞行员执行一个重要巡逻任务。有位大客户受够了不法分子老是袭击他们的飞船和卫星。我们受雇去可疑区域扫描，并解决所有敌对势力。巡逻任务从 HUD 上的位置标记开始，之后还要去其他几个指定地点进行清场。

不清楚会遇上什么，但根据客户提供的情报，那片区域经常有大概 5 到 7 艘飞船组成的战机编队游荡，有时甚至还有大型飞船带队。这意味着你最好为一场恶战做好准备。如果可以的话，尽量招募至少三个朋友加入。即使是经验丰富的飞行员，在对付这群人时也需要所有能得到的帮助。

鉴于这次任务会很棘手，巡逻结束后主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

detail.description_en:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the location marker on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.
Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least three friends to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.
Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 24 MG Scrip at the end of the patrol.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
需要个身经百战的飞行员执行一个重要巡逻任务。有位大客户受够了不法分子老是袭击他们的飞船和卫星。我们受雇去可疑区域扫描，并解决所有敌对势力。巡逻任务从 HUD 上的位置标记开始，之后还要去其他几个指定地点进行清场。

不清楚会遇上什么，但根据客户提供的情报，那片区域经常有大概 5 到 7 艘飞船组成的战机编队游荡，有时甚至还有大型飞船带队。这意味着你最好为一场恶战做好准备。如果可以的话，尽量招募至少三个朋友加入。即使是经验丰富的飞行员，在对付这群人时也需要所有能得到的帮助。

鉴于这次任务会很棘手，巡逻结束后主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
Looking for a consummate professional to handle a high-stakes job. We’ve got VIP clients at [LOCATION] who are facing extremely aggressive and motivated outlaws targeting ships around their location. Exact details on the attack are still rolling in, but it appears to be a wide ranging, multi-pronged operation.
If you’re available, I highly recommend that you bring additional combat support ships, plenty of supplies, and your A-game. Get this right, and we’ll reward the main contractor with a bonus payment of 9 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们在找一位专业老手来处理一项高风险的任务。我们在 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 的 VIP 客户正面临极其凶猛且目标明确的不法分子袭击，他们专门针对客户附近的飞船。关于这次袭击的具体细节还在陆续传来，但看起来是一次范围广泛、多线并进的行动。

如果你有空接下这个任务，我强烈建议你带上额外的战斗支援飞船、充足的物资，并拿出你的最佳状态。如果干得漂亮，我们会给主承包商提供 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

detail.description_en:
Looking for a consummate professional to handle a high-stakes job. We’ve got VIP clients at [LOCATION] who are facing extremely aggressive and motivated outlaws targeting ships around their location. Exact details on the attack are still rolling in, but it appears to be a wide ranging, multi-pronged operation.
If you’re available, I highly recommend that you bring additional combat support ships, plenty of supplies, and your A-game. Get this right, and we’ll reward the main contractor with a bonus payment of 9 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们在找一位专业老手来处理一项高风险的任务。我们在 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 的 VIP 客户正面临极其凶猛且目标明确的不法分子袭击，他们专门针对客户附近的飞船。关于这次袭击的具体细节还在陆续传来，但看起来是一次范围广泛、多线并进的行动。

如果你有空接下这个任务，我强烈建议你带上额外的战斗支援飞船、充足的物资，并拿出你的最佳状态。如果干得漂亮，我们会给主承包商提供 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。
