detail.description_en:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an [TARGET] and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near [LOCATION]. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack.
Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [TARGET] is aggressive and battle hardened.
You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of 16 MG Scrip in it for the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

一旦到达现场，你应该藏身于辐射云中，以足够掩盖你的信号，争取先发制人。不幸的是，福克斯韦尔无法为这次行动提供额外的增援，所以你需要负责带来任何支援力量。你可能也需要帮助。这支 [AMBUSHTARGET] 的队伍非常好斗且战斗经验丰富。

帮我们搞定这事，就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证 当奖励。

detail.description_en:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an [TARGET] and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near [LOCATION]. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack.
Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [TARGET] is aggressive and battle hardened.
You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of 16 MG Scrip in it for the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们收到了一些关于 [AMBUSHTARGET] 及其护航船最近发动攻击的通讯。在打开一个文件后，我们开始追踪这艘船的动向，发现它经常经过靠近 [LOCATION] 的辐射云。我们想利用这一点发起一次突袭。

一旦到达现场，你应该藏身于辐射云中，以足够掩盖你的信号，争取先发制人。不幸的是，福克斯韦尔无法为这次行动提供额外的增援，所以你需要负责带来任何支援力量。你可能也需要帮助。这支 [AMBUSHTARGET] 的队伍非常好斗且战斗经验丰富。

帮我们搞定这事，就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证 当奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en: Urgent ship support needed at [LOCATION]. A known destructive criminal organization has been testing the waters with one of our clients’ property for months, and has now raised hell by targeting the client’s [OBJECTS]. These assets are highly valuable, so need to keep those safe at all costs – though we know it’ll be no easy feat. I cannot stress enough how dangerous these guys are, so I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. If you and the assets make it out intact, we’re offering a well-earned 7 MG Scrip to the main contractor. Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
[LOCATION] 急需飞船支援。一个臭名昭著的破坏性犯罪组织已盯上我们一位客户的财产长达数月，如今更是变本加厉，直接攻击该客户的 [OBJECTS]。这些资产非常有价值，必须不惜一切代价确保其安全，尽管我们也清楚这绝非易事。

我不得不强调，这些人极度危险，因此我会毫不犹豫地呼叫增援来对付他们。如果你能带着资产全身而退，我们将向成功完成此任务的主承包商提供一份实至名归的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en: Urgent ship support needed at [LOCATION]. A known destructive criminal organization has been testing the waters with one of our clients’ property for months, and has now raised hell by targeting the client’s [OBJECTS]. These assets are highly valuable, so need to keep those safe at all costs – though we know it’ll be no easy feat. I cannot stress enough how dangerous these guys are, so I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. If you and the assets make it out intact, we’re offering a well-earned 7 MG Scrip to the main contractor. Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

我不得不强调，这些人极度危险，因此我会毫不犹豫地呼叫增援来对付他们。如果你能带着资产全身而退，我们将向成功完成此任务的主承包商提供一份实至名归的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

detail.description_en: Urgent ship aid needed at [LOCATION]. A band of destructive criminal outlaws that have been trying to make a name for themselves recently has struck hard against one of our high priority clients, attacking their ships and targeting the client's [OBJECTS]. It will be your job to keep everyone and everything safe – though it won't be an easy feat. I cannot stress enough how dangerous these attackers are, so be sure to bring backup to deal with them. If you, the crew, and the infrastructures make it out intact, we’re offering a generous sum of 6 MG Scrip to the main contractor. Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
[LOCATION] 急需飞船援助。一群近期试图进行破坏性犯罪扬名立万的不法分子，对我们的一位高优先级客户发起了猛烈攻击，袭击其飞船并企图掠夺其 [OBJECTS]。你的任务是确保所有人及所有设施的安全 - 但这绝非易事。

我必须强调这些袭击者极其危险，务必增派援军来对付他们。如果你、船员以及基础设施都能毫发无损地脱险，我们将向主承包商提供一笔丰厚的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en: Urgent ship aid needed at [LOCATION]. A band of destructive criminal outlaws that have been trying to make a name for themselves recently has struck hard against one of our high priority clients, attacking their ships and targeting the client's [OBJECTS]. It will be your job to keep everyone and everything safe – though it won't be an easy feat. I cannot stress enough how dangerous these attackers are, so be sure to bring backup to deal with them. If you, the crew, and the infrastructures make it out intact, we’re offering a generous sum of 6 MG Scrip to the main contractor. Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
[LOCATION] 急需飞船援助。一群近期试图进行破坏性犯罪扬名立万的不法分子，对我们的一位高优先级客户发起了猛烈攻击，袭击其飞船并企图掠夺其 [OBJECTS]。你的任务是确保所有人及所有设施的安全 - 但这绝非易事。

我必须强调这些袭击者极其危险，务必增派援军来对付他们。如果你、船员以及基础设施都能毫发无损地脱险，我们将向主承包商提供一笔丰厚的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝你好运，

detail.description_en: An emergency contract just came through about a gang of violent thugs wreaking havoc on one of our VIP clients’ infrastructures. If available, we need you to rush to [LOCATION] and defend the client’s extremely valuable [OBJECTS] at all costs. Foxwell is extremely aware of this group, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to survive the encounter with the client’s property intact, we’re adding 9 MG Scrip any main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

detail.description_en: An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [LOCATION] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s [OBJECTS] and of their ships that may need assistance. This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering 6 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
来自福克斯韦尔一位 VIP 客户旗下的维护团队发出了紧急求救信号。如有可能，请立即前往[LOCATION]。在应对袭击者时，你需要全力保护客户的 [OBJECTS] 及其可能需要援助的飞船。

这些不法分子此前已多次作案，相信我，绝不能轻视他们的飞行技术。我强烈建议你安排一支高度专业的增援部队与你一同飞往现场。

如果你能成功捍卫客户利益，我们将向敢于接下此任务的勇敢主承包商支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

注意安全，祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en: An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to [LOCATION] as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s [OBJECTS] and of their ships that may need assistance. This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering 6 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
来自福克斯韦尔一位 VIP 客户旗下的维护团队发出了紧急求救信号。如有可能，请立即前往[LOCATION]。在应对袭击者时，你需要全力保护客户的 [OBJECTS] 及其可能需要援助的飞船。

这些不法分子此前已多次作案，相信我，绝不能轻视他们的飞行技术。我强烈建议你安排一支高度专业的增援部队与你一同飞往现场。

如果你能成功捍卫客户利益，我们将向敢于接下此任务的勇敢主承包商支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

注意安全，祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们正在为一项货运任务发愁，急需一位有在危险环境作业经验的可靠承包商来完成这项工作。提前提醒你，货物位于一艘废弃飞船上，周围有多个极其危险的不法分子。我们强烈建议你带些帮手，并自带重型牵引光束来取回客户货物。详情如下：

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

由于这项任务有一定风险，我们提供相应的报酬。至于具体如何分配给你的组员，由你自行决定。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们正在为一项货运任务发愁，急需一位有在危险环境作业经验的可靠承包商来完成这项工作。提前提醒你，货物位于一艘废弃飞船上，周围有多个极其危险的不法分子。我们强烈建议你带些帮手，并自带重型牵引光束来取回客户货物。详情如下：

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

由于这项任务有一定风险，我们提供相应的报酬。至于具体如何分配给你的组员，由你自行决定。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a heavy-duty tractor beam are highly recommended.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
The cargo should be in the bay of the abandoned ship. The client has already expressed frustration regarding the cargo’s delay so please work quickly and efficiently.
BE RESILIENT – Life is hard and sometimes you have to roll with the punches. Keep going and don’t let it bring you down.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

召集一名技术高超的飞行员，回收我们客户的货物。仅限有处理涉及多名敌对目标的极端危险情况经验者接取本合约。强烈建议携带额外机组人员和一把重型牵引光束。

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

货物应该在那艘废弃飞船的货舱里。客户已经对货物的延误表达了不满，所以请迅速高效地完成任务。

坚强些 - 生活不易，有时你得学会挨打不倒。继续前进，别让它击垮你。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We appreciate how hard you’ve been working for us recently, which is why we’d like to offer you this advanced contract. An important client of ours is waiting for delivery on multiple packages but the courier due to deliver them is no longer responding. The package trackers are showing that they’re at [LOCATION], meaning we have some time to recover the delivery.
PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 5x [ITEM1]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Deliver to [DESTINATION]
We cannot stress enough how important the success of this delivery is. Since we do not know what happened to the original courier, we strongly urge you to travel with several trustworthy combat pilots.
Needless to say, we’re offering a substantial payout for this one proportionate to the danger of the contract.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
detail.description_zh:

要找回的包裹
     · 5x [ITEM1]

卸货地点
     · 送至 [DESTINATION]

我们再怎么强调这次送货成功的重要性都不为过。由于我们不知道原快递员发生了什么，强烈建议你带上几位值得信赖的战斗飞行员一同前往。

不用说，这次任务的报酬会非常高，与任务的危险程度相匹配。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”

我们的一名货运司机在运输货物时发动机出了故障，被迫弃船。现寻找承包商打捞货物并完成交付。你需自带重型牵引光束，将货物转运到你的飞船上。详情如下。

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

请注意，打捞地点的安全性尚未确认。你可能会遇到趁火打劫的不法分子企图抢走货物，务必提高警惕。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们的一名货运司机在运输货物时发动机出了故障，被迫弃船。现寻找承包商打捞货物并完成交付。你需自带重型牵引光束，将货物转运到你的飞船上。详情如下。

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

请注意，打捞地点的安全性尚未确认。你可能会遇到趁火打劫的不法分子企图抢走货物，务必提高警惕。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Red Wind is excited to announce that we are looking to hire new couriers to help with deliveries across the ’verse. We pride ourselves on been a flexible company that’s eager to meet the needs of all clients, everywhere. We’ll ask no questions; if you want it there, we’ll get it there. If that sounds like you, we have an introductory contract to see if you’re the right fit.
We need a resilient new hire to head to [LOCATION], recover the package abandoned by a former employee, and finish the delivery.

· 1x [ITEM1]

· Deliver to [DESTINATION]

我们需要一位坚韧的新员工前往 [LOCATION]，取回前员工遗弃的包裹，并完成最终配送。

要找回的包裹
     · 1x [ITEM1]

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Red Wind is looking to bolster our roster of haulers. Need someone who can keep their wits about them and keep quiet. If you check those boxes, and have a ship that can handle 4 SCU cargo containers, then give this trial run a shot.
PICK UP
Freight elevator at [LOCATION].
DROP OFF
Freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Complete this contract and we’ll send more hauling opportunities your way. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

红风物流希望在派罗地区增强我们的运输队伍。我们需要一个能够保持头脑冷静，并且知道何时保持沉默的人。如果你符合这些条件，并且有一艘能够应付大约 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱货物的飞船，那么就来试试这个试用合约吧。

取货
位于 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯

送货
位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

完成这个合约后，我们会给你更多的运输机会。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.
HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

我们为最优秀的承包商准备了一项特殊任务。我们的一名运输员不幸遇难，未能完成最后一单任务。他原本要运送的货物，现在仍静静躺在他那艘飞船里，位置如下。

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

我不会和你绕弯子，这是一项极其艰巨的任务。你需要带一支实力强劲的飞行员团队，去应对杀死上一位承包商的不法分子，并配备一台重型牵引光束来取回客户的货物。不过，如果你接下这份合约，我们一定会让你觉得值得。

我们做得如何 - 请在我们的光谱页面完成简短的反馈调查，有机会参与我们的月度抽奖。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
The pilot reported multiple hostiles so make sure you take this seriously.
EVERY OPPORTUNITY COUNTS – Make the most of what’s given to you, show us that you can handle more work.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

红风运输的一艘货船遭到不法分子伏击，客户货物现在停在原地，对方正准备劫走。我们需要一名飞行员，装备上重型牵引光束和能战斗的飞船，前往下方地点，在货物彻底丢失前将其夺回。

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

飞行员报告称有多个敌对目标，务必认真对待。

每一个机会都至关重要，充分利用现有资源，向我们证明你能胜任更多任务。

detail.description_en:
There is a group of outlaws at [LOCATION] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system.
To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves.
Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.
Thanks,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
在 [LOCATION] 有一群不法分子，他们在攻击繁荣公民的资产时变得越来越猖狂。

为了尽量减少人员伤亡，我们希望通过破坏他们的发电机和摧毁他们的燃料储备，先尝试说服他们离开，去别的地方。

希望这样足以让他们放弃，去别的“好地方”。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
There is a group of outlaws at [LOCATION] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system.
To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves.
Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.
Thanks,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
在 [LOCATION] 有一群不法分子，他们在攻击繁荣公民的资产时变得越来越猖狂。

为了尽量减少人员伤亡，我们希望通过破坏他们的发电机和摧毁他们的燃料储备，先尝试说服他们离开，去别的地方。

希望这样足以让他们放弃，去别的“好地方”。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
We’ve been monitoring a situation at [LOCATION] regarding an uptick in the [CREATURE] population over the past few months. Our models indicate that if this continues many of the native plants and animals will be adversely affected. It’s imperative that the [CREATURE] population is reduced before that happens.
If you can help, please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for more specifics on the targeted creature.
Best,
Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
detail.description_zh:
我们一直在监测 [LOCATION] 的情况，过去几个月 [CREATURE] 的数量有所增加。我们的模型显示，如果这种情况持续下去，许多本地植物和动物将受到不利影响。在此之前，必须减少 [CREATURE] 的数量。

如果您能提供帮助，请参阅《斯坦顿野生动物指南》。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

detail.description_en:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
Best,
Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
detail.description_zh:
若您近期有任务需前往基格小行星带的任一老旧 QV 碎岩站，我们另有一项工作希望您顺道协助。

我们近日接到人民联盟的请求，协助推进一项计划：为修复这些废弃空间站做前期准备。遗憾的是，瓦拉卡种群的入侵已严重破坏站内基础设施，并极大降低了其未来重启的可能性。鉴于瓦拉卡属入侵物种，经评估，清除其种群实为唯一可行方案。

请在任一老旧 QV 碎岩站内削减瓦拉卡数量，任务完成后我们将支付相应报酬。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

detail.description_en:
Hey there,
If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.
A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.
Waiting to hear from you,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club

Hey there,
If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.
A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.
Waiting to hear from you,
Dina Deloit

detail.description_en:
Hey there,
If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.
A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.
Waiting to hear from you,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

detail.description_en:
Hey there,
If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.
A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.
Waiting to hear from you,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
你好啊，

如果你加装了加油设备，可能会喜欢这个任务。

一个信标刚刚在 [LOCATION] 附近上线。是一位客户的委托，他的 [SHIP] 需要 [FUELTYPE]

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

看起来是个零麻烦、一次搞定就完事的活，但保持扫描器开启总没坏处。
如有兴趣请告知，我们好让这些人顺利启程。

静候佳音，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
Hey there,
If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one.
A beacon has just gone live at [LOCATION], from a client whose [SHIP] is in need of [FUELTYPE], so make sure your pods are topped off.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.
Waiting to hear from you,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
你好啊，

如果你加装了加油设备，可能会喜欢这个任务。

看起来是个零麻烦、一次搞定就完事的活，但保持扫描器开启总没坏处。
如有兴趣请告知，我们好让这些人顺利启程。

静候佳音，

missions.name_zh: 清除星区的新兴帮派
name_notes_zh: 繁荣公民 - 击杀飞船 MRT 多波次

detail.description_en:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [LOCATION] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises.
Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.
Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
总感觉每当我们在星系中刚取得实质性进展，不法分子就会跳出来让我们往回退一步。我们不久前才刚肃清 [LOCATION]，却得知一支新的不法团伙已在此扎根，并将其作为各类犯罪活动的跳板。

鉴于我们无法容忍这种腐化继续蔓延，现指派你携数艘支援飞船前往该地，彻底清除所有帮派成员。每击溃一股敌军编队后，请务必耐心等待，直至所有敌对势力均被歼灭为止。

要知道，你正在做出真正的贡献，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.
We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.
Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.
And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
有一队飞船最近劫了我们的运输舰队，我赌十块钱他们还会再来。想找人在那之前给他们给他们点颜色看看。

已经确认这帮蠢货由几艘大船和一艘护卫舰组成。领队开的是 [AMBUSHTARGET]，就把它定为首要目标。既然对方人多势众又穷凶极恶，搞突袭才是上策。他们常经过 [LOCATION] 那片带辐射云的星域——藏好身形，伺机而动。

除非你自认是王牌飞行员，否则最好带几个帮手。不妨告诉来帮忙的人，干完这票可以在可以在残骸里随便捡值钱货。

更重要的是，我还会额外奖励给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为甜头。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.
We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.
Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.
And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

更重要的是，我还会额外奖励给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为甜头。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.
The fools are operating from [LOCATION]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.
- Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
一些混蛋拒绝支付我们应得的报酬。问题是，这些蠢货还到处炫耀。要是他们保持沉默的话我们还能用更有效方法解决这个问题，但现在我们需要给他们个下马威。

这帮蠢货在 [LOCATION]。我们需要他们全部消失，动静越大越好，等所有人都处理干净了，我们会把你的报酬发过去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

name_notes_zh: 玲家快递 - 取回货物 中等难度 无战斗

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.
One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at [LOCATION]. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers to complete the haul for us.
Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. And I probably don't have to say this, but a heavy-duty tractor beam would probably be handy to have along.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

有个挺简单的活儿，你要是有兴趣的话。

我们一个飞行员没当回事，直接无视了维护警报，结果几小时后，飞船真在 [LOCATION] 那儿抛锚了。人现在正回办公室路上，但我们需要个靠谱的运输员，开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱 的大船，帮我们把这趟货拉完。

你觉得能搭把手不？先去把滞留的货取走，再送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行。我猜不用多说你也知道，带个重型牵引光束肯定更方便。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

detail.description_en:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:
Your priority is to disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.
Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces.
Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission.
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
很高兴你能为北境之岩执行这项行动。以下是完整简报：

你的首要任务是摧毁三台敌我识别转换器（IFFI），这些设备正阻碍十字军安保部队进入平台周边的空域。一旦转换器下线，十字军便能派遣飞船进场并重新夺回平台控制权。在此期间，各平台之间通过一系列不受转换器影响的穿梭机相连，这将是你们在平台间移动的主要交通工具。

请注意，随着行动推进，你将遭遇猛烈抵抗。十字军曾多次尝试自行处理此次入侵，但至今未果。不过，我们坚信一支精干的突击小队将能更有效地对付九尾的兵力。

此外，本着全面合作的精神，十字军已授权你自由使用任何在任务中发现、可能对任务有帮助的资源。

祝你好运，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

detail.description_en:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near [LOCATION] from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by [TARGET] and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.
Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that [TARGET] tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.
XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
重新夺回位于 [LOCATION] 附近的几个前繁荣公民设施，这些设施目前被猎头帮控制。这些区域曾被 [TARGETNAME] 暴力夺走，导致众多志愿者遇难。

重新让我们掌控这些前哨站将有助于为星系带来更多稳定。报告显示，[TARGETNAME] 通常会藏在他下属的背后，因此在大部分敌对力量被清除后，他们才可能会出现。

猎头帮受过训练且脑子一根筋，所以他们不会轻易放弃。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

detail.description_en:
You got a ship and a heavy-duty tractor beam? Good. I’ve got work for you.
Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at [LOCATION]. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.
Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.
Get the goods to the freight elevator to [DESTINATION] and I’ll send your payment.
-Twitch
detail.description_zh:
你有船，还有重型牵引光束？行，我有活儿找你。

不知道那帮人咋知道咱们要来，我一个运输队在 [LOCATION] 被人伏击了，飞行员彻底失联，八成凉了，但货的追踪器还停在原地没动。

我猜干掉飞行员那帮混蛋肯定还蹲在那儿，带点人手去，捞了货就跑别硬刚，别再搭上好货船了。

把货送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，钱立马打你账上。

- 刺痛

Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.
The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we update our intel.
We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old QV Logistics station.
The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the encrypted data and use the decryption key to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.
Good luck. We’ll be in touch.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：存在武装不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船、单兵武装
战斗简报：互安防务再次需要你的帮助。

你之前收集的情报在识别数名非法获取的剜度部件买主方面至关重要。但自那以后，碎刃帮仍在继续活动，而 UEE 要求我们更新情报。

我们相信，在旧的 QV 物流空间站的储存设施中，还能获取更多线索。

这次行动的参数与你上一次任务相同：找到加密数据，并使用解密密钥解密后上传清单给我们。碎刃帮自上次之后必定加强了该区域的防御，做好应对抵抗的准备。

祝你好运，我们会再联系你。

此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Have a run here that could become a lucrative regular thing if we can pull it off. This’ll take you into Pyro, so you’ll have to be ready to tangle with some of the locals.
You’ll need to grab the stuff from [LOCATION], make the jump to Pyro, and then get to [DESTINATION].
All you need to do is bring a ship with space for 24 SCU cargo containers, a handheld tractor beam, and be ready to do some damage if someone picks a fight with you.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

这儿有个活儿，要是能稳住就能变成个长期赚钱的买卖。这趟得进派罗，你得准备好跟当地那些人干一架。

你得先到 [LOCATION] 提货，跃迁到派罗，再赶到 [DESTINATION]。

你只需要一艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，带个手持式牵引光束，要是有人找茬，也别怂，该打就打。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Got a contract from a major client who needs a skilled pilot to move a large load of luxury items from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].
You'll need room for at least 8 SCU cargo containers in your hold. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to get everything loaded and unloaded.
And as a fair warning, the things you'll be carrying are pricey enough that you might attract some unwanted attention. Be ready to defend yourself if you can't evade.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”

我接到了一位大客户的合约，需要一位技术娴熟的飞行员把一批高档货从 [LOCATION] 运到 [DESTINATION]。

你的货舱至少得能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，还得带个手持式牵引光束，方便装卸货。

顺便提醒你，你运的这玩意儿贵得离谱，很可能引来不速之客。如果躲不开，做好自卫准备。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Red Wind needs an experienced pilot to transport a large shipment of raw revenant tree pollen from [LOCATION] to these locations:
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]
This might seems self-evident, but the rep from CFP asked us to assure you that it's okay under UEE law to transport revenant tree pollen as long as it hasn't been processed.
Be sure that your ship can carry up to 16 SCU cargo containers before you accept the contract. And buy a handheld tractor beam if you don't have one already to make loading and unloading as painless as possible.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”

卸货地点（任意顺序）

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

这事儿可能显而易见，但繁荣公民的代表特别提醒你：只要花粉未经加工，根据 UEE 法律，运输是完全合法的。

接单前请确认你的飞船能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱。如果没有手持式牵引光束，赶紧买一个，装卸起来能省不少劲儿。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
CFP has an urgent request for a pilot with combat experience. A few of their settlements are under immediate threat and may soon be under attack, so they need supplies ASAP.
If you're confident that you can navigate a potential combat zone, please head to [LOCATION], grab the cargo, and bring it to these locations:
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]
You'll need enough room for 16 SCU cargo containers, and your own handheld tractor beam to get everything loaded and unloaded.
Keep in mind that it's always best to run if someone tries to ambush you. But if you get cornered, don't hesitate to defend yourself.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

繁荣公民急需一位有战斗经验的飞行员。他们几个前哨站正面临直接威胁，随时可能遭袭，急需物资支援。

如果你有信心穿越潜在的交火区，请前往 [LOCATION] 取货，然后运往以下地点：

卸货地点（任意顺序）

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

你的飞船必须能得装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，并自带手持式牵引光束，方便装卸。

记住，要是有人想伏击你，跑路永远是上策。但真被逼到墙角，别犹豫，直接还手。

Got a request from a farmer in Pyro for specialized agricultural supplies - namely, ranta dung. Apparently, normal fertilizers aren't cutting it. They've put in orders from multiple distributors and need someone to bring everything back to [DESTINATION].
Here are all the places you can collect the dung:
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]
The client says your ship needs to be able to carry at least 8 SCU cargo containers. Don't forget to bring your own handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading.

以下是你可以收集有机粪便的地点（任意顺序）：

- [LOCATION 1]
- [LOCATION 2]

----------------------------

detail.description_en:
Greetings,
Unfortunately, I've just received word that one of RSI's Discovery Month host locations has been attacked by a group of outlaws. Fortunately, the criminals in question left a rather messy trail of evidence behind allowing us to easily track down their location.
We need a contractor to head to [LOCATION] and deal with the criminals on site before they can strike again.
Arm yourself appropriately and be wary.
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
向您问候，

很遗憾，我刚收到消息，RSI 探索月的一个承办地点遭到了一群不法分子的袭击。好在这帮家伙留下了一堆乱七八糟的证据，让我们能轻松追踪到他们的位置。

我们需要一名承包商前往 [LOCATION]，趁他们还没再次动手，就地解决这帮不法分子。

装备好自己，多加小心。

祝你好运，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员
北境之岩服务团队

missions.name_zh: RSI 探索月：提供星座租用
name_notes_zh: 运输任务 - 投递 250点

detail.description_en:
Calling all RSI Enthusiasts!
A core value of Robert Space Industries is exploration and adventure - and in keeping with that - we are thrilled to provide all pilots with the chance to test fly the new RSI Constellation Mk V!
All you have to do is collect the Golden Constellation box from the plinth at one of our special event locations and deliver it to another RSI Event Platform. Once you've done that, you'll be able to enjoy the test flight period. It’s as simple as that!
The Constellation Mk V is one of RSI's most versatile ships to date. Featuring four S5 weapons, two remote turrets, and 240 SCU of cargo storage, this ship caters for all kinds of adventures.
We hope you enjoy this opportunity to experience the future of spaceflight first hand and that it will be just the first of many more adventures to come.
Enjoy your journey,
Christoph Roester
RSI Community Outreach Manager
---
Roberts Space Industries
Delivering the Stars since 2075
detail.description_zh:
呼叫所有 RSI 爱好者！

探索与冒险，是罗伯茨太空工业的核心价值——正因如此，我们非常激动地要让所有飞行员都有机会试飞全新的 RSI 星座 Mk V！

你只需要从我们某个特别活动地点的基座取走金色星座包装盒，再把它送到另一个 RSI 活动平台。完成后，你就能享受这段试飞期了。就这么简单！

星座 Mk V 是 RSI 迄今为止用途最广的飞船之一。它配备四门 S5 武器、两座遥控炮塔，以及 240 SCU 的货舱容量，它能应对各种各样的冒险。

希望你能享受这次亲身体验未来太空飞行的机会，也希望这只是未来众多冒险中的第一段。

祝您旅途愉快，

克里斯托夫·罗斯特
RSI 社区外联活动经理
---
罗伯茨太空工业
自 2075 年，为你摘下星辰

missions.name_en: RSI Disc. Month: Critical Refuel Request ([SHIP])
missions.name_zh: RSI 探索月：特别紧急加油请求 ([SHIP])
name_notes_zh: 运输任务 - 燃料补给 HRT 271点

detail.description_en:
Hey there,
Got another beacon if you've got the time. The folks at RSI have just been in touch to say that due to a ""communication issue between staff members"" their engine has run dry, and they need to moving again pronto. The [SHIP] is located over at [LOCATION] and will need topping up with [FUELTYPE].
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Of all the places for them to run dry, they couldn't have picked a worse one. I don't want to make you nervous or anything, but I'd recommend bringing a buddy with you to watch your back.
You take care of each other out there, okay? Make sure you come back in one piece.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
""We’ve got your back""
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

要是有空的话，这又有一个信标。RSI 的人刚联系我说，因为“员工之间的沟通问题”，他们的引擎燃油耗尽了，得马上重新动起来。那艘 [SHIP] 就停在 [LOCATION]，需要加满 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

他们偏偏挑了个最烂的地方把油耗光了。我不想吓你，不过还是建议你带上个同伴，帮你盯着点背后。

在外头彼此照应，好吗？一定要平安回来。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

name_notes_zh: 防卫任务 - 消灭人员 LRT 125点

detail.description_en:
Greetings,
A high value criminal named [TARGET] has recently been spotted for the first time in several months and we've been hired to intercept them. With a long history of ship theft and homicide, it seems far too coincidental for them to just suddenly make a reappearance considering the number of high value ships on display at the current RSI Discovery Month event locations.
Our analysts have reported their last known location was [LOCATION]. We are seeking a contractor to track them down and eliminate them.
Payment and additional work to follow upon your success.
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
向您问候，

一名名叫 [TARGETNAME] 的重犯，最近几个月来首次现身，我们受雇前去拦截他们。此人长期以来盗船、杀人，劣迹斑斑，考虑到眼下 RSI 探索月的活动地点正展出一批高价值飞船，他们偏偏在这时候突然露面，实在不像是巧合。

missions.name_zh: RSI 探索月：高价值包裹取回行动
name_notes_zh: 运输任务 - 物品取回FPS HRT 313点

detail.description_en:
Greetings,
Requesting a contractor with strong combat experience for a challenging package retrieval operation.
A courier contracted by RSI has unfortunately been eliminated by a group of known outlaws in the system. The speed and execution of this attack suggests this was not by happenstance, and instead a coordinated and targeted attack with the intention of stealing whatever valuables are within that package.
RSI had the good sense to install a tracker in the package, leading us to believe the outlaws who stole it are located at [LOCATION]. Information regarding their hideout is sparse, but we would strongly advise bringing back up and arming yourself appropriately.
In the interest of minimizing disruption to the RSI Discovery Event, it has been requested that you deliver the package directly to [DESTINATION].
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
向您问候，

现招募一名具备丰富战斗经验的承包商，执行一项颇具挑战性的包裹取回行动。

一名受 RSI 委托的快递员不幸在星系中被一伙已知的不法分子杀害。这次袭击的速度与执行手法表明，此事绝非偶然，而是一次有组织、有预谋的针对性袭击，目的就是窃取包裹内的贵重物品。

RSI 还算机灵，在包裹里装了追踪器，让我们得以判断偷走包裹的不法分子就在 [LOCATION]。关于他们藏身处的信息不多，但我们强烈建议你带上后援，并做好相应的武装准备。

为尽量不影响 RSI 探索活动，已要求你把包裹直接送到 [DESTINATION]。

祝你好运，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员
北境之岩服务团队

detail.description_en:
Hiya,
We've been given a really important task by RSI to deliver some crucial goods for their Discovery Month event and I need our best contractors on this one.
We have a ton of supplies moved from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].
If you think you're up to the task, go ahead and accept this contract, get a ship that can carry 16 SCU, and grab your handheld tractor beam. All pick ups and drop offs are done by freight elevators.
Good luck and safe travels!
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
detail.description_zh:
嗨呀，

RSI 给了我们一个相当重要的任务，要为他们的探索月活动运送一些关键货物，而我需要我最得力的承包商上阵。

我们有一大批物资要从 [LOCATION] 运到 [DESTINATION]。

如果你觉得自己能胜任，就接下这份合约，弄一艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，再带上你的 手持牵引光束。所有取货和卸货都通过货运电梯完成。

祝你好运，一路平安！

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Not often we get to work with RSI, so pretty honored they offered this job to us.
Got some party supplies that need delivering from [LOCATION] to their new pop-up event at [DESTINATION].
Your ship will need to be able to carry 4 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam would be highly recommended to move the boxes.
Thanks,
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

你的飞船得能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，另外强烈建议带上一个 手持牵引光束 来搬箱子。

感谢，
康妮·玲
运输协调员
玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

detail.description_en:
RSI are hosting a Discovery Month event and are contracting security services to provide some additional protection. There's gonna be a lot of high value items at each of these locations, so we need people doing regular patrols to make sure it goes off without a hitch.
Start by flying out to the patrol point on your HUD. Got a few places for you to scan before we can report back to the client that everything's safe.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

detail.description_en:
Foxwell needs a contractor to help save an RSI ship from a group of outlaws. They hired us to protect a ship for their Discovery event and the whole thing is turning into a mess. The original escorts we sent are not responding to comms and we need someone to take control of this situation ASAP.
We have reports of multiple hostiles at their current location, [LOCATION], and there's likely to be more on their way.
Good luck out there,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

有报告称他们当前所在位置 [LOCATION] 有多名敌人，而且很可能还有更多敌人正在赶去。

name_notes_zh: 防卫任务 - 巡逻 HRT 417点

detail.description_en:
The RSI Discovery Month event has been attracting the wrong kind of attention it seems. RSI's is worried there's a potential attack brewing and has contracted us to patrol the area.
Head over to the patrol point on your HUD to begin your sweep. Once you've scanned all the areas and dealt with any potential threats, we'll ping the client to make sure they're happy, then we can send you your creds.
Based on some of the patrols conducted so far, I would strongly recommend bringing some wingmen to watch your back.
Be careful out there,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:

到 HUD 上的 巡逻点 开始你的清扫。等你把所有区域都扫描完，处理掉任何潜在威胁，我们就通知客户，确认他们满意，然后就能把你的报酬打给你了。

从目前进行的几次巡逻来看，我强烈建议你带上几架 僚机 帮你盯着点背后。

在外小心点，

尤金·沃尔顿

detail.description_en:
In search of a contractor to help us out of a tight spot.
We were hired by RSI to escort their ship to the Discovery event that's going on, but the moment the group dropped out of quantum, outlaws took out the escort. All we know is that their last known location was [LOCATION], but that's about it.
Not for the faint of heart this one, so bring back up and don't skimp on weapons. You'll need to cover them long enough so they can quantum to safety.
Good luck out there,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们正在找一位承包商，帮我们摆脱困境。

RSI 雇我们护送他们的飞船前往正在举办的发现活动，可就在队伍退出量子跃迁的那一刻，不法分子就把护航队干掉了。我们只知道他们最后已知的位置在 [LOCATION]，除此之外就没了。

这活儿可不适合胆小的人，所以带上后援，武器上千万别吝啬。你得掩护他们足够长的时间好让他们量子到安全地带。

祝你在外面好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
Greetings,
Outlaws have conducted a targeted attack on a courier that was due to deliver a crucial package to one of the RSI Discovery Event locations. Contact has since been lost with the pilot, but the tracker still appears to be functional. It is crucial that we act now whilst the trail is still warm.
Scanners are suggesting the package is located somewhere at [LOCATION]. Whilst we have no intel on the situation on the ground, what we do know is that you should expect resistance. Ensure you are well prepared and prioritize the retrieval of the package.
After you have successfully extracted the package, deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
向您问候，

不法分子对一名快递员发动了针对性袭击，该快递员本应将一个关键包裹送往某处 RSI 探索活动地点。此后我们便与飞行员失去了联系，但追踪器似乎仍在正常工作。趁着线索还没冷，我们必须立刻行动，这一点至关重要。

扫描仪显示，包裹就在 [LOCATION] 的某处。虽然我们对当地的情况一无所知，但可以确定的是，你将会遭遇抵抗。务必做好充分准备，并把取回包裹放在首位。

成功取出包裹后，将其送往 [DESTINATION]。

祝你好运，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员
北境之岩服务团队

We've tracked the package to [LOCATION]. We require a skilled contractor to enter the location, recover the package, and dispatch any hostiles that might inhibit the success of this operation.
Once recovered, the package is to be delivered to [DESTINATION].
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group

我们追踪到包裹在 [LOCATION]。我们需要一位身手了得的承包商进入该地点，取回包裹，并清除任何可能妨碍本次行动成功的敌人。

取回后，包裹需送往 [DESTINATION]。

missions.name_zh: RSI 探索月：加油请求 ([SHIP])
name_notes_zh: 运输任务 - 燃料补给 LRT 104点

detail.description_en:
Hey!
If you're top notch refueller, this job might just interest you.
Picked up a beacon at [LOCATION] from a client who's flying a [SHIP] and needs [FUELTYPE] to help them out of a pinch. Looks like they were heading to that fancy new RSI Discovery location and forgot to refuel along the way. If I had a cred for every time I did that - well, let's just say I wouldn't be working here anymore!
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Can't imagine you'll run into any trouble, but that's exactly the kind of thing people say in those old vids right before they do. So keep an eye out for danger.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
""We’ve got your back""
detail.description_zh:
嘿！

如果你是个顶尖的加油员，这份活儿说不定正合你胃口。

我在 [LOCATION] 收到一个信标，客户开着一艘 [SHIP]，需要 [FUELTYPE] 来帮他们脱离困境。看样子他们正赶往那个气派的新 RSI 探索站点，结果半路上忘了加油。要是我每次犯这毛病都能拿一个信用点——这么说吧，我现在早就不在这儿干了！

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

我猜你这一趟不会遇到什么麻烦，不过老录像带里那些人也都这么说，然后麻烦就来了。所以还是多留个心眼。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

Good luck and have fun out there!
Christoph Roester
RSI Community Outreach Manager

Delivering the Stars since 2075

有兴趣参加一场特别的远距离接力赛吗？

祝你好运，玩得开心！

detail.description_en:
Greetings,
Northrock has been hard at work to identify some of the key players in the recent attacks on RSI's Discovery Month event. As a result, we have located a high ranking member of a local outlaw gang named [TARGET].
We've triangulated their last known location was [LOCATION], where we believe they are preparing their next attack. Intel suggest they're a cautious individual that may require drawing out by eliminating their comrades first. Bringing a team of skilled operators is heavily advised.
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
向您问候，

北境之岩一直在全力追查近期针对 RSI 探索月活动的一系列袭击中的几个关键人物。经过努力，我们已经定位到当地一个不法帮派的一名高层成员，名叫 [TARGETNAME]。

通过三角定位，其最后已知位置是 [LOCATION]，我们相信他们正在那里筹备下一次袭击。情报显示，此人行事谨慎，可能得先干掉他的同伙，才能把他引出来。强烈建议带上一支技术娴熟的行动小队。

祝你好运，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员
北境之岩服务团队

detail.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
RSI have informed us that there has been an increase in owners exchanging their ships in order to upgrade to the latest Constellation Mk V Centaurus and are looking for our help in salvaging the retired crafts. The exchange program only accepts Construction Materials (Salvage), so RSI have informed us that the contractor may keep any RMC they collect.
If accepted, you will travel to [LOCATION] and gather unrefined Construction Materials from the ship located there. Then, once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION]. Please be mindful that any extra materials delivered will not be returned.
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal. Check the requirements below to ensure you bring the right equipment.
> Requirements <
- A large-sized salvage ship (Aegis Reclaimer)
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

detail.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
We have received several special work orders from RSI who wish to support loyal customers by offering them a discount on their next purchase in exchange for recycling their previous ship. We are in need of the Construction Materials (Rubble) for another order we're working on, but anything else you salvage, like RMC, is yours to keep.
The disused RSI ship is located [LOCATION] and is ready and waiting. Once salvaged, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION]. Please be mindful that any extra materials delivered will not be returned.
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal. Before accepting this contract be sure to check the equipment requirements below.
> Requirements <
- A small-sized salvage ship (RSI Salvation, Drake Vulture, MISC Fortune)
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

missions.name_zh: RSI 探索月：紧急加油请求 ([SHIP])
name_notes_zh: 运输任务 - 燃料补给 MRT 104点

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
Found a beacon from one of those new [SHIP] ships out in [LOCATION] that needs refueling. Just got off comms with them and they said they ran into some trouble with some local outlaws and had to make a sharp exit so weren't able to fill up on <EM4>[FUELTYPE]<EM4> before heading out.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hoping we can get out to those nice folks before anything bad happens to them, been hearing a lot of nasty rumors about those parts recently. Watch your back and make sure you get home safely.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
""We’ve got your back""
detail.description_zh:
嘿，又是我，

在 [LOCATION] 收到一个信标，来自一艘新款 [SHIP] 飞船，需要加油。刚跟他们通了话，他们说碰上了当地的不法分子，只好紧急撤离，出发前没来得及加满 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

希望能赶在坏事发生前，去到那些好心人身边，最近那一带的传言可不太妙。多留个心眼，务必平安回家。
一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

missions.name_zh: RSI 探索月：黄色级别 - 巡逻星系
name_notes_zh: 防卫任务 - 巡逻 LRT 250点

detail.description_en:
Got what should be a routine contract for someone looking to cut their teeth on some patrol work.
We're been hired to secure the space around RSI's Discovery Month event. The job is mainly a deterrent against any opportunistic outlaws in the area, but that doesn't mean you should let your guard down. If your scanners pick up anything strange don't hesitate to act.
Once you've accepted, head to the first patrol point. After you've scanned the area, I'll update you on where to head next.
Best of luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
得到一份按理说是例行公事的合约，适合想拿巡逻工作练练手的人。

我们受雇保障 RSI 探索月活动现场周边空域的安全。这活儿主要是震慑一下附近那些想趁火打劫的不法分子，但你也别因此就放松警惕。要是扫描器扫到什么不对劲的，别犹豫，直接动手。

接下之后，前往第一个 巡逻点。等你把那片区域扫描完，我会通知你下一个去处。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
We were just contacted by RSI who are in urgent need of combat support for one of the ships that are supporting their Discovery Month event.
Our tracker is saying they're still over at [LOCATION], but god knows how long they'll last for. If you can make it in time, we'd really appreciate it.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们刚接到 RSI 的联系，他们正为一艘参与探索月活动的飞船寻求紧急战斗支援。

我们的追踪器显示它仍在 [LOCATION] 一带，但天知道它还能撑多久。如果你能及时赶到，我们会非常感激。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Salvage
WORK BRIEF:
Got a call about a derelict ship out near [LOCATION]. Ran the regtag through the system to make sure we weren't taking someone's ride but it looks unclaimed, so I need someone with a salvage ship to head out and break it down.
Once you're done, take the resources to [DESTINATION] and we'll get you paid.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：打捞

工作简报：
接到个消息，说是 [LOCATION] 附近有条废弃飞船。我查了系统里的注册信息，确认没谁认领，所以得找个开打捞船的人过去把它拆了。

等你干完了，把弄到的资源送到[DESTINATION]，我们就给你结账。

报酬：
资源交付后按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

missions.name_en: Salvage Wrecked Ships on the Drift
missions.name_zh: 打捞漂流的残骸飞船

detail.description_en:
Got word there’s a few ships near [LOCATION] just floating all by their lonesome. It’s good salvage, but none of our crews have the time right now. We figured to give you first snap at it.
If you want the coords, we’ll sell them to you for a price. Then you’re free to pick the wreck as clean as you like and sell it all for a tidy profit. Now, you might run into some trouble out there from rival scavs, but I’m sure it won’t be anything you can’t handle.
- Smokey
detail.description_zh:
听说在 [LOCATION] 附近有几艘飞船孤零零地漂浮着。这是不错的打捞机会，但我们现在的团队都没时间去处理。我们想先给你这个机会。

如果你想要坐标，我们可以以一个价格卖给你。然后你可以尽情打捞残骸，卖掉赚取可观的利润。不过，你可能会遇到一些来自竞争对手的麻烦，但我相信这对你来说没什么问题。

-“烟雾”

detail.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a tractor beam.
We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points, maybe in one of Nyx's asteroid belts, or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. We advise extra caution since there have been Vanduul sightings in the system, especially with how long it might take for you to track down this specific order.
Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

detail.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a tractor beam. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.
Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

detail.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a tractor beam.
We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. This request probably won't be as easy to satisfy as our normal contracts, partly in thanks to how many outlaws are flying around in Pyro and partly because this request isn't for your average everyday component. But lucky for you, the extra effort will be rewarded.
Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
- A handheld tractor beam
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

detail.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Scan And Mining Needed
WORK BRIEF:
I have a job here that might interest you. I need people to go out and do some basic mining in order to pull some geological data for future prospecting. Need someone to scope out and mine [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]. You'll be helping us out massively. [RARITY]
Also, if you're stuck or new to mining, there's a journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi that you should check out.
Keep me posted.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
detail.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：需要扫描与开采

工作简报：
我这有个活儿你可能感兴趣。我需要有人外出进行基础采矿，以获取地质数据用于未来的勘探。需要有人去勘察并开采 [RESOURCES] [MINEABLETYPE]。你们将对我们有巨大的帮助。[RARITY]

另外，如果你不了解或者刚接触采矿，手环里有个由联合资源工人协会撰写的采矿指南，你应该去看看。

随时联系。

报酬：
确认扫描并提取整个区域后，按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

missions.name_zh: 侦查与扫描
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 LRT

detail.description_en:
Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go.
This one kicks off at the location marker on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.
Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor 4 Council Scrip as a thanks.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
猎头帮一直在扩张，但还需要帮助来了解我们的新领地。我得去检查一下我们打算扫描的地点，准备开始行动了。

我这有个侦查任务要跑，先去 HUD 上的位置标记，后面还有几个要扫的位置，完事儿会实时更新路线。虽说应该没啥麻烦，但咱这行当你也懂的...意外总比明天来得快。

把这事办妥了，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 当谢礼。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go.
This one kicks off at the location marker on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.
Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor 4 Council Scrip as a thanks.
Stows out.

把这事办妥了，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 当谢礼。

detail.description_en:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.
Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 3 Council Scrip for the main contractor.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
有个新冒出来的帮派正让猎头帮头疼得要命，他们居然把 [OBJECTS] 给盯上了，地点就在 [LOCATION]。这事儿可不太妙，毕竟我们很在意那边人的安危，更别提要是让他们搞出大动静，搞不好会把接下来的行动全搅黄了。

你一到那儿就赶紧去阻止他们，别让他们造成永久性破坏。要是发现有友方飞船需要帮忙，你也得搭把手。别指望这帮家伙好对付，但只要你保持冷静，应该还是能摆平他们的。

要是你还缺点动力，那么我特意给主承包商额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.
Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 3 Council Scrip for the main contractor.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
有个新冒出来的帮派正让猎头帮头疼得要命，他们居然把 [OBJECTS] 给盯上了，地点就在 [LOCATION]。这事儿可不太妙，毕竟我们很在意那边人的安危，更别提要是让他们搞出大动静，搞不好会把接下来的行动全搅黄了。

你一到那儿就赶紧去阻止他们，别让他们造成永久性破坏。要是发现有友方飞船需要帮忙，你也得搭把手。别指望这帮家伙好对付，但只要你保持冷静，应该还是能摆平他们的。

要是你还缺点动力，那么我特意给主承包商额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
A client has intercepted comms between gang members and discovered that they’re planning an attack on [LOCATION]. Now they need our help to ensure the attack isn’t successful.
Looking for a contractor who can defend the location from this offensive. Don’t have any specifics on the outlaws, but doubt they’re that skilled if our client cracked their comms so easily.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Trial - Defend Location
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVAL_CODE]
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Eckhart Security is continuing to evaluate potential new contractors. According to our records, you’ve previously attempted a trial contract. We understand how demanding and unpredictable this line of work can be, and would like to give you another chance at completing a qualifying contract.
If interested, report to [LOCATION] ready to defend it from an incoming assault by outlaws. Successfully complete this contract to receive payment and more work opportunities from Eckhart Security.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.name_zh: 看看那儿有啥
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 VLRT

detail.description_en:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?
If so, get on over to the location marker on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on.
And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of 2 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
猎头帮要摸清领地周边动向。虽然放了监控卫星，但哪有真人巡逻靠谱。接不接？

要干就去 HUD 上的位置标记，先扫那片区域，完事再带带你去其他几个情报点。

要是你还缺点动力的话，这单干完主承包商还能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Client has requested a discreet contractor to infiltrate an ASD research site, locate a group of servers, and destroy the information stored on them permanently.
The client was able to share the location of the servers within the facility: the Control Center in the Engineering wing. The site has officially been shuttered, but there still may be hostile forces there. Be on your guard.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

detail.description_en:
Citizens for Prosperity is in need of pilots with dogfighting experience. If you’re looking to put your skills to the test, I have a mission here for you to try.
A civilian ship has requested combat support near [LOCATION]. Head there and show us that you have the skills to excel in these types of missions and we’ll put you to good use.
Please be aware. This mission is not a training exercise. This is a real encounter, so please do your best to save the ship in distress.
Good Luck,
Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.name_zh: 设个陷阱
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 伏击 入门

detail.description_en:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a[TARGET] and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.
You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently.
Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.
And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
有个机会适合那些想展示自己飞行技巧的人。猎头帮最近惹上了这个驾驶 [AMBUSHTARGET] 飞船的蠢货，我们得彻底解决这个问题。

你要帮我们设一个陷阱。你看，[LOCATION] 附近有一片辐射云，他们经常从那里飞过。

你去那里，把飞船的引擎关掉藏在云里，一旦看到他们和其他蠢货一起飞，就立刻发动攻击。第一次攻击就靠你一个人了，但我们会派几艘支援飞船来帮忙完成剩下的工作。

作为为我们完成的首次突袭，完成任务后，主承包商会得到[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的额外奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 设个陷阱
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 伏击 入门

detail.description_en:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a[TARGET] and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.
You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an emission cloud near [LOCATION] that they fly by frequently.
Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.
And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of 1 Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
有个机会适合那些想展示自己飞行技巧的人。猎头帮最近惹上了这个驾驶 [AMBUSHTARGET] 飞船的蠢货，我们得彻底解决这个问题。

你要帮我们设一个陷阱。你看，[LOCATION] 附近有一片辐射云，他们经常从那里飞过。

你去那里，把飞船的引擎关掉藏在云里，一旦看到他们和其他蠢货一起飞，就立刻发动攻击。第一次攻击就靠你一个人了，但我们会派几艘支援飞船来帮忙完成剩下的工作。

作为为我们完成的首次突袭，完成任务后，主承包商会得到[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的额外奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
One of our clients has been the victim of consistent harassment so the time has come to send a clear cease-and-desist message by taking out their prized [TARGET]. The lowlife in question follows a fairly predictable routine making them susceptible to an ambush. We’ve identified [LOCATION] as the ideal spot. It features an emission cloud where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting.
By the way, the [TARGET] often flies alone but is sometimes joined by a friend in a single-seat ship. Neither should give you too much trouble, but we have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip in this for the main contractor too.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

A Citizens for Prosperity member who’s new to Nyx took out their ship to tour the system, and ran right into trouble. Based on their comms, it sure sounds like they ventured into Shattered Blade territory, got caught, and are now trying to escape.
They’re putting up a decent fight, but don’t know how long they’ll last without support. Could you go to their aid at [LOCATION] before it’s too late?
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:

他们抵抗得还不错，但如果没人支援，也不知道能撑多久。你能在事情无法挽回之前赶到 [LOCATION] 去支援他们吗？

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民
