My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake [LOCATION]. The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.
Security there's being run by [TARGET] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?
-Stows
detail.description_zh:
我老大在找一个可以出手的雇佣兵，猎头帮正打算重新夺回在 [LOCATION]。那里的佣兵已经准备好进行一场漫长的战斗。听着，我们不想杀任何非杀不可的人，所以我们在寻找其他路子。

那里的安保由 [TARGETNAME] 负责，我的判断是如果他被解决掉，其他人就会四散而逃。流一点血总比流很多好，对吧？

- 斯托斯

你准备好展示猎头帮的处事方式了吗？如果是的话，前往 [LOCATION]，把那里的一切活物清除干净。

斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 关掉繁荣公民的通讯
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 关闭通讯塔

detail.description_en:
CFP think they’re safe over at [LOCATION] but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.
There should be a control terminal at the top that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.
Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
繁荣公民以为他们躲在 [LOCATION] 就安全了，但我们早就给他们准备了大礼。你先过去把他们的通讯塔统统关掉，给我们铺平道路。

塔顶应该有个控制终端，你可以用它来关闭通讯塔。只要搞定这个，他们就别想叫援兵了。到时候我们就好好让那些渣渣知道，这个星系到底是谁的地盘。

大多数前哨站都用同样的系统，所以下次你想确保没人来打扰你的时候，这招就派得上用场了。

missions.name_zh: 关闭异种威胁的通讯塔
name_notes_zh: 繁荣公民 - 关闭通讯塔

detail.description_en:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.
We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.
Head to [LOCATION] and find the towers. At the top is a control panel that can be used to disable them.
Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.
Good luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
繁荣公民渴望帮助派罗的人民，而这一切都要从把他们从异种威胁的魔爪中解救出来开始。

我们正在准备一支小队渗透进他们的一个前哨站，但需要有人先行潜入摧毁他们的通讯塔。只要那些塔一瘫痪，他们就无法呼叫增援，我们就能顺利推进计划了。

前往 [LOCATION] 找到通讯塔。塔顶有一个控制面板，可以用来关闭它们。

另外，值得注意的是，大多数前哨站都使用类似的系统，所以你会知道如何关闭通讯塔，而不是在执行其他任务时冒险与增援运输船作战。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员

missions.name_zh: 让异种威胁闭嘴
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 关闭通讯塔

detail.description_en:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.
Head to [LOCATION] and climb the comm towers there. Should be a control panel at the top you can use to switch them off.
In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们打算给那些异种威胁的混蛋来点狠的，但得聪明点动手。所以先派你进去，把他们的通讯塔干掉，让他们没法叫援兵。你搞定之后，我们就能神不知鬼不觉地进出。

前往 [LOCATION]，爬上那里的通讯塔，塔顶应该有个控制面板，你可以用它把塔关掉。

其实大多数前哨站都这样，与其等他们援军来烦你，不如直接把通讯塔关了省事。不过话说回来，要是你想敲个钟多引几个异种威胁出来遛遛，我也不拦着。


斯托斯通讯完毕

detail.description_en:
Hiya,
I've got a client who's been messaging me all morning about a shipment they were supposed to receive and when I checked up on the cargo it turns out that it's sitting completely still in the middle of space.
This is obviously bad for a number of reasons, and not just because I had to spend 20 minutes getting yelled at. Can you head over to [LOCATION] and see what happened? The original contract called for a ship that could carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers so make sure you've got that and a heavy-duty tractor beam.
Once you've got the cargo, can you make sure it's delivered to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]? Thanks a bunch.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
你好，

我有个客户一早上都在给我发消息，问他们本该收到的那批货去哪儿了。我查了下货物状态，结果发现它正孤零零地停在太空中间一动不动。

这事儿明显很糟，原因不止一个，尤其我还被骂了整整 20 分钟。你能去 [LOCATION] 那儿看看到底出了啥状况吗？原合约要求用一艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，所以你得确保自己有这个运载能力，还得配个重型牵引光束。

等你拿到货后，记得把它送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯哈，多谢啦！

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

missions.name_zh: 小批量采矿订单：萨达瑞晶

detail.description_en:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx
DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.
However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.
We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.
TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.
Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
合约：采矿订单
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
我们的一支勘探小队近期确认，位于尼克斯星系基格小行星带中，设有 QV 碎岩站的小行星内部蕴藏一种稀有矿石“萨达瑞晶(Sadaryx)”。

然而，由于这些站点难以抵达，且作业本身风险极高，我们现面向外部采矿队伍招募执行开采任务。

目前尚无法确定萨达瑞晶矿石在站点内的具体分布位置，但建议优先从天然矿物富集的洞穴区域入手。若运气极佳，你甚至可能在仓储区发现由旧时 QV 作业组开采并留下的晶体矿藏。

条款*：
你的船员需进入 QV 碎岩站，采集指定的萨达瑞晶，并将其运送至位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。

此项任务需配备装有采矿附件的多功能工具，并具备基础的手动采矿技能。

我方勘探小队报告称，这些站点可能已被不法分子渗透，请务必谨慎行事。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for Volt weapons. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."
detail.description_zh:

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的 mobiGlas 日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。如果你需要复习如何获取这些材料，也可以顺便阅读第一部分《采矿基础 #1：基本概述》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。"

TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
由于我们的采购渠道发生变化，舒宾星际目前正在寻求从该地区独立矿工处购买各种精炼材料。虽然在贸易中心出售可能获得比完成我们的订单获得更具竞争力的价格，但许多矿工发现，加强与舒宾的关系是职业生涯中明智的长期投资。

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的 mobiGlas 日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。如果你需要复习如何获取这些材料，也可以顺便阅读第一部分《采矿基础 #1：基本概述》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

请注意，为了加快这些材料未来的使用效率，它们必须在交付前进行精炼。这可以在任何精炼厂完成，其位置可在你的星图中找到。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available?
All you need to do is head to the location marker on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it.
Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip as thanks.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
本地金主需要关于咱们地盘的最新情报。不清楚他们在找什么，但我可不打算问太多。我的任务是找个愿意跑一趟、扫描这些地点的人。你有空吗？

你只需要前往 HUD 上的位置标记，进行扫描，如果一切正常，就继续前往下一个点。 如果遇到任何问题，自行解决就行。

这差事听着不赖吧？另外，为了表示感谢，我会给主承包商额外 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为奖励。

- 斯托斯

name_notes_zh: 科瓦莱什 - 斯坦顿投递 超级困难

detail.description_en:
Got a special assignment - Loads of packages ready to delivered across the system. Its a bit more than the usual so I'm only reaching out to my best contractors for this one.
Obviously, a part of that payment will be to cover your fuel because you'll be going super far with this one. You'll need all the usual as well like a handheld tractor beam and a ship with space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Good luck. I'm counting on you.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
这是一次特殊任务 - 星系内大量包裹等待运输，比平时多一点，所以这次我只联系我最好的承包商。

显然，报酬中已包含燃料补贴，因本次航程极远。除常规装备外，你还需配备手持牵引光束，并驾驶一艘可容纳 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船。

祝你好运，我就指望你了。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.
Reminder, materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。这份订单比通常的更复杂，需要多种采矿方法，但鉴于你到目前为止已证明了自己的能力，我们认为你和你的团队能够胜任这项挑战。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.
Reminder, materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。这份订单比通常的更复杂，需要多种采矿方法，但鉴于你到目前为止已证明了自己的能力，我们认为你和你的团队能够胜任这项挑战。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. This purchase order is more complex than typical, requiring multiple mining methods, but since you've proven your skill thus far, we think you and your team are up for the challenge.
Reminder, materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。这份订单比通常的更复杂，需要多种采矿方法，但鉴于你到目前为止已证明了自己的能力，我们认为你和你的团队能够胜任这项挑战。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.
Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.
With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to [LOCATION] in order to take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.
If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.
Best of luck,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
detail.description_zh:
我本不该让别人冒这么大的风险，但眼下情况特殊。

我们的飞行员在运送一批关键货物时，遭到了一伙不法分子的袭击。无论如何，绝不能让他们得手。

鉴于袭击者规模庞大，单凭你一人无法完成任务。你必须带上一支技术过硬的队伍，前往 [LOCATION]，击溃这批不法分子并夺回货物。请确保队伍中至少有一人驾驶的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，并配备一把 重型牵引光束。

倘若奇迹发生、你真能把这批货物抢回来，请将其运至 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯处。

这要求确实很高，但若你能成功，我本人及整个组织都将对你深表感激。

祝你好运，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

missions.name_zh: 坚守阵地
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 VHRT

detail.description_en:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?
If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.
You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
有些人不爽咱们在这儿混，专门派小队搞咱们的船。敢不敢去几个据点让他们明白——猎头帮可不是吓大的？

从 HUD 上的位置标记开始侦查，完事带你去点其他几个火药桶。出发前最好把家伙事儿备齐。我建议你多带点弹药，再拉上两个朋友一起参与巡逻。

给猎头帮办成这事儿的话，我保证让主承包商多拿 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 当外快。

- 斯托斯

missions.name_zh: 坚守阵地
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 巡逻 VHRT

detail.description_en:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?
If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.
You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
有些人不爽咱们在这儿混，专门派小队搞咱们的船。敢不敢去几个据点让他们明白——猎头帮可不是吓大的？

从 HUD 上的位置标记开始侦查，完事带你去点其他几个火药桶。出发前最好把家伙事儿备齐。我建议你多带点弹药，再拉上两个朋友一起参与巡逻。

给猎头帮办成这事儿的话，我保证让主承包商多拿 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 当外快。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
Due to a corporate restructuring, Foxwell has some new vacancies that need to be filled immediately. Foxwell knows you’ve previously expressed interest in this line of work, and we’re wondering if you would want to take another crack at a contract.
One of our clients needs support at [LOCATION] where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late.
Successfully complete this contract, and Foxwell would be happy to send more work your way.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

我们的一位客户在 [LOCATION]需要支援，那里的安保部队难以应对不法分子的入侵。前往那里，帮助当地部队在问题失控之前解决它。

成功完成这份合约，福克斯韦尔将很乐意为你提供更多工作机会。

尤金·沃尔顿

detail.description_en:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at [LOCATION].
Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION], then we can sort your payment.
A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
Stows out.

怎么把货物拿出来就看你了，但如果在这个过程中顺便解决掉几个竞争对手，我也不会抱怨。一旦你拿到货物，就把它送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯上，然后我们可以给你发报酬了。

带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 地点保卫 VHRT

detail.description_en:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at [LOCATION], along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto.
Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.
This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip for a job well done.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们需要的不仅是能进行空中缠斗的人，还要能招募其他人加入猎头帮的事业。我们的行动中心位于 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION]，所有进出那里的飞船都遭到了敌对势力的袭击。我们急需支援。

说实话，那边的情况很棘手，敌人的火力很猛。所以你得确保物资充足，再找几个信得过的朋友跟你一起飞。等你组好队伍，出发过去，如果那边有任何突发情况，我会及时通知你。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我打算给完成任务的主要承包人额外奖励 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

detail.description_en:

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.
This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip for a job well done.

This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along. Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor 6 Council Scrip. - Stows

这事儿办漂亮了，我会主承包商发 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at [LOCATION]. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the [OBJECTS] there.
I need you and whatever crew you can muster on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any friendly ships that need a hand.
Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor 4 Council Scrip.
- Stows
detail.description_zh:
有个小帮派一直像根刺扎在我们这儿，那帮混蛋刚在 [LOCATION] 伏击了几个朋友。看样子他们正拼命想毁了那里的 [OBJECTS]。

我要你带上所有你可以召集的船员立刻赶去现场，阻止这些混蛋把一切都炸飞，还得护住那些需要帮忙的友方飞船。

这事办得漂亮的话，我就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing:
Local assets have indicated that Shattered Blade elements are attempting to rebuild one of their stations and Intersec is looking for a pilot to make sure that doesn't happen.
They've managed to get basic turret defenses back online but currently only have two power relays activated. These will be your targets as they cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, you will need to bring ballistic or ordnance to be effective.
Reactivation of this station will allow the Shattered Blade to try and reclaim a foothold in this system and we can't let that happen.
Good luck,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：碎刃帮
装备规格：战斗级飞船/军械
任务简报：
当地资产显示，碎刃帮的残余势力正试图重建他们的一座空间站，互安正在招募飞行员去阻止这件事。

他们虽然把基础炮台防御重新上线了，但目前只激活了两座能源中继器，这些就是你们的攻击目标。因为能量武器对它们无效，你们得带上实弹武器或军械才能奏效。

要是让这座空间站重新启用，碎刃帮就能借此在这个星系重新站稳脚跟，我们绝不能让他们得逞。

祝好运，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.
Can you fly out to [LOCATION] and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.
Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send confirmation to the client.
Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
detail.description_zh:
嘿，

真够背的，我们刚拿下这辈子最大的一单，结果运输船引擎直接卡死了。他们拼了命修，但看样子还是没戏了.

你能飞去 [LOCATION] 帮我们把货带回来吗？这事儿真挺关键的，客户得看到我们跟那些大厂一样靠谱。

顺便说下，这单货量不小，你得开艘能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的大船，再带上一个重型牵引光束才搬得动。等你把货挪到自己船上，直接送到 [DESTINATION] 那儿的货运电梯就行，我们立马给客户发确认。

考虑到现状，谁能干完这个活，我们给的钱绝对比市场价高不少。

谢谢，
雷耶斯·玲
货运物流协调员
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.
Can you fly out to [LOCATION] and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.
Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send confirmation to the client.
Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

detail.description_en:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx
DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.
TERMS*:
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using Sadaryx crystals and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment.
Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION] for processing.
Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
合约：制造订单
地点：尼克斯星系

详情：
倘若您恰巧因其他工作需前往基格小行星带的任意一个 QV 碎岩站，舒宾星际公司非常乐意委托您顺带获取一批难以获取的采矿激光聚焦透镜。

条款*：
尽管部分聚焦透镜或可从 QV 碎岩站的仓储区回收，但您很可能仍需利用萨达瑞晶，并借助站点内的透镜制造器自行生产。尽管该矿石稀有，但这些碎岩站通常蕴藏可直接用带采矿附件的多功能工具开采的萨达瑞晶矿石。

missions.name_zh: 罪犯追捕执照

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.
If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.
The suspect you would be after is known as [TARGET]. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.
Hope to hear from you soon,
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
嗨，

希望你不介意，但我知道你在赏金猎人工会的情况，并想看下你有没有兴趣和我们北境之岩服务团队签订合约，我们是星系内评价最高的私人安保公司之一。

如果你有的话，首先需要你去完成一份临时嫌犯逮捕合约。与其说是评断，其实更像是次机会，来确保我们能有良好的共事关系。

你要找的嫌犯名叫 [TARGETNAME]。他们可是出了名的难以捉摸，所以对你来说会有些困难。

希望尽快收到你的消息，

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

detail.description_en:
Looking for someone willing to take out the trash at [LOCATION]. Guess a gang has settled in without the permission of the owners. So they’ve hired us to get them out whatever way we see fit.
I’d bring plenty of ammo, if I were you. Doubt they’ll want to leave willingly.
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
正在寻找愿意在 [LOCATION] 清理垃圾的人。看来一个帮派未经业主许可就驻扎在那里。所以他们雇佣我们以我们认为合适的方式将他们赶出去。

如果我是你，我会带上充足的弹药。我估计他们不会自愿离开。

尤金·沃尔顿
福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.
Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGET]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我收到了判官的消息，要求我们夺回一些被繁荣公民控制的前哨站。他们有点生气，他们认为繁荣公民在这个星系中占据的地盘太多，同时还觉得这让猎头帮显得很软弱。

在 [LOCATION] 附近发现了几个可以清扫的目标。更妙的是，那里安保负责人是 [TARGETNAME]。不确定你是否听说过他们，但上个月他们干掉了几名平民，所以这简直是双赢的局面。我们不仅能夺回一些领土，还能教训一个欠揍的人。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 战术打击
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 伏击 VHRT

detail.description_en:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.
We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.
No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.
Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
有些人就是见不得咱们好。有线报说几艘次主力舰带着护航队在搞咱们。先下手为强总比等着挨揍强。

发现他们的 [AMBUSHTARGET] 经常经过 [LOCATION] ——这地方天生就是打埋伏的料。边边上的辐射云能藏住你和带来的帮手。

丑话说前头：这活儿不轻松。但赏金绝对对对得起卖命钱。活干完主承包商就能拿 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为额外奖励。

再说了，天知道那些残骸里能捞出什么宝贝。

- 斯托斯

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 伏击 VHRT

detail.description_en:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.
We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.
No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.
Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
有些人就是见不得咱们好。有线报说几艘次主力舰带着护航队在搞咱们。先下手为强总比等着挨揍强。

发现他们的 [AMBUSHTARGET] 经常经过 [LOCATION] ——这地方天生就是打埋伏的料。边边上的辐射云能藏住你和带来的帮手。

丑话说前头：这活儿不轻松。但赏金绝对对对得起卖命钱。活干完主承包商就能拿 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为额外奖励。

再说了，天知道那些残骸里能捞出什么宝贝。

- 斯托斯

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing:
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site.
Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will need ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station and ultimately get boots on the ground to save their pilot.
Recruiting additional ships to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will need a variety of ship types to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：碎刃帮
装备规格：打击群
任务简报：
我们收到消息，一艘名为宁静号的人民联盟安保飞船意外发现碎刃帮藏匿于一个旧的 QV 采矿站中。细节尚不明确，但一旦抵达现场，我们将为你连接到当地资产。

互安防务正在寻找一支团队介入并保护宁静号及其人员。根据与宁静号船长的讨论，你将需要实弹武器和爆炸物来突破该空间站的防御，并最终派遣地面部队前往营救其飞行员。

招募额外的飞船以支援你执行此任务至关重要。你需要多种类型的飞船，以便在太空和地面的多个作战区域之间保持平衡。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

We have gotten word that the outlaws at [LOCATION] have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity.
In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion.
Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.

Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

成功完成这项任务可能会拯救很多生命。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民组织

Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at [LOCATION] so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need a heavy-duty tractor beam to lug the goods from the ship.
I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.
Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
-Twitch

detail.description_en:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGET]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGET] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.
Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGET] won't be able to hide.
Take them all out and have one on us.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们有个丰厚的任务，适合任何想要赚大钱的强硬人士。在 [LOCATION] 那里，有一片由一个叫 [TARGETNAME] 的家伙控制的异种威胁地盘。如果你在这个星系待得够久，可能听说过 [TARGETNAME]，或者至少见过他们的手段。这帮杂种总是喜欢在他们走过的地方留下尸体。

无论如何，判官想要把这个区域清理干净，这意味着你得攻击所有三个集群，杀掉你找到的每一个异种威胁。杀得够多，[TARGETNAME] 就藏不住了。

把他们全都解决了，咱们请你喝一杯。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 取回货物 LRT

detail.description_en:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at [LOCATION] but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.
Just don’t forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam as that shit’s heavy.
When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we’ll take care of the rest.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我刚截下一艘运货的船，就在 [LOCATION] 那边，但咱自己人飞船装不下，东西堆那儿了。想赚点快钱不？赶紧过去把货弄走，现在那儿说不定已经蹲着几个打捞的了，小心点。

别忘了带个重型牵引光束，那玩意儿沉得要命。

弄完直接拉到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，剩下的交给我们。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.
There's a real piece of work named [TARGET] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGET] responded, they were very disrespectful.
We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.
Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
事情是这样的，猎头帮想要扩大他们的人才库，现在有几个职位空缺，欢迎任何有胆量的人来应征。

有个家伙名叫 [TARGETNAME]，觉得自己很聪明，从在星系中运输的货船那里偷走货物。我们要求他们支付一部分利润作为运营的许可税。当 [TARGETNAME] 回应时，他们非常无礼。

我们追踪到他们的飞船在 [LOCATION]，需要将他们解决掉。你应该知道，他们很聪明，知道紧靠一些盟友就不会孤立无援。

完成这个任务后，我们将考虑让你参与未来的猎头帮工作。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves.
I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to [LOCATION] and really mess the place up.
Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:

我想他们需要一个提醒，告诉他们谁才是真正的掌控者。去 [LOCATION] 那儿，好好把那个地方给搅个天翻地覆。

没有什么比一些财产损失更能传达这个信息了。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

A senior security official by the name of [TARGET] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [LOCATION], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.
I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter.
Earnestly,
Vaughn
detail.description_zh:
一名叫做 [TARGETNAME] 的资深安保人士马上就要在从天而降的暴力之中和他的职业生涯告别了。他们目前驻扎在 [LOCATION]，并且不会很好对付。恐怕你需要费一番功夫才能引他们出来了。

我推荐击杀足够多的手下，他们就别无选择只能亲自出来迎战你。当然了，一旦他们决定露面，事情就很好办了。

你真诚的，
沃恩

detail.description_en:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at [LOCATION] and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.
But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
寻找那些手指发痒的人，我们打算在 [LOCATION] 对一些繁荣公民采取行动，然后把它占为己有。不过，你得聪明地处理这件事。主前哨站周围有一堆边远前哨站，所有的都有安保，所以你应该先清除这些边远前哨站，再攻打主基地。

不过，如果你想直接跳进深处然后抵挡所有增援，那就看你自己了。只要能完成任务就行。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular [TARGET]. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good.
Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by [LOCATION] on the regular, which has an emission cloud that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the [TARGET] could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip for the main contractor.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

detail.description_en:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.
The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?
Head to [LOCATION] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION].
-Bit Zeros
detail.description_zh:
这次我们自作聪明，结果翻车了。人嘛，总得有点梦想对吧？我们本来想把一批加密数据藏进飞船黑匣子，运到咱们的数据据点。为了骗过敌人，还特意在船上堆满“值钱货”当诱饵。结果这招太灵了——东西是唬住人了，可也引来了不该来的人。货全被抢光了，唯独漏了黑匣子。坏消息是，现在那艘船周围全是不法分子，跟蜂窝似的。

那黑匣子里的数据对他们屁用没有，但我们非得拿回来。你要是能帮我们搞到手，分你一大笔，这买卖不亏吧？

去 [LOCATION] 把事儿办了，然后把飞行记录仪送到 [DESTINATION]。

- 零比特

NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: [SYSTEM]

LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a waste material transfer going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size. Wouldn't bring your cleanest ship either.
On the bright side though, most likely outlaws will leave you alone when they see what you're carrying. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员来负责从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯转运废料到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你有一艘能处理最大尺寸为 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱的飞船，这应该没什么问题。也别把你最干净的飞船带来。

不过也有好的一面，当不法分子看到你运送的东西时，他们很可能会对你放手一马。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员，将货物从 [LOCATION] 的货物电梯运输到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你的飞船能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，这项任务应该很简单。

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员，将货物从 [LOCATION] 的货物电梯运输到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你的飞船能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，这项任务应该很简单。

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员，将货物从 [LOCATION] 的货物电梯运输到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你的飞船能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，这项任务应该很简单。

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

detail.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
detail.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员，将货物从 [LOCATION] 的货物电梯运输到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你的飞船能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，这项任务应该很简单。

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 轰炸 VHRT

detail.description_en:
Got a plan to take care of a rat I've been dealing with and need a hand.
Had a client default on some debts and now they've decided they ain't going to pay up. Got a tip that they're hiding out over at [LOCATION]. If you can take out their fuel tanks they'll have no choice but to reconsider their crap decisions.
Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:
我有个收拾某个卑鄙小人的打算，需要你搭把手。

有个客户赖账，现在居然决定彻底耍赖不付钱了。我收到消息，这货正躲在 [LOCATION] 那儿。你要是能把他们的燃料罐给炸了，他们除了重新考虑自己糟糕决定之外别无选择。

不过千万别小瞧这号混蛋。他们虽然蠢，但也不傻，你懂我意思吧？听说那地方到处都是飞船和炮塔，除非你是脑子进水的大白痴，否则肯定得带点帮手去才行。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

detail.description_en:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a [TARGET] which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the [TARGET] is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft.
We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an emission cloud that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

detail.description_en:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.
We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.
- Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
我们的一位法官打听到了异种威胁试图侵入我们领土的风声。看起来他们正试图抢夺 [LOCATION]。我们不想让这帮神经病在该星系中获得更多的立足点，因此我们将采取一些措施来让他们退缩。

我们希望你狠狠的教训一下他们。直到整个地点都变成墓地之前，不要放松。一旦他们的尸体准备好入土，我们就会向您发送报酬。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 教程 - 首次飞行

detail.description_en:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!
With your business in [LOCATION] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TRANSITNAMESHORT] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [LOCATION] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.
This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.
detail.description_zh:
您马上就要完成本教程了。接下来就该起飞了！

既然您已经处理完了 [LOCATION] 的事务，那么是时候离开城市了——接下来还会离开这颗星球。请前往 [TRANSITNAMESHORT] 乘坐穿梭机，这些穿梭机可以带您前往 [LOCATION] 各地。不过当前您的目的地是空港，在那里会有一艘铁砧航天的 C8 双鱼座临时供您使用。

这艘方正小巧的探索船是艘很棒的新手船，非常适合想要展翅高飞的新手驾驶员们使用。

missions.name_zh: 教程 - 你的第一次出行

detail.description_en:
Well done!
With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.
This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].
You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.
detail.description_zh:
干得漂亮！

在完成了教程的第一部分后，您现在应该对基础移动控制、自身饥渴状态管理、还有一些mobiGlas的核心功能——即合约管理和日志都有所了解了。

接下来的部分将会帮您熟悉一下 [LOCATION]，并带您去逛一下 [LOCATION] 的武器店 [STORENAME]。

您可以使用联合地球信劵（UEC）在这些商店中进行购物。在星际公民的阿尔法测试阶段，我们会使用名为aUEC（阿尔法联合地球信劵）的货币。这是一种专门用于测试游戏内经济和平衡系统的临时货币。

detail.description_en:
DD here - I've got something special for you,
I just received a ping from [LOCATION]. A strike force led by a [SHIP] just dropped into the system and are looking for a fast refuel before heading back out.
They need [FUELTYPE] asap and will pay [REFUELREQUEST] for it. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
I won't lie - I'm more than a little jealous. Getting up close and personal to a ship that big? Should be one to tell the grandkids about.
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
我是 DD - 我有个特别的任务交给你。

我刚收到来自 [LOCATION] 的信号。一支由 [SHIP] 率领的突击部队刚刚进入该星系，在返航前急需快速加油补给。

他们需要 [FUELTYPE]，并愿意按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

我不骗你 - 说实话，我有点嫉妒了。能近距离接触那么大的飞船？这故事都值得讲给孙辈们听。

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Happy trails,
Dina Deloit

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

missions.name_zh: 紧急：登舰行动进行中

detail.description_en:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [LOCATION] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard.
Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters.
Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.
Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.
Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy.
Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
detail.description_zh:
一位行政客户刚刚向我们发出求救信号，他们的 890 跃动在 [LOCATION] 被拦截并被不法分子登上了船。因为船上存了一些比较敏感的私人数据，所以他们更希望能私下处理这个问题。

你的首要任务是把不法分子以最快的速度清理掉，这样一支救援小组就能派遣过去把船返还给船主。让这些非法之徒控制这艘船的时间越长，它被抢走的可能性就越大。为了能更快速的解决问题，我建议你组织一个特勤小组来执行此任务。

需要注意的一点是，船上所有幸存的船员都在船上的私人安全部队的保护下坐救生艇安全逃离了。不过，现在船上的状况仍然无法确定，为了以防万一，执行任务的时候请务必留意是否还有友军，以免误伤。

还有，如果可能的话，我们的客户会“非常乐意”看到你能把飞船内的数据保护下来不被盗走。如果你能成功阻止这些机密数据以远程传输的方式被盗走，会有一笔非常丰厚的额外奖金等着你。

如果换作是我的话，我会尽全力完成这位客户的要求让他满意。

布雷登·科查多
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

missions.name_zh: UWC 正在招募加油员
name_notes_zh: 旅者联合 - 燃料补给 入门

detail.description_en:
Hey!
DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.
The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.
And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.
If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.
A Club member has run out of [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST]. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.
There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.
Looking forward to working with you.
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
detail.description_zh:
嘿！

我是来自旅者联合俱乐部的 DD。

UWC 在全 UEE 范围内提供维修、补给和加油服务。碰巧我们正在寻找新的合作伙伴，只要你的飞船配备了加油设备。如果你拥有燃料吊舱，并且喜欢被人热情迎接，那么 UWC 可能很适合你来。

如果你觉得这不错，那我手头正好有一个正在运行的信标你可能喜欢。

如果你确实喜欢它，那么给你一个提醒：出发前务必确保燃料吊舱已满。

一名俱乐部成员在 [LOCATION] 那边耗尽了 [FUELTYPE]。具体细节我还不太清楚，比如他们怎么就跑到那儿连“动力果汁”都没了，但 UWC 不想把大家晾在一边不管。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

这是一趟很简单的活儿。如果你想感受熟悉这类工作，这再合适不过了。去那里给他们的 [SHIP] 加满油，然后让他们启程吧。多做几次这样的任务，操作就会变成肌肉记忆。在此之前，你的 mobiGlas 里有一篇名为“加油协议”的日志条目，涵盖了所有基础内容。

该区域尚未报告有不法分子活动，但仍需保持警惕。我始终建议你追求快速周转。越早完成，我就越能尽快为你安排下一份合约。UWC 一直在寻找新的合作伙伴。

期待与你合作，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

detail.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Unknown
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec has been enlisted by the UEE to gather intel on a group of black marketeers dealing in Vanduul parts, that have been linked to the illegal Vanduul experiments happening at ASD’s Onyx Facility. The UEE is eager to understand and put an end to their operations.
Based on evidence extracted from the ASD facilities, we’ve potentially managed to track down the location of one of their storage sites.
Once accepted, head over to the old QV Planet Services Logistics station and we’ll be in touch.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
detail.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：未知
装备规格：战斗级飞船、单兵武装
任务简报：互安防务已受 UEE 委托，搜集一群涉及剜度部件黑市交易的不法分子的情报，这些人与联合科学与开发公司玛瑙设施内非法的剜度实验有关。UEE 迫切希望了解并终结他们的活动。

根据从 ASD 设施中提取的证据，我们可能已经锁定了他们其中一个藏匿点的位置。

接受任务后，前往旧的 QV 行星服务物流空间站，我们会与你联系。


此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

detail.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP70001
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
In need of a highly competent operator for a special assignment. A highly dangerous outlaw that has been evading local authorities for some time has been reported to have been involved in a large-scale ship battle, resulting in their supposed death. Our client wishes to confirm that they have been neutralized.
Contract Investigator Actions:
We require you to head to [LOCATION] locate [TARGET]’s body and confirm their death.
Additional Notes:
Serious preparation is advised for this contract as there is a strong potential for there to be highly aggressive and dangerous hostiles still on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bring other skilled pilots with you.

detail.description_en:
Hiya,
Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.
Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.
As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
你好呀，

detail.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: saldynium, jaclium, and carinite.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
detail.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏三种对实验至关重要的资源：烁迪银, 杰金, 和 科力晶 而受阻。

特别是，我们在 [DESTINATION] 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

尽管我们尚未进行彻底扫描，但我们的团队坚信，哈索尔已经废弃得轨道激光平台建造在这些资源浓度较高的区域之上。重新激活这些轨道激光平台可能是获取我们所需资源的最佳希望。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 轰炸 HRT

detail.description_en:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.
Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at [LOCATION]. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.
-Stows out
detail.description_zh:
听着，猎头帮从不把时间浪费在鸡毛蒜皮的报复上，但我也绝不会任由这种胡闹继续下去。

有个混蛋干掉了我不少船员，还到处吹嘘这事。我听说那个没脑子的家伙还在 [LOCATION] 囤积了大量量子燃料。我想看看当你飞过去把他们建的一切烧成平地时，他们该怎么应对这真正的“发火”。哦对了，就凭他们在那儿聚集的火力，你一个人飞过去可不明智，最好带上团队一起行动。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

missions.name_zh: 值得费心
name_notes_zh: 猎头帮 - 取回货物 ERT

detail.description_en:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at [LOCATION]. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.
If you can get your best pilots together and a heavy-duty tractor beam you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.
I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I’ll send you the creds.
Stows out.
detail.description_zh:
这对你来说会是个有趣的任务。我们刚收到消息，有一艘运输船在 [LOCATION] 那儿抛锚了。问题在于，好像所有的不法分子都知道这件事。那儿到处都是想抢走船上货物的混蛋。这就是你需要发挥作用的地方。

如果你能召集你最厉害的飞行员，并且准备好重型牵引光束，那么你就能击败那些对手拿到货物。不过这不会容易的。我的一个侦察员说，守着那艘船的家伙们有一些很厉害的装备。

我已经找好了买家，你只需要把货物送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯那儿，我就会把报酬给你。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

missions.name_zh: 待售残骸飞船

detail.description_en:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to [LOCATION]. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.
Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.
- Smokey
detail.description_zh:
有几艘残骸飞船被拖到了 [LOCATION]。它们完全无法使用，急需拆解。如果你有兴趣打捞剩下的东西，价格合理，全部都可以归你。

而且，你在工作时不用担心太多干扰，因为你会在我们的一个前哨站附近，我们会确保人们守规矩。

-“烟雾”

missions.name_zh: 异种威胁 = 发大财
name_notes_zh: 零比特 - 飞船抢劫 异种威胁 HRT

detail.description_en:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat.
We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting.
Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.
Interested?
57 65 65 76 69 6c
detail.description_zh:
你知道谁可能值得被狠狠揍一顿吗？异种威胁。

我们从一个服务器上获取了一些情报，里面有他们即将开展的所有行动的细节，只要价钱合适，我们就可以把一艘装满优质货物的异种威胁飞船的确切坐标发给你。

这是我们掌握的一点信息，这样你就知道我们不是在开玩笑。异种威胁把这艘飞船藏在一个锁住的小行星基地机库里，只能通过站内的电梯进入。我们没法为你打开机库门，但已经调整了安全协议，这样你就可以在机库的控制台上覆盖锁定。

有兴趣吗？

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on Daymar and Aberdeen. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.
Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻找能够完成另一份稀有材料采购订单的合作伙伴。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

只有少数已知地点可以获取这些材料，主要来自位于戴马尔和阿伯丁的现已解散的哈索尔集团遗址。我们建议前往平台校准设施（PAF），尝试重启其轨道激光平台（OLP），以获取行星地表下的材料。

提醒一下，由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on Daymar and Aberdeen. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.
Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION]
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION]

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。
