detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

detail.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
detail.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for a heavy Antium armor set. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."

detail.description_en:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy?
We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a [TARGET]. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that [LOCATION] is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.
Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.
Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 1 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
想帮我们对付坏蛋吗？

我们被雇来追捕一名驾驶 [AMBUSHTARGET] 的不法分子。这应该不太难，因为他们每天都走同样的飞行路线。这让他们成为了绝佳的伏击目标。我分析了路线，认为 [LOCATION] 是发动攻击的理想地点。在那里有一片辐射云，正好可以隐藏你的飞船信号，等着他们经过。

如果你感兴趣，工作很简单。前往指定地点，藏起来，关闭动力，然后等他们飞过。有时他们会单独行动，但他们通常会带着其他单座飞船。对于专业人士来说，这应该不算太难。此外，我们附近还有增援力量，随时准备出动，一旦情况升级就可以支援你。

搞定这事儿，我们就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

Once you and whoever you're bringing are ready, go to [LOCATION] and engage with these criminals. Since they like to fly in separate packs, be sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.

detail.description_en:
Ships coming and going from [LOCATION] are being targeted by hostile forces. The folks there have hired us to deal with this problem immediately.
Need someone to get there pronto and start fighting off these ships. The situation appears to be constantly evolving, so I’ll keep you updated on where you’re needed most.
For the hustle and effort, we’ll also be paying a bonus of 3 MG Scrip to the main contractor for dealing with this.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:

需要有人赶紧过去，开始击退这些飞船。情况似乎一直在变化，所以我会随时更新信息，告诉你最需要支援的地方。

为了感谢你的努力，我们还会给主承包商额外支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿

detail.description_en:
We've just received the location of an outlaw outpost where some up-and-coming criminals have been hanging out. Now, our client says there's no reason to engage these folks directly. Instead you will be targeting their supply lines.
Fly on over to [LOCATION] and take out their fuel stores while dealing with any minimal resistance they may put up. It will be your call on how much you engage with the hostile forces, just don't forget that your main objective is ensuring those fuel tanks are out of action.
This is a yellow level contract so pay will be proportionate.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
我们刚收到一处不法分子前哨站的位置情报，据报一些初露头角的罪犯近期常在此出没。客户明确表示：无需正面交火，你的任务是切断他们的补给线。

请飞往 [LOCATION]，摧毁其燃料储备库，并应对可能出现的轻微抵抗。如何与敌对势力周旋由你自行判断，但切记，核心目标是确保那些燃料罐彻底瘫痪。

本任务为黄色级别合约，报酬将以此相应设定。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿

detail.description_en:
A bunch of outlaws have been harassing our client and recently things have taken a turn for the worse. They've taken over their property and we've exhausted all other options.
We need a decent pilot to head to [LOCATION] and take out their fuel tanks. If you can cut off their supplies, you can pave the way for the client to take back their property.
This shouldn't be a tough one. You might run into a ship or two and maybe a few turrets, but you've been authorized to use lethal force. All we need for you to do is get in there, get the fuel tanks, and get out.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
一帮不法分子长期骚扰我们的客户，近来事态急剧恶化，他们甚至强占了客户的产业，我们已别无选择。

现需一名靠谱的飞行员前往 [LOCATION]，摧毁其燃料罐。只要切断他们的补给线，就能为客户夺回产业铺平道路。

这任务不算太难，你可能会遇上一两艘飞船和几座炮塔，但你已获授权可使用致命武力。我们唯一的要求是：进去、炸掉燃料罐、然后撤离。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

Okay, this might be a bit of stretch to do on your own, so if you got any favors to call in, it could be good to cash those chits now. There's a group of desperados striking delivery ships up and down this sector and we've been tasked with cleaning them up.
Once your crew is ready, head over to [LOCATION] and take the hostiles there down. Now, these bastards are a bit clever so they tend to split up into smaller packs. Make sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives."

等你们团队准备好了，就直接去 [LOCATION] 那儿，把那帮敌人一锅端了。不过提醒一句，这帮家伙脑子不笨，经常分头行动、化整为零，所以你得多蹲一会儿，确保一个都不漏掉。

Need someone to knock out a security patrol. You’ll need to go to the location marker on your HUD and then scan several designated waypoints ensuring that they’re safe and secure.
Satellites in that region have been acting up recently. Not exactly sure what’s going on out there, but best be prepared in case there’s any trouble.
Complete this contract and the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 4 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:

Outlaw ships are harassing anyone attempting to land or leave our client’s operations at [LOCATION]. Need someone to fly there to defend the site and protect our client’s ships before the situation gets out of control. Get there, get after those aggressors, and I'll keep you updated on the situation.
Help take care of this and we'll pass along a bonus payment of 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton

Outlaw ships are harassing anyone attempting to land or leave our client’s operations at [LOCATION]. Need someone to fly there to defend the site and protect our client’s ships before the situation gets out of control. Get there, get after those aggressors, and I'll keep you updated on the situation.
Help take care of this and we'll pass along a bonus payment of 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Eugene Walton

detail.description_en:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.
Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a [TARGET] and will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.
Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
有个逃亡的不法分子终于回到这个星系了。他们可能以为消失一阵子就能让我们忘记追捕他们。这家伙连伪装身份身份和改变行动路线都懒得做，所以我们完全掌握了行踪。

最新情报显示他们驾驶着 [AMBUSHTARGET]，很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。我已经物色好一处辐射云，最适合你关掉引擎躲藏起来静候目标。唯一不确定的是他们是否单独行动。听说这帮人有时会带着开单座机的同伙。第一波突袭至关重要，毕竟对方是群老油条。不过只要你需要，我们随时能派增援。

搞定这活儿，我们就会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

detail.description_en:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.
Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a [TARGET] and will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.
Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
有个逃亡的不法分子终于回到这个星系了。他们可能以为消失一阵子就能让我们忘记追捕他们。这家伙连伪装身份身份和改变行动路线都懒得做，所以我们完全掌握了行踪。

最新情报显示他们驾驶着 [AMBUSHTARGET]，很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。我已经物色好一处辐射云，最适合你关掉引擎躲藏起来静候目标。唯一不确定的是他们是否单独行动。听说这帮人有时会带着开单座机的同伙。第一波突袭至关重要，毕竟对方是群老油条。不过只要你需要，我们随时能派增援。

搞定这活儿，我们就会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

detail.description_en:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their [OBJECTS], based in [LOCATION]. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.
If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
呼叫所有飞行员 - 我们的一位客户正在为其位于 [LOCATION] 的 [OBJECTS] 寻求保护。据我们所知，这群袭击者自诩为不法分子，他们可能并未意识到自己试图摧毁的资产价值，纯粹是为了破坏而破坏。尽管如此，客户的财产至关重要，必须尽可能保持完好无损。

如果你能按照福克斯韦尔的达标标准解决这些麻烦，我们将向主承包商提供 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

For any pilots in the area – a group of bandits is targeting one of our clients at [LOCATION], specifically their [OBJECTS] and the maintenance ships that manage them. From our intel, it's only a few outlaws trying to make some quick credits, but they're also the type to cause some real damage if you get in their way.
If you take care of them and relocate the client's ship and crew safely, we’re offering 2 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
致区域内所有飞行员 - 一群匪徒正袭击位于 [LOCATION] 的我们的一位客户，目标直指其[OBJECTS]以及负责维护的飞船。据情报显示，对方仅由少数不法分子组成，企图快速捞一笔，但一旦有人挡路，他们也会造成严重破坏。

若你能击退他们，并安全转移客户的飞船与船员，我们将向主承包商支付 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

detail.description_en:
Any willing pilots in the area? Need some protection around [LOCATION] for a client. A band of outlaws has been targeting their [OBJECTS], and if nothing's done about it they'll do some real damage. Need someone to protect the client’s property as much as possible and deal with the thugs.
From the intel we’ve managed to gather, these thugs are small-time but can cause some pain if you’re not careful. So, if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 3 MG Scrip to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
detail.description_zh:
附近有没有的原意接单飞行员？我们需要有人为位于 [LOCATION] 的客户提供一些保护。有一伙不法分子正盯上他们的 [OBJECTS]，如果不加以制止，后果将不堪设想。我们需要有人尽可能保护好客户的财产，并解决这些暴徒。

根据我们掌握的情报，这些恶棍虽然只是小角色，但如果不小心应对，他们也能造成不小的麻烦。所以，如果你能按照福克斯韦尔的标准完成这次任务，我们将提供 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证给主承包商。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

detail.description_en:
We need a contractor to provide convoy and protection services at [LOCATION]. One of our elite clients' are under attack from a band of outlaws targeting their [OBJECTS] and ships. You'll need to keep the crew safe as they traverse the area, as well as make sure the assets stay as intact. These thugs look like they can do some real damage, so be sure you engage them with caution or the client might not be the only one to take heavy losses.
If you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering 3 MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

detail.description_en:
Hey,
Have a bit of good news for you. Covalex recently finished an evaluation of our contractor pool, and decided to reconsider your status as a cargo hauler. To requalify, all you need is to successfully complete the following delivery.
Pick up Tungsten from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and deliver it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul 1 SCU cargo containers.
Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

detail.description_zh:
嘿，

我有个好消息要告诉你，科瓦莱什最近完成了对我们备用承包商的评估，并决定重新考虑你作为货运员的身份。要重新获得资格，您只需要成功完成下列的投递。

从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯取得 [[ITEM]] ，并把它送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。为了快速高效地完成这次运输，你需要一艘能运 尺寸为 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 集装箱的飞船。

希望一切顺利，这样我们就能欢迎你重新回到队伍了。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。


科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 32 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

detail.description_en:
Hello,
Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 8 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

detail.description_en:
Hello,
There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in [LOCATION] that needs to go to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION] for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than 8 SCU.
My mom would’ve loved this run. She’s one of those who thinks every scrapyard is filled with hidden treasures. Can’t even tell you how many hours I spent bored out of my mind following her around one. If that’s your thing, here’s a chance to actually make credits going to one.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

哈喽，

需要一位承包商来一次简单的运货，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。尺寸最大不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱。

初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

Need the trash collected from a few Hurston locations and then taken to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Don't worry, none of the containers are bigger than 4 SCU.
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION2]
Fun fact for you. Hurston is the only planet in Stanton that doesn’t separate their trash and scrap. One of their workers told me that the company did a cost-benefit analysis on it decades ago that determined it wasn’t worth putting a planet-wide system in place to facilitate it. Isn’t that the most Hurston thing ever?
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

嗨，

一些十字军的设施需要补充加工食品和加压冰。不知道为什么，每次我看到他们要这么多东西的时候我总是很惊讶。

不管怎样，有一大堆尺寸不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱在 [LOCATION] 等着你。你从货运电梯上把货一拿走，这些设施就是它要去的地方了：

卸货地点（任意顺序）

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

[CONTRACTOR]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.
Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of Quartz from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
摘得“帝国金融Top10航运公司”和“投递领域2945最值得信赖的运输”等荣誉后，科瓦莱什比以往都更加繁忙。这意味着更多的货物将运往更多的地方，这就是需要你发挥作用的地方。

科瓦莱什正在寻找可靠且勤奋的飞行员加入我们不断壮大的家庭。你有能装载尺寸为 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱货物的飞船吗？如果需要，你能通过督导局的背景调查吗？那么，一个充满机会的宇宙正在等着你。

从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯里取出 [[ITEM]] 并把它成功送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯，即可完成“试用评估”。

圆满完成后，你将有资格成为拥有庞大的运输网络的科瓦莱什货运专员。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。


科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

Hello,
Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 4 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

你能帮我们处理一下吗？

[CONTRACTOR]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

detail.description_en:
Hello,
Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 4 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
哈喽，

需要一位承包商来一次简单的运货，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。尺寸最大不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

你能帮我们处理一下吗？

[CONTRACTOR]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

需要一位承包商来一次简单的运货，从 [LOCATION] 的货运电梯送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。尺寸最大不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

你能帮我们处理一下吗？

[CONTRACTOR]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

Hello,
Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 4 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

detail.description_en:
Hi,
Need the trash collected from a few Hurston locations and then taken to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Don't worry, none of the containers are bigger than 1 SCU.
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
Fun fact for you. Hurston is the only planet in Stanton that doesn’t separate their trash and scrap. One of their workers told me that the company did a cost-benefit analysis on it decades ago that determined it wasn’t worth putting a planet-wide system in place to facilitate it. Isn’t that the most Hurston thing ever?
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

detail.description_en:
Hi there,
There’s a few sites on ArcCorp that need their waste and scrap collected (all boxes 4 SCU or smaller) and taken to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Doesn’t matter what order you do the run, as long as you grab it all.
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
You know, my mom was a hauler who specialized in runs like this. It might not be the most glamorous stuff, but she claimed these runs had the best pay-to-risk ratio. Pirates never gave her any trouble when they found out what was on board.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
detail.description_zh:
你好啊,

在弧光星上有几个站点需要收集他们的垃圾（所有的箱子的尺寸都不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE]），并送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。不管你的取货路线是啥，只要你全拿走了就行。

取货地点（任意顺序）

[MULTITOSINGLETOKEN]

你知道吗，我妈妈是个货运员专门负责这种运输。这可能不是最吸引人的事情，但是她说这些业务有最佳的收益风险性价比。海盗们发现他船上是啥之后从没给她找过麻烦。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带手持式牵引光束。

[CONTRACTOR]

蔡斯·休伊特
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司，为鼓励及时交付和防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运将设定交货时间限制。到期后，任何未交付的货物将被视为被盗。总酬金将会根据货物成功交付的百分比按比例支付。

The refinery at [LOCATION] has been busy. They’ve processed a bunch of Corundum into containers 4 SCU or smaller, and are looking to get it shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see which ones needed this stuff and was able to put together this run.
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
Should be an easy run for you, if you’re free.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. 嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 的精炼站一直很忙，他们已经加工了各种精炼矿石，并希望用尺寸不超过 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的集装箱用从货运电梯把它们运走。我刚才和物流主管们确认了一下，看看哪些人需要这些东西让这趟活一次跑完。

[SINGLETOMULTITOKEN]

初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
